plugin.source: They say the College has been snooping around Saarthal. Mages in a burial crypt. No good can come of that...
plugin.target: 他們說學院最近在薩瑟爾城周邊有所動作。有法師在墓穴裡活動。恐怕不會幹出什麼好事……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: By Shor, is that... is that Azura's Star? How did you come to possess such a rare treasure?
plugin.target: 朔爾在上，那是……那是阿祖拉之星嗎？你怎麼會有這種稀世珍寶？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who did you have to kill to get that blade?
plugin.target: 你是殺了誰才得到那把刀的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That is one... big hammer.
plugin.target: 我真是一把……很大的錘子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That mace... get it away from me. Get it away...
plugin.target: 那個釘錘……別讓我看見它。把它拿走……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your shield... Dwarf-make, is it not? But yet it seems so much... more.
plugin.target: 你的盾……矮人制造，對吧？但是似乎並不是……這麼簡單。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That hammer... Why that's Aegisbane, heirloom of Clan Shatter-Shield! Last I heard, it was stolen by a couple of swindlers. Alain and... Muiri. Yeah.
plugin.target: 那個錘子……那不是神盾之禍嗎，碎盾氏族的傳家之寶！我最後一次聽到它的訊息，是它被兩個騙子偷走了。亞蘭和……暮蕊。對。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What a foul and unnatural weapon you wield. Never have I seen its like.
plugin.target: 你拿著的武器真是又邪惡又詭異。我從沒見過這樣的傢伙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ugh. Your breath is foul. What've you been eating?
plugin.target: 呃。你的口臭真嚴重。你吃什麼了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Uch. Been tending your hounds? You smell like a wet dog.
plugin.target: 呃……你剛照顧你的狗嗎？你聞起來像條落水狗。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sheathe those claws, Khajiit...

plugin.source: This truce with the Stormcloaks won't last a fortnight. Bloody savages will kill us while we sleep.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thalmor in the Ratway? What's next, spriggans in the Bee and Barb?

plugin.target: 哇，神盾之禍。碎盾氏族的象徵。但那東西不是才剛被偷了嗎？嗯，應該是我記錯了。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: For your sake, I hope you took that armor from a dead Imperial scout...

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yamarz refuses help, but I sense that you may be just what we need.
plugin.target: 亞馬茲拒絕援助，但我覺得你正是我們需要的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is there a way to cure yourself?
plugin.target: 你有辦法治好自己嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's what I've spent my twilight years trying to find out.
plugin.target: 我付出了晚年歲月就是在探究這個可能。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And now I've found the answer. The witches' magic ensnared us, and only their magic can release us.
plugin.target: 而現在我找到了答案。是女巫們利用法術囚禁了我們，可恨的是偏偏只有她們的法術才能解放我們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They won't give it willingly, but we can extract their foul powers by force.
plugin.target: 她們不會主動施法解救我們的，不過我們可以用蠻力取得他們的邪惡之力。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I want you to seek them out. Go to their coven in the wilderness. Strike them down as a true warrior of the wild.
plugin.target: 我希望你把她們找出來。在荒野中找到她們的聚集地。然後像一名真正的勇士堂堂正正地打倒她們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And bring me their heads. The seat of their abilities. From there, we may begin to undo centuries of impurity.
plugin.target: 然後把她們的頭顱帶回來給我。那是她們的力量之源。有了那個，我們就可以驅除這幾百年來的詛咒了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mind you, it's no business of mine what each Companion does in the name of honor.
plugin.target: 提醒你，不管團裡的戰友們打著榮耀的口號做了什麼事情，都和我無關。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But this sneaking around. It does not befit warriors of your standing. Aela knows better, and so should you.
plugin.target: 但是這種偷偷摸摸的事情，可不該發生在像你這樣的勇士身上。艾拉對於這點就很清楚，你也該記住這點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Get yourself kitted out with what you need. Welcome to the fight!
plugin.target: 裝備好所需的物品。來戰鬥吧，兄弟！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes. An axe. How long have you been in Skyrim? Give the man my axe.
plugin.target: 沒錯。一柄戰斧。你在天際待了多久了。把戰斧交給那人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If he keeps it, I will bide my time. If he returns it to you, it means war.
plugin.target: 如果他收下了戰斧，那我還可以伺機而動。可一旦他拒而不收，這就意味戰爭開始了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened to capturing Mercer alive?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: From the moment you were struck with my poisoned arrow at Snow Veil Sanctum, my path changed its course.
plugin.target: 在雪幔聖所當你被我的毒箭襲擊之後，我的計劃就改變了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps I couldn't bring Mercer back alive, but together, we were able to clear my name and to put Gallus' memory to rest.
plugin.target: 或許我沒辦法活捉墨瑟，但如果我們協力的話，就可以替我洗清罪名並讓加盧斯的靈魂得以安息。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd always intended Mercer's fate to ultimately be decided by the Guild, and it seems they've spoken.
plugin.target: 我一直主張墨瑟的命運最終該由公會決定，看來他們也似乎同意了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Just outside of Riften, beyond the southeast gate is a small path cut up the mountainside.
plugin.target: 裂谷城外，東南大門不遠處，有一條直上山腰的小路。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At the end of that path is a clearing and an old standing stone. I'd ask you both to meet me there.
plugin.target: 在小路盡頭有一塊古老又純淨的立石。請你們兩位在那裡等我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's a curse! It has to be! I... I've got to get out of this town.
plugin.target: 這是個詛咒！肯定是的！我必須離開這個小鎮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Lady Nocturnal, we accept your terms. We dedicate ourselves to you as both your avengers and your sentinels.
plugin.target: 諾克圖娜爾女士，我們接受您的契約。我們會將自身全都奉獻給您，做您的復仇者、做您的斥候。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We will honor our agreement in this life and the next, until your conditions have been met.
plugin.target: 直到您的目的達成，無論過了多少個輪迴，我們都會遵守契約。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here's the Jagged Crown. I believe you owe Galmar a drink?
plugin.target: 這就是鋸齒王冠。你是否該請加爾瑪喝一杯了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Damn him - that old bear was right! Did you run into any trouble?
plugin.target: 該死的——那頭老熊是對的！你有碰到什麼麻煩嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The stones aren't what bother me, love. The Forsworn are tearing The Reach apart.
plugin.target: 那些石碑並不是困擾我的東西，親愛的。困擾的是，棄誓者正在試圖分離邊塞領。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The city hasn't changed that much, dear. Same old Dwarven stones gathering the same old moss.
plugin.target: 城市並沒有那麼大的變動，親愛的。古老的矮人石碑，長滿了同樣古老的青苔，就是這樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Stew again, Papa? I want steak.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes, I know. As does Astrid. You have done well, and have earned both your reward, and a bonus, as I have mentioned.
plugin.target: 是的，我知道了。阿斯垂德也知道了。你做得很好，正如我之前所說的，你能拿到的不單隻報酬，還能獲得額外獎勵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But you should know that we have a more pressing matter to deal with.
plugin.target: 但是你得明白還有一件更緊迫的事情要辦。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's... Cicero. There's been an incident. You should proceed into the Sanctuary. I'll let Astrid explain.
plugin.target: 是……西塞羅。那裡出事了。你立刻前往聖所，我會叫阿斯垂德解釋給你聽的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Gaius Maro is dead.
plugin.target: 蓋烏斯·馬洛死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why are you here? Killing Gaius Maro is but the first step in your contract - you must also plant the incriminating letter on his body...
plugin.target: 你在這裡做什麼？除掉蓋烏斯·馬洛只是契約的第一步——你還要把誣陷的信件塞到他身上……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes, I'm ready.
plugin.target: 好的，我準備好了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good. After I open the gate, please stand on the circle.
plugin.target: 好極了。我開啟門之後，請站在西面的圓圈中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I made a mistake. I want to be a Stormcloak. The crown belongs to you.
plugin.target: 我錯了。我想成為風暴斗篷。王冠是你的了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're not short of guts, are you? What's your game?
plugin.target: 你可不是懦弱之徒，不是嗎？你在搞什麼鬼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why would Tullius waste resources getting the crown only to give it to me? Poisoned, perhaps? No. He's not that cunning.
plugin.target: 圖留斯為什麼會費這麼大勁兒拿到王冠，最後卻送給我？要毒害我？不會。他不是狡詐之人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Alright. I believe you. You aren't the first to turn away from the Empire in disgust.
plugin.target: 好吧。我相信你。你也不是第一個開始厭惡帝國的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But remember - you're one of us now, forever. Whatever Imperial loyalties you may have had... that's all in the past, forgotten.
plugin.target: 但請記住——你是我們的一員，永遠都是。無論你之前對帝國多麼的忠心耿耿……這都是往事了，不再計較。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now, to prove yourself to me, I have a task for you. Take my axe, and deliver it to the Jarl of Whiterun.
plugin.target: 現在，向我證明一下你自己吧，我有個任務給你。拿上我的戰斧，把它交給白漫城的領主。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I just want to join the Legion. Consider the crown a gift.
plugin.target: 我只想加入軍團。以王冠為見面禮。

plugin.source: Well, you did show remarkable initiative. And you didn't have to bring the crown to me...
plugin.target: 好吧……你的積極性讓我很欽佩。不過，你不用把王冠給我……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But let me warn you - joining the Legion is for life. Any previous loyalties... I trust we understand each other.
plugin.target: 不過我提醒你——加入軍團就意味著至死不渝。而你之前所效忠的……我希望我們可以互相信任彼此。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You can prove your new allegiance to me, by delivering an important message to the Jarl of Whiterun.
plugin.target: 你要向我證明你的忠誠，就要幫我向白漫城的領主傳達一個重要的訊息。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hmm... what is that? Some kind of stone claw? I wonder what it's used for?
plugin.target: 嗯……那是什麼？像是石爪？是不是有什麼用處。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: See what you can figure out, Auxiliary. I'm going to check out these carvings over here. Let me know if you find something.
plugin.target: 試試能不能找出路來，輔助軍士。我去看看這裡的浮雕，你如果有什麼發現務必告訴我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One thing at a time, soldier. Focus on our primary mission. We're searching for the crown.
plugin.target: 專心點吧，士兵。記住我們的主要任務。找到王冠。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Too bad we can't read these carvings. Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
plugin.target: 可惜我們看不懂這些刻字。否則天知道我們會發現什麼秘密？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Saxhleel?
plugin.target: 撒西勒？

plugin.target: 抱歉。這種說法我也好久沒用過了。泰姆瑞爾上大多數人都把我們叫做亞龍人，但我們自稱為撒西勒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sure, I'll get them for you.
plugin.target: 沒問題，我會帶來給你的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you, marsh-friend.
plugin.target: 謝謝你，來自沼澤的朋友。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you, land-strider.
plugin.target: 謝謝你，旅行者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 你自己打造珠寶嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I do. Sadly, I'm one of the few traditional Saxhleel Jewelers that remains in Tamriel; it's becoming a lost art.
plugin.target: 是的。可惜的是，我已經是泰姆瑞爾大陸上為數不多的正宗撒西勒寶石匠了，我們的手藝算是瀕危藝術了。

plugin.target: 唯一的困難就是收集材料的路途十分危險。前往礦坑和其他城市的沿途全是強盜……而且可能還更糟。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Would you be interested in gathering some materials for me? I'd certainly be happy to compensate you.
plugin.target: 你有興趣幫我收集材料嗎？只要你帶回來，我會很樂意給你報酬的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good luck with that.
plugin.target: 祝你好運。

plugin.source: The job pays well, so I hope I can make arrangements soon. We really could use the gold.
plugin.target: 任務的報酬不錯，所以我想盡快完成安排。我們可以好好利用這筆金幣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you jealous of her?

plugin.target: 噢！不是，我不是這個意思。艾爾格瑞姆連幫自己穿鞋都有困難，更別說有能力追女孩子了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He's been gushing about how talented Ingun is at alchemy. He'd never say it to her face; that's not his way.
plugin.target: 他不停地在吹捧因甘說她對鍊金術多有天份。但他從未當面和她說過，他就是這樣的人。

plugin.source: I just think Elgrim's taken it upon himself to mentor the young thing so he focuses a lot of attention on her.
plugin.target: 我只是覺得，艾爾格瑞姆決定親自教導那個年輕人，這樣他才可以花更多時間在她身上。

plugin.source: Are you an alchemist as well?

plugin.source: I know how to mix a few basic potions, but I'm nowhere near as skilled as a master alchemist.
plugin.target: 我只是略懂一些簡單的配方，要說是鍊金大師，那根本談不上。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've picked up a few tricks by reading the tomes scattered all over the shop, but I don't have the knack to pull off half of the formulas.
plugin.target: 我在附近的書店裡看了很多書籍，稍微學了點小技倆，但是我連其中的一半配方都還沒掌握。

plugin.source: How did you capture Ulfric?
plugin.target: 你是怎麼抓到烏弗瑞克的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A masterstroke by General Tullius! He's only been in charge here for a few months, but he's turned things around for the Empire.
plugin.target: 是圖留斯將軍的一條妙計！他才接管此地幾個月，就徹底改變了帝國。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've been trying to catch Ulfric since the war started, but he always seemed to slip through our fingers... like he knew we were coming.
plugin.target: 自從戰爭爆發後，我們就一直在追捕烏弗瑞克，可他總能巧妙的從我們手中溜走……就像他知道我們會來抓他似的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This time, the General turned the tables on him. Ulfric rode right into our ambush with only a few bodyguards.
plugin.target: 這一次，將軍扭轉了戰局。烏弗瑞克徑直衝進了我們的包圍圈，身邊的衛兵屈指可數。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He surrendered pretty meekly too. So much for his death-or-glory reputation.
plugin.target: 他也很配合的投降了。倒是與他一貫寧死不從的作風有些不同。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I thought we were taking Ulfric back to Cyrodiil, but I guess the General changed his mind. You know the rest.
plugin.target: 本以為我們要把烏弗瑞克帶回賽瑞迪爾，不過好像將軍改變了主意。接下來的就如你所知。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No going back that way now.
plugin.target: 我們現在沒有退路了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, got a bit of interest in your boss do you?
plugin.target: 噢，開始對你的頭領感興趣了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You should quit working in the eastern mine. Leigelf's no good to work for.
plugin.target: 你應該放棄在東部礦坑的工作。幫雷蓋爾夫工作沒什麼好處。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Animals in The Pale don't need a reason to attack Dawnstar. It's just their nature.
plugin.target: 蒼原的野獸們攻擊晨星人是不需要理由的。捕獵是它們的天性。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thoring, do you remember the time when that wolf pack came clamoring into town?
plugin.target: 梭靈，你還記得狼群咆哮著衝進城鎮時的情景嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Dawnstar has always held its own against the bandits and wild animals of The Pale.
plugin.target: 晨星從來都是獨自對付蒼原的強盜和猛獸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Frida, you aren't saying...
plugin.target: 福瑞達，你不是說……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The General expects so much with so little.
plugin.target: 將軍期望過高了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The sooner we end this rebellion, the sooner I'll be able to sleep at night.
plugin.target: 我們早日平定這場叛亂，就能早日睡個安穩覺。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ulfric... what have you done my old friend?
plugin.target: 烏弗瑞克……我的老朋友，你做了什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Stormcloaks... even the name of their rebellion stinks of Ulfric's vanity. He wants to be king. That's all this is about. One man's ambition.
plugin.target: 風暴斗篷他們……就算是打著革命的口號，他們的名聲也被烏弗瑞克的虛榮心搞臭了。他想當的是國王。這就是真實情況。完全是他一個人的野心。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't fight for the glory of the Empire, nor do I glory in the death of my kinsmen. I fight to bring peace and order to my homeland.
plugin.target: 我並不是為了帝國的榮譽而戰，也不是為了族人的名譽而戰。我奮勇廝殺只為換取故土的和平穩定。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Dammit! Why can't Ulfric see he's tearing Skyrim to pieces?
plugin.target: 該死！難道烏弗瑞克沒發現他這樣會把天際搞得四分五裂嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When we destroy the rebellion, perhaps the Thalmor will call off their damned inquisitions. It's just making things worse.
plugin.target: 一旦我們平定了叛軍，梭默說不定會立刻撤走法庭。這樣局勢就更糟了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Stormblade.
plugin.target: 風暴之刃。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sometimes I wonder if Ulfric understands what I'm dealing with out here.
plugin.target: 有時候我懷疑烏弗瑞克到底知不知道我在這裡做些什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What will Skyrim have become if her children submitted to tyranny?
plugin.target: 如果百姓們都臣服於暴政，那麼天際將來會變成什麼樣子？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire would have us become their slaves as they have become slaves to the Thalmor. I will not live as a slave, nor will I die as one.
plugin.target: 帝國會把我們變成政府的奴隸，就像他們已經成為了梭默的奴隸一樣。我生不作奴隸，死亦不作奴隸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire is weak. That is why we fight them. Skyrim must be ruled by the strong.
plugin.target: 帝國虛弱不堪。這就是為什麼我們要跟它鬥爭。天際一定要找到更強的主人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When we have reclaimed our homeland from the Imperials, we will take the fight to the Thalmor. They are the true enemy. Make no mistake.
plugin.target: 當我們從帝國重拾我們的家園之時，我們會與梭默鬥爭。他們是真正的敵人。不要搞錯了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If there was someone else Ulfric could trust with all this planning nonsense, I would be out there breaking heads with the rest of you.
plugin.target: 要是這樣胡亂佈局之後，烏弗瑞克還能有誰相信的話，我就和你們一起真刀真槍地出去戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire is man's last bastion. If Ulfric wasn't blinded by lust for power, he'd see we are on the same side.
plugin.target: 帝國是人類最後的堡壘。如果烏弗瑞克沒有被權力的慾望矇蔽了雙眼，他就會看到，其實我們是站在同一邊的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Were the Stormcloaks to prevail in dismantling Imperial rule in Skyrim, who would be her protector? No. We will crush this rebellion. We must.
plugin.target: 要是風暴斗篷推翻帝國在天際的統治，誰來保護我們的天際？沒有，我們要碾碎這次叛亂。我們必須要成功。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ulfric would expunge from Skyrim citizens whose only crime was to be born of a non-Nordic woman. That is unacceptable to free men everywhere.
plugin.target: 烏弗瑞克就因為一個人不是諾德人生的而殺了他。這對於世界上的自由人民來說是不可接受的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We stand out here in the cold, as brothers, warmed by the knowledge that we fight for the rights of every free citizen of the Empire.
plugin.target: 我們站在這裡，冰冷刺骨，我們兄弟們並肩，只因知道我們是在為每一個帝國的自由公民而奮戰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire would have us become slaves to the Thalmor. We are not slaves. We are men. Free men who will slay anyone who begs to differ.
plugin.target: 帝國本來會把我們都變成梭默的奴隸。我們不是奴隸，我們都是人。自由的人，為了自由我們會斬殺一切敵人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It was anger that brought each of us here, but it is love that keeps us fighting.
plugin.target: 我們來到這裡都是因為心中的憤怒，而支援我們戰鬥的則是我們心中的愛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My hatred for the Empire is bested only by love for my countrymen.
plugin.target: 只有想到我們的同胞之時，我對帝國的仇恨才被拋在了腦後。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Emperor would turn Skyrim into a puppet of the Dominion. I for one would not care to dance for the amusement of those foul elves.
plugin.target: 帝國會把整個天際都變成先祖神洲的傀儡。我才不會為那些卑賤的精靈跳舞。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll fight the entire Legion myself if they dare show their faces here.
plugin.target: 要是他們敢在這裡露面，我就敢跟他們整個軍團打一仗。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Legion soldiers gleam like fresh-fallen snow and clank like a kitchen. They head this way, we'll know it.
plugin.target: 軍團士兵像雪崩一樣滾過來了，吵得就像廚房裡一樣。他們朝這邊來了，我們聽見了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I long to be out there, with my brothers, waging war against the Empire.
plugin.target: 我渴望能和我的兄弟們一起，在外面和帝國大戰一番。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Keep an eye out for Stormcloak spies.
plugin.target: 留意風暴斗篷的間諜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Been so long since I killed a Stormcloak, my sword arm's getting flabby.
plugin.target: 上一次殺死一個風暴斗篷都是好久以前的事情了，我的肌肉都變成肥肉了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Stay alert. Never know when those Stormcloak dogs might charge.
plugin.target: 提高警覺。你永遠不知道那些風暴斗篷畜生什麼時候會衝過來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Buy it? This? An Elder Council amulet?
plugin.target: 要買它？這個？一條上古議會項鍊？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh yes. Oh yes, indeed.
plugin.target: 哦、好啊，好。確實是沒什麼不好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Uh, wait just one moment...
plugin.target: 稍等一會……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here... is a letter of credit. Usable, by Astrid only, for any service or item I can provide. As per our standard arrangement.
plugin.target: 來，這是信用憑證。只有阿斯垂德能使用，可換我的東西與服務。一切按照我們協議的標準。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You bring that back to your lovely mistress. With my regards.
plugin.target: 你拿回去交給你的女主人吧，順便為我捎去問候。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Will you buy it?
plugin.target: 你要買它嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let's see...
plugin.target: 我們來瞧一瞧……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where oh where did you get this? No, don't answer - I don't want to know.
plugin.target: 從哪兒，你是從哪兒得到的這個東西？別回答——我不想知道。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This is an amulet of the Emperor's Elder Council. Specially crafted for each member. Worth a small fortune. Ain't somethin' you'd give up lightly.
plugin.target: 這是皇帝的上古議會的一枚護符。是特別為每一位重要人物打造的。值不少錢，最好不要易輕易丟棄。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look, it ain't my business to tell the Dark Brotherhood its business, but if you killed a member of the Elder Council, you'd better belie-
plugin.target: 瞧，談論黑暗兄弟會的事情可不是我該做的事，但是如果你殺死了長老會的某位人物，你最好相信——
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What can you tell me about this? (Give Delvin the amulet)
plugin.target: 這東西你有什麼見解？（把護符交給戴爾文）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh. Oh, I see.
plugin.target: 哦，我明白了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, you're makin' friends all over, ain't ya?
plugin.target: 好吧，你到處結交好友，是吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, uh... how is Astrid doing these days? Tell her to stop by some time. We can have a drink. Catch up.
plugin.target: 那麼，呃……阿斯垂德可這段時間怎麼樣了？告訴她有時間過來串串門。我們可以喝一杯，然後聊聊天。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, but business! Of course. What kind of business?
plugin.target: 啊，可別是談什麼正事！當然了，到底是什麼要事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Actually, I'm here on Dark Brotherhood business.
plugin.target: 事實上，我來這裡是有黑暗兄弟會的要事要談。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh. Oh, I see.
plugin.target: 哦，我明白了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well now, how is Astrid doing these days, uh? Tell her to stop by some time. We can have a drink. Catch up.
plugin.target: 好，阿斯垂德這段時間怎麼樣，呃？告訴她有時間過來串串門。我們可以喝一杯。磨磨嘴皮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, but we can discuss that later, yeah? What does the Brotherhood need?
plugin.target: 啊，但是我們可以以後再討論這個問題，對吧？兄弟會需要做什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Dark Brotherhood requires your services.
plugin.target: 黑暗兄弟會要求你的幫助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I know many things. I've studied things beyond the reach of most humans, traveled the Oblivion planes, seen things one should not see.
plugin.target: 我懂很多事情，我研究的東西比你們大多數人都還要多，我徒步穿越過湮滅位面，看見了許多不該看見的東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have met Daedra and Dwemer and everything in between and I know enough to see a vampire where others would see a man.
plugin.target: 我見過魔族和鍛莫，以及其他的東西。由於我懂的夠多，即使你們認為他是一個普通人，我也能看出他其實是吸血鬼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've heard you're an expert in vampirism.
plugin.target: 我聽說你在吸血鬼的習性研究方面是個內行。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, the bard-to-be. Did Viarmo send you?
plugin.target: 啊，你就是那個想成為吟遊詩人的人。維阿墨派你來的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's time for us to part ways.
plugin.target: 是時候分道揚鑣了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If that's what you want. Come find me at the College if you change your mind.
plugin.target: 如你所願。要是改變主意就來學院找我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd best get back to Master Neloth then. No telling what's happened since I've been gone.
plugin.target: 我最好回到尼洛施大師身邊。我離開的這段時間，不知道會發生什麼事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You'll be all right on your own? Then I'll see you back at the College.
plugin.target: 你一個人沒問題吧？那我們就學院再見了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Really? J'zargo was having such fun. Ah, well. Back to the College then.

plugin.target: 我不在乎我們可能來自相同的祖先，這些人都是粗魯的人。他們之中有半數是棄誓者野蠻人，你有看到他們吃的是什麼嗎？

plugin.source: What have I done for the gods to take me so far from my beloved Daggerfall?
plugin.target: 我為了神做了那麼多，就是為了讓我遠離我深愛的匕落嗎？

plugin.source: What do you mean "saviors of Mer"?

plugin.source: The Thalmor saved all of Elven-kind during the Oblivion Crisis. We've been watching over our lands for 200 years.
plugin.target: 梭默從湮滅危機之中拯救了精靈族，我們守護這片土地已經有二百年了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We refounded the Aldmeri Dominion, an alliance between us and our Bosmer cousins. You might know them from their common name. Wood Elves.
plugin.target: 我們重新建立了先祖神洲，他們是我們和波茲莫近親之間的聯盟。你也許聽說過他們的通稱-木精靈
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We intend to prove the superiority of mer over man, one century at a time.
plugin.target: 我們打算每一個世紀就證明一次精靈是優越於人的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm interested. What is it?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ogmund the skald. He's old, respected, and I know for a fact that he worships Talos in his home.
plugin.target: 吟唱者歐格蒙，他年長且倍受尊敬，而且我知道他常在家膜拜塔洛斯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But the Jarl has been hesitant to call for his arrest. I want you to break into his home and find evidence.
plugin.target: 但是領主對於逮捕他感到有點疑慮。所以我希望你能強行闖入他的家裡找到證據。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why are you after Talos worshippers?
plugin.target: 你為什麼要追蹤塔洛斯的信徒呢？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's a religious matter. The Thalmor do not recognize Talos as a god. He was only a man, and does not deserve a place in our pantheon.
plugin.target: 事關宗教信仰，梭默並沒有把塔洛斯看作是一位神。他只是一個人，而且他不值得被列入萬神殿當中。

plugin.source: The Empire has agreed to accept our beliefs, and its citizens have a responsibility to cease their heretical worship.
plugin.target: 帝國已經同意接受我們的信仰，而他們的公民也該停止對異端的崇拜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're awfully inquisitive, aren't you? I like that. Perhaps you'd care to solve a little problem I'm having?
plugin.target: 你很愛管閒事對吧？我喜歡那樣，也許你有興趣幫我解決一些麻煩？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're not from Markarth, I take it?
plugin.target: 你不是馬卡斯城的人，對嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As if this craggy, wretch of a city could give birth to a superiorly bred mer such as myself. No, I'm not from Markarth.
plugin.target: 除非這低賤陡峭的城市能誕生出像我這樣的高貴血統。不，我並非來自馬卡斯城。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I was sent here to lead the Thalmor's interests in this corner of Skyrim. It's my mission to root out all Talos worship in this city.
plugin.target: 我是被派來這引導天際中此處的梭默信徒。我的任務是杜絕這個城市裡所有對塔洛斯的崇拜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who are the Thalmor?
plugin.target: 梭默是些什麼人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We're the ruling body of the Aldmeri Dominion. Saviors of mer. Victors of the Great War.
plugin.target: 我們是先祖神洲的管理者，精靈的救星。浩大戰爭的勝利者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire exists because we allow it to exist, and I'm here to make sure the Jarl of Markarth remembers that.
plugin.target: 帝國的存在是因我們允許其存在，而我之所以在這裡是為了提醒馬卡斯城的領主記住這一點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're married to Thonar? What's he like?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He's the real head of this family. He may not be the eldest, but all the work that keeps us respected is handled by my Thonar.
plugin.target: 他是這個家族的棟樑。他也許不是最年長的，但他卻能應對所有的工作。這令我們非常敬佩他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Know anything about the Thieves Guild?
plugin.target: 你知道任何關於盜賊公會的訊息嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You kiddin'? My brother Dirge works in their hideout.
plugin.target: 你開玩笑呢？我的兄弟輓歌在他們的藏身處工作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I used to run with them myself, but took a job with Maven after they started hittin' a rough patch.
plugin.target: 我曾經是他們的支持者，但在他們遭遇打擊之後我接下了瑪雯的工作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you want to get in on that action, find Brynjolf in the marketplace. I'm sure he could use someone like you.
plugin.target: 如果你想加入他們的行動，去市集找布林喬夫，我相信他會僱用像你這樣的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd like to purchase a home in your city.
plugin.target: 我想在你的城市買間房子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't know you, and I don't sell what precious property we have to outsiders.
plugin.target: 我不瞭解你，而且我們也不賣我們珍貴的房產給外人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But if you're willing to work, and you prove to be reliable, I might deem you worthy to live here. My Steward will handle things from there.
plugin.target: 但如果你打算在這裡工作，而且證明了你可以信賴，我會承認你夠格居住在這。我的總管將會滿足你的要求的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nothing to say? Fine, but I'm watching you.
plugin.target: 沒什麼要說的了。好吧，但我會注意你的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I understand you knew Isabelle Rolaine.
plugin.target: 我知道你認識伊莎貝拉·羅萊妮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What?
plugin.target: 什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't you... don't you say that name to me.
plugin.target: 不，不要在我面前提起那個名字。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't you dare. Ever.
plugin.target: 別再這麼做了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where did you say Isabelle Rolaine was?
plugin.target: 你之前說過過伊莎貝拉·羅萊妮在哪
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Like I told you, last time I saw her she was headed for Hob's Fall Cave. No idea what happened to her.
plugin.target: 正如我之前告訴你的，上次我看見她朝落灶洞穴去了。我不清楚她出了什麼事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So you do know her.
plugin.target: 所以說你認識她。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: She came through a while ago, wanted to know where she could get her hands on something valuable. Anything, really.
plugin.target: 她之前來過，想弄清自己能上哪兒去找點值錢的東西。什麼都好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I told her it was a bad idea, that she wasn't cut out for what'd be necessary, but she wouldn't hear it.
plugin.target: 我告訴她那不是個好主意，但她沒有聽進去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So I gave her some advice, pointed her towards Hob's Fall Cave and that was that.
plugin.target: 所以我給了她一些建議，並指引她去落灶洞穴。就是那樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you know Isabelle Rolaine?
plugin.target: 你知道伊莎貝拉·羅萊妮這個人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who's asking?
plugin.target: 誰在問的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What did he used to be like?
plugin.target: 他以前是個什麼樣的人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, he was a different person. Happy, outgoing... like anyone who's in love.
plugin.target: 噢，他是個與眾不同的人，快樂且直率，正如沉浸在愛中的人一樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Anything around here that needs doing?
plugin.target: 這裡有什麼事需要人幫忙？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, not exactly.
plugin.target: 好吧，不全是這樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Listen, we're friends, right?
plugin.target: 我們是朋友，對吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I wonder if I could ask a favor of you.
plugin.target: 我在想我能否請你幫個忙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I haven't spoken to him yet.
plugin.target: 我還沒跟他談過呢
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Can't blame you for having better things to do than to help some farmer you don't know.
plugin.target: 你有比幫助陌生農夫更好的事情要做，這沒什麼好抱怨的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your father changed his mind.
plugin.target: 你父親改變主意了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I can't thank you enough, friend. I hope you'll come back to Rorikstead soon and pay me a visit.
plugin.target: 感激不盡，朋友。我希望你日後能回到洛利克鎮來看看我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Maybe we can swap stories about our adventures over a mug of ale at the inn!
plugin.target: 也許我們可以在酒館裡一起暢飲麥芽酒，一邊交流冒險經歷。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Enough!
plugin.target: 夠了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You are traitors and will die traitors' deaths. Stand down and face public execution, or advance and face summary execution by my hands.
plugin.target: 你們這些叛徒，必將死無葬身之地。你們要麼就滾開聽候公眾的審判，要麼就上前馬上讓我親手處決。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It matters little to me. Either way, I'll be sending your heads back to Cyrodiil.
plugin.target: 這對我來說沒什麼區別。不論如何我都會把你們的頭顱送回賽瑞迪爾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No... but I belong to her.
plugin.target: 不……但我得聽她的話。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Step aside, Galmar. We're here to accept Ulfric's surrender.
plugin.target: 讓開，加爾瑪。我們是來這接受烏弗瑞克投降的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've purchased Honeyside.
plugin.target: 我已經把甜蜜灣買下了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hmm? What's this about?
plugin.target: 唔？這是怎麼回事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, yes, of course. The whole Thane thing. I'd forgotten. If you're ready then, can we get this out of the way?
plugin.target: 噢，是的。當然……武衛那件事嘛。我幾乎都忘了。要是你準備好了，那麼我們就來搞定這事吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I would be honored to accept.
plugin.target: 能夠得到這個稱號讓我倍感榮幸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Before I can present you with the title, there's but a single requirement you must fulfill.
plugin.target: 在我把稱號授予你之前，還有唯一一個條件你必須滿足。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A Thane of Riften is expected to maintain permanent residence within the city walls.
plugin.target: 作為一位裂谷城的武衛，他應該在城牆內保證有固定的住處。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My Steward has such a home available to you for purchase. I think you'll find the accommodations to be most pleasing.
plugin.target: 我的侍從剛好有那麼一套房子可以賣給你。我想你肯定會對那住所感到非常滿意的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When the house is yours, return to me and I will present you the title.
plugin.target: 等房子屬於你之後，就回來找我，我會把稱號授予你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah ah ah. Not so fast, there's a matter of residence to be discussed.
plugin.target: 沒那麼快，居留的問題還得討論討論。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In order to have the title bestowed upon you, you need to purchase a house within Riften.
plugin.target: 為了能夠被賜予那個頭銜，你必須在裂谷城買棟房子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And by the Eight, aren't you fortunate that my Steward has just the place for you to buy.
plugin.target: 八聖靈在上，我的侍從剛好有那麼一處地方可以賣給你，你可真夠幸運的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After the place is yours, come back to me and we'll deal with the rest of the nonsense.
plugin.target: 等你把那地方買下來就回來找我，我們再去處理其它那亂七八糟的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you.
plugin.target: 謝謝。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I should be the one thanking you. You've solved more problems in the short time you've been here than anyone in my court has their entire careers.
plugin.target: 我才應該說謝謝呢。你才來了這麼一陣子，就幫忙解決了那麼多問題，要是換作我的任何手下，肯定搞一輩子都搞不定。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've been a beacon of hope in these dark times for my people and I will never forget it.
plugin.target: 在這黑暗的時代裡，你簡直就是我們的希望之光，你的恩情我永遠不會忘記。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Therefore, by my authority as Jarl, I pronounce you Thane of Riften and award you all the benefits befitting your station. Congratulations.
plugin.target: 因此，我以領主的身份宣佈，封你為裂谷城武衛，並賜予你一切應得的權益與獎賞。恭喜你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I expect that you'll distance yourself from the affairs of state. In other words, keep your nose out of my business and we'll do just fine.
plugin.target: 我希望你能劃清界限，不要插手本土的事務。換句話說，只要你不來干涉我，那大家都能相安無事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Just remember that you're only a part of my court. This doesn't make you one of the family.
plugin.target: 要記得你還只是我的一名臣屬，而不是我的家族成員。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I guess all that's left is to bestow the title. What were those words again?
plugin.target: 我想只剩下稱號賜予的事情了。那該說什麼來著？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Doesn't matter... the title is yours. I henceforth name you Thane of Riften. Don't disappoint me.
plugin.target: 無所謂……稱號是你的。我從今天開始任命你為裂谷城武衛。別讓我失望了啊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've purchased Honeyside.
plugin.target: 我已經把甜蜜灣買下了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Regarding what, my lady?
plugin.target: 是關於什麼的呢，我的女士？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, don't pretend to be modest. I'm talking about your new role as champion. Apparently, you've taken my people under your wing.
plugin.target: 噢你別太自謙了。我正在討論你勇士的新身份。很顯然，你非常關懷我的人民。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you think you can steal my throne by winning the hearts of the people, that's where you're wrong. Keep that in mind.
plugin.target: 你給我聽好了，要是你覺得這樣收買人心就能篡我的位，那你就大錯特錯了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: However, since it wouldn't behoove me to make you disappear, I'd rather have you on my side as Thane of Riften.
plugin.target: 然而，要我就這樣把放你走也太可惜了，我倒希望你能成為裂谷城武衛，做我的左右手。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is there anything I can help Riften with?
plugin.target: 有什麼事情我可以幫到裂谷城的嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, there you are. I was wondering when you'd visit us again.
plugin.target: 啊，你來了，我剛剛還想著你什麼時候會再來見我們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've been informed by my Steward that you've made quite an impression in The Rift; several of our citizens have expressed their admiration.
plugin.target: 我的侍從告訴我，你已經給裂痕領的人們留下了深刻的印象；我們有不少居民都對你表示欽佩。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, I've been hearing your name in court quite a bit lately.
plugin.target: 嗯，我才在宮廷裡聽說你的大名，有點兒孤陋寡聞了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've been informed by my Steward that you've made quite an impression in The Rift; the people won't stop blathering about you.
plugin.target: 我的侍從告訴我，你已經給裂痕領的人們留下了深刻的印象；人們都七嘴八舌的討論你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: On second thought, maybe we'll fight later.
plugin.target: 我想了想，不如我們還是下次再打吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Suit yourself. I'm always here.
plugin.target: 隨你便，反正我一直都會在這裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let's fight! (Brawl)
plugin.target: 我們來打吧！（打架）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here we go!
plugin.target: 放馬過來！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How about a rematch?
plugin.target: 再比一次怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sure, I don't mind taking some more of your gold.
plugin.target: 很好，我也不介意在你身上多贏點錢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Just let me know when you're ready.
plugin.target: 你準備好就告訴我一聲。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll fight you again, but not until you have the gold to back up your bet.
plugin.target: 等你有足夠的錢下賭注了，我就和你再打一場。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sure, I'll match your bet! (Brawl)
plugin.target: 好啊，我接受你的賭注！（打架）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well come back when you earn some more so I can take it from you!
plugin.target: 歡迎再來，等你賺夠了錢再回來輸給我吧！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't have the money right now.
plugin.target: 我現在沒有錢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Must be dangerous living outside the walls.
plugin.target: 住在城牆外一定很危險。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Bah, I'm not afraid of anything out here. Walls are just a weakling's hiding spot.
plugin.target: 呸，我說這有什麼好怕的。只有懦弱的傢伙才躲在城牆後面。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Not me, I'm no weakling. In fact, I bet I've got the strongest arms in all of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 你看我，我才不是什麼弱者。實際上，我可是有著天際最孔武有力的臂膀呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Does this finally mean peace?
plugin.target: 終於，這樣就和平了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The fiercest of the remaining rebels will continue to harass us, but by and large, the people here desire peace.
plugin.target: 那些最兇殘的殘餘叛亂份子，還會不斷地侵擾我們，但整體來說，這裡的大多數人都期待著和平。

plugin.source: Hmph. I like to say I was born with a wand in my hand. Well, not literally - you can see how painful that would have been for Mother.
plugin.target: 唔，我喜歡說我帶著魔杖出生。當然，不是字面上的意思，要是真的那樣，你可以想像母親會多痛苦。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Wait here.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you sure? All right. I'll keep guard here.
plugin.target: 你確定？好吧，我來守住這裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: (growl)
plugin.target: （咆哮）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Head on, then. I will keep an eye out.
plugin.target: 往前走，我會警惕周圍的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me more about this artifact.
plugin.target: 告訴我更多關於這聖器的事情吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mortals call it Dawnbreaker, for it was forged in a holy light that breaks upon my foes, burning away corruption and false life.
plugin.target: 人們叫它破曉者，因為它是用照耀在敵人身上的聖光所打造而成，可以燒盡一切的墮落和虛偽。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You will enter my shrine, destroy Malkoran, and retrieve this mighty blade.
plugin.target: 你得到我的神殿去，殺死莫克然，取回那把強大的武器。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This store has seen better days, hasn't it?
plugin.target: 這商店有過好日子，對吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, by the Divines is it that obvious? I swear, if my Gunnar was alive to see me now.
plugin.target: 哦，看在聖靈的份上，這不是很明顯嗎？我發誓，如果我的甘那還在的話，決不會是這樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This store would finally be on its feet if I hadn't lost my last shipment to the Forsworn attacks. A specially made Dibella statuette.
plugin.target: 如果不是我的貨，一個特製的小蒂貝拉塑像被棄誓者搶走了，這家店就能順利運作下去了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You aren't for hire, are you? A sellsword? I'll pay you if you can recover that statuette from the Forsworn.
plugin.target: 你不是來應徵工作的，對吧？你是傭兵嗎？你如果能從棄誓者手裡奪回我的雕像，我就付你報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This city looks so ancient. Have you been here long?
plugin.target: 這城市看起來真古老，你在這裡住很久了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My family came here centuries ago. We made a good living smithing the silver that flows through the city.
plugin.target: 我的家族在幾個世紀前就搬來了，我們靠鍛造流過城市的銀子為生，日子過得還不錯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But you probably wanted to know about the fancy carvings and stonework, didn't you? Travelers always do.
plugin.target: 你多半更想知道關於那些想像力十足的雕刻品的事，對嗎？旅行者都這樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here, I have a delivery I need to make to Calcelmo. Why don't you take it to him? He knows the history of Markarth better than anyone.
plugin.target: 拿去，我這有東西要送給卡塞莫。不如你幫我拿去給他吧？他比任何人都瞭解馬卡斯城的歷史。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: May I see the staff?
plugin.target: 我能看看法杖嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In fact, keep it. I must have used up the magic in the staff or something. It's just a dumb stick of wood now.
plugin.target: 收下它吧。這根法杖上的魔法已經被我用光了。現在它只不過是根破木棍。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: See, my grandfather was a wizard. My father wouldn't talk about him much. But I found some of his things in the attic. Including this staff.
plugin.target: 看，我祖父就是個法師。我父親很少提起他，但我在閣樓找到了些東西，包括這根法杖。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After that I thought I was turning into a wizard too... because dead things near me would come to life again for a while.
plugin.target: 在那之後，我想我應該也要當個法師，因為在我周圍死去的生物總會復活一陣子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I even went to the College of Winterhold. But they just laughed at me. The magic is in the staff, not in me they said.
plugin.target: 我甚至去了冬堡的學院。但他們笑話我，他們說法力是從法杖裡來的，不是我本身的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's quite a staff you have there.
plugin.target: 你手裡的法杖還真不錯呀。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I used to think so too.
plugin.target: 我也曾這麼想。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's the problem?
plugin.target: 出了什麼問題？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh... hello there. I didn't notice you come up. I was focusing my magicka.
plugin.target: 哦……你好。我沒看見你來了。我正專注於我的魔法呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Or at least, I thought I was. I don't really know what I'm doing.
plugin.target: 至少我認為我是的。我不是很確定自己正在做什麼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're going back where you belong, Dremora.
plugin.target: 你該回屬於你的地方了，魔人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where I belong is back aboard my ship, on the Abecean.
plugin.target: 屬於我的地方是我停船的地方，在阿貝希恩。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've no hope of defeating me, pup. Don't bother. Why not broker a bargain instead?
plugin.target: 你不可能打敗我的，別費勁了。我們不如做個交易？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I do. Now and forever.
plugin.target: 我願意，天長地久。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Under the authority of Mara, the Divine of Love, I declare this couple to be wed.
plugin.target: 在瑪拉和聖靈的見證下，我宣佈這對情侶結為夫婦。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I present the two of you with these matching rings, blessed by Mara's divine grace. May they protect each of you in your new life together.
plugin.target: 我贈給你們這對帶有瑪拉神聖賜福的對戒，願它們在你們的新生活中保佑你們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I made a mistake. I want to go ahead with the ceremony.
plugin.target: 我犯了個錯誤，我還是想舉行結婚儀式。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, I think your betrothed might feel otherwise. The two of you will need to work this out before the temple will marry you.
plugin.target: 但我覺得你的另一半會感覺很糟。你們兩個得在神殿進行婚禮之前協調好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's our wedding day. I feel like all of Skyrim is focused on just the two of us.
plugin.target: 這是我們結婚的日子，我感覺整個天際都看著我們倆。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This is a fine wedding. And to think, it's for us.
plugin.target: 這是個不錯的婚禮，想想，這是為我們而舉行的呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This ceremony is so different from an Orc marriage. Less blood.
plugin.target: 這儀式跟獸人的婚禮完全不同，少了許多血腥呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I never would have dreamed I would be getting married in the Temple of Mara.
plugin.target: 我做夢都沒想過我會在瑪拉神殿舉行婚禮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Weddings always make me cry. What am I supposed to do now that I'm the one getting married?
plugin.target: 婚禮總讓我感動落淚，現在我是那個要結婚的人，我該怎麼做呢？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's a simple ceremony, but it'll do. You're here. That's enough.
plugin.target: 儀式很簡單，你在這裡，就夠了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who would have thought I would be getting married?
plugin.target: 我到底是為什麼要結婚啊？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How could you? Just go.
plugin.target: 你怎麼能這麼想？快去吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't want to see you ever again.
plugin.target: 沒想到會再次遇到你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Get away from me. Liar!
plugin.target: 快離我遠點，騙子！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You should leave. Now.
plugin.target: 你該滾了，馬上。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Get out. Leave me alone!
plugin.target: 出去，離我遠點！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're abandoning me? Me? I never want to see you ever again.
plugin.target: 你把我甩了？把我甩了？我以後再也不想見到你了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Get out of my sight.
plugin.target: 滾出我的視線。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Get out.
plugin.target: 出去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What? Why did you do that?
plugin.target: 為什麼……你為什麼那麼做？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This is great! I almost can't believe it.
plugin.target: 這太棒了！我簡直不敢相信！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Congratulations on your wedding. I'm so happy for both of you.
plugin.target: 恭喜你們結婚了。我真為你們倆高興。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Just leave.
plugin.target: 快點離開。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Laelette! She's dead!
plugin.target: 拉萊特！她死了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ysmir's beard! She's... she's a vampire!
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾的鬍子！她……她是一個吸血鬼！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why should I trust you or your order?
plugin.target: 我為什麼要相信你或者你的修會？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I presume you refer to Ancano's distaste for the Psijic Order?
plugin.target: 我想你是在指安卡諾對賽伊克修會的厭惡？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Thalmor see our order as a threat because we have power, and we will not allow them to control us.
plugin.target: 由於我們強大的力量，使得梭預設為我們修會是一個威脅。但我們是不會讓他們控制我們的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I assure you that we mean you no harm.
plugin.target: 我保證我們不會傷害你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I fear I have already overstepped the bounds of my order, but I will offer this: seek out the Augur of Dunlain here in your college.
plugin.target: 我可能已經超出了修會的規定，但是我建議：在你的學院裡找到占卜師杜蘭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: His perception may be more coherent than ours.
plugin.target: 他的看法可能比我們的更清晰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What do you expect from me, then?
plugin.target: 那你想要我做什麼呢？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We believe that your efforts should be directed towards dealing with the aftermath, but we cannot predict what that will be.
plugin.target: 我們相信你應該在一件大事中大有作為，但是我們不知道那會是什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So what exactly is the problem?
plugin.target: 那麼到底有什麼問題？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As you may have learned, this object... the Eye... is immensely powerful.
plugin.target: 你可能已經知道了，這個物體……眼睛……擁有無窮的力量。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The world is not ready for it. If it remains here, it will be misused.
plugin.target: 這個世界還沒有準備好迎接它。如果它繼續留在這，將會被人誤用。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Indeed, many in the Order believe it has already... Rather, something will happen soon, something that cannot be avoided.
plugin.target: 事實上，教團的許多人相信它已經……確切的說，有事情即將發生，且無法避免。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You must understand, the Psijic Order does not typically... intervene directly in events.
plugin.target: 你必須明白，賽伊克教團不會直接……干預這世上的事務。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My presence here will be seen as an affront to some within the Order. As soon as we have finished, I will be leaving your college.
plugin.target: 我來這將被修會的某些人視為一種冒犯，當事情結束後，我將離開你們的學院。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm all too aware that my arrival has aroused suspicion, especially in Ancano, your Thalmor associate.
plugin.target: 我發現我的到來引起了懷疑，特別是安卡諾，你的梭默同事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nevertheless, my order will not act directly. You must take it upon yourself to do so.
plugin.target: 總之，我的教團不會直接干預此事。你必須獨自揹負這個任務。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What did you do?
plugin.target: 你做了什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've given us a chance to speak privately, but I'm afraid I can't do this for long. We must be brief.
plugin.target: 我製造了一個讓我們私下談話的機會，但是恐怕不能一直保持這樣。我們必須長話短說。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The situation here at your college is of dire importance, and attempts to contact you as we have previously have failed.
plugin.target: 你的學院面臨極度重要的問題，而且我們無法再像之前那樣跟你聯絡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I believe it is due to the very source of our concern. This object... The Eye of Magnus as your people have taken to calling it.
plugin.target: 我相信這正是因為我們所擔心的那個物體……你們稱作瑪格努斯之眼的東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The energy coming from it has prevented us from reaching you with the visions you have already seen.
plugin.target: 從它之中釋放的能量阻止我們通過你現在看到的景象聯絡你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The longer it remains here, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And so I have come here personally to tell you it must be dealt with.
plugin.target: 它在這裡待的越久，形勢就變的越危險。所以我獨自來這告訴你這個物體必須要被處理掉。
