plugin.source: Why the feud with Clan Gray-Mane?
plugin.target: 為什麼你們和灰鬃氏族不和？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Money, you laggard! What else? It always comes down to coin.
plugin.target: 因為錢，鄉巴佬。還能是什麼？不都是因為錢嘛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Gray-Manes have deep roots in Whiterun, but so do we. Difference is, we're rich... and Vignar hates it.
plugin.target: 灰鬃在白漫城根基很深，我們也一樣。不同之處在於我們有錢，而維吉納忌諱這一點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, and they hate it too. All their big talk of pride and honor. What have they got to show for it? Beggar's rags and stale bread.
plugin.target: 噢，當然他們對此也表示不屑，他們高談闊論關於忠誠與自尊的話題，然而他們所展現出來的呢？除了乞丐般的破衣服就是發黴的麵包了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've got the same pride, the same honor, and we've got wealth. No wonder they envy us.
plugin.target: 我們得到了同等的尊重，同等的忠誠，同時我們還兼有財富，也難怪他們會憎恨我們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What about Clan Gray-Mane?
plugin.target: 灰鬃氏族是什麼樣的一群人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Uncivilized, pelt-wearing axe-draggers. It's a wonder they don't still live in a cave like those ancestors they keep boasting about.
plugin.target: 一群野蠻的、披著毛皮、拿著斧頭的野人。奇怪的是，他們沒有像他們所誇口的那樣追隨祖先住在洞穴裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's true. Vignar Gray-Mane and his lot are one of Whiterun's oldest and, depending on who you ask, most respected clans. I don't dispute that.
plugin.target: 維吉納·灰鬃和他的人是白漫城中的老資歷沒錯，也是得到大部分人敬重的氏族。對此我不予置評。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But it's one thing to take pride in your lineage, and another to cling blindly to the past. What they call honor and tradition, I call ignorance.
plugin.target: 但為你的血脈傳統自豪是一回事，盲目沉湎在昔日的榮耀中不能自拔又是另外一回事。他們所提到的榮耀與傳統，要我說就是愚昧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about Clan Battle-Born.
plugin.target: 告訴我有關戰狂氏族的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Battle-Born is a name out of legend, sung in the songs of old and heard in deeds of valor for a hundred generations.
plugin.target: 戰狂是個傳說中的名字，這個名字和那些英勇的事蹟數百年來被人們以古老的歌謠所傳頌。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: "For Clan Battle-Born!" they cry in the mead halls. "First into the fray and last to quit their ale!"
plugin.target: 他們在蜜酒大廳中高呼“為了戰狂”、“出征時第一個上陣，拼酒時最後一個醉倒”之類的口號。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've got honor. Wealth and titles too. Aye, and buxom women to warm your bed on a cold Skyrim night.
plugin.target: 我們得到了太多的榮耀、財富和名聲。當然，還有體態豐滿的女人，在寒冷的夜裡為你暖床。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now if that don't answer your question, then no words will.
plugin.target: 如果你還有疑問的話，那就恕我無法解答了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Back on its feet?
plugin.target: 重現榮光？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look around you. The Flagon, the Guild... it's all fallin' apart.
plugin.target: 你看看，漏壺，盜賊公會……都四分五裂了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A few decades ago, this place was as busy as the Imperial City. Now, you'll be lucky if you don't trip over a skeever instead.
plugin.target: 數十年前，這地方就如同帝都一樣繁華。現在，如果你沒有被惡鼠絆倒過都算是幸運的了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Brynjolf pointed me your way.
plugin.target: 布林喬夫要我來找你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Brynjolf, eh? Lemme guess. He plucked you off the street and dropped you into the thick of things without tellin' you which way is up. Am I right?
plugin.target: 布林喬夫，是吧？讓我猜猜，他把你從街上叫過來然後交給你一堆毫無頭緒的事情去處理，對吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Any idea why?
plugin.target: 知道是什麼原因嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who knows. Old Delvin thinks it's some kind of a curse. I think he's crazy.
plugin.target: 誰知道呢，老戴爾文認為那是某種詛咒，而我覺得他瘋了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you want my opinion, I'd say it's just plain old bad luck.
plugin.target: 在我看來，只是單純的走黴運而已。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Brynjolf said I should speak to you.
plugin.target: 布林喬夫說過我該跟你談談的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Before we begin, I want to make two things perfectly clear.
plugin.target: 在我們開始之前，我得先弄清楚兩件事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One, I'm the best infiltrator this rathole of a Guild's got, so if you think you're here to replace me, you're dead wrong.
plugin.target: 第一，我是盜賊公會在這個鼠洞裡最好的潛行者，所以如果你覺得可以取代我，那可是大錯特錯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And two, you follow my lead and do exactly as I say... no questions, no excuses.
plugin.target: 第二，你跟隨我的領導並且照我說的去做，別提問，也不要辯解。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You play well.
plugin.target: 你演奏得很好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you. I'm still at the beginning of my lessons but Inge... Dean Six Fingers... says I'm quite good with the flute.
plugin.target: 謝謝。我還只是個新手。但因格……“六指”因格院長……他說長笛也很適合我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You seem proud to be a bard.
plugin.target: 你看起來很以詩人為榮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And why wouldn't I be? We sing tales of kings, queens, and their politics, 'tis true. But do you know who really makes history?
plugin.target: 為什麼不呢？我們傳頌國王與皇后的傳說和政績。但你知道誰才是歷史的見證者嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The person who writes it.
plugin.target: 就是寫下歷史的那個人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But you're talking right now.
plugin.target: 你不是說了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I shouldn't be. Mama says if I do, people are going to ask about Uncle Roggvir.
plugin.target: 我不該說。媽媽說如果我說了，人們會開始問起羅吉維爾叔叔的事情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Maybe if I don't talk, they won't either.
plugin.target: 也許我不說，他們就不會過問了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I shouldn't be. Everyone wants to ask me about Mama and Uncle Roggvir.
plugin.target: 我不該說。每個人都想問我媽媽和羅吉維爾叔叔的事情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Maybe if I don't talk, they won't either.
plugin.target: 也許我不說，他們就不會過問了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're a long way from home, then.
plugin.target: 看來你離家很遠了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Aye, but I'll be here in Solitude for longer still. Fihada's skill as a fletcher drew me to this place. I wanted to learn.
plugin.target: 是的，但我會繼續在獨孤城待下去的。費哈達的造箭技巧吸引我來到了這裡，而我想學習這技巧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And there is still much of Skyrim I wish to see. I hear there is a city, Wind-Helm, that is nearly white with... What do you call it? Ah yeah! Snow.
plugin.target: 而且我仍然想看看更多在天際的景觀。我聽說這裡有座城市，風舵城，那裡幾乎覆蓋著白色的……你怎麼說來著，對了，白雪！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And far to the west lies a ruin. Volskygge. Inside, there is said to be a wall, black as night. And it speaks! In the ancient Dragon tongue!
plugin.target: 而往西走遠一點有一處遺蹟，叫恐懼暗影，那裡面有一堵漆黑如夜的牆，不可思議的是，它會用遠古巨龍語說話！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There are wonders in this place I never dreamed imaginable.
plugin.target: 這個地方有太多令我意想不到的驚喜了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So Erikur is your brother?
plugin.target: 那麼艾瑞庫爾是你的兄弟？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes. My older brother. He was a bit of a fop, really.
plugin.target: 是啊，我的哥哥，他只是有那麼一點高傲而已，真的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And truth be told, since Torygg's death, he had no real power in the court. But still... he didn't deserve to die.
plugin.target: 而且說實話，自從託依格死後，他在宮廷裡就沒什麼實權了。但是……那也不表示他得死啊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So Erikur was your brother?
plugin.target: 那麼艾瑞庫爾是你的兄弟？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes. I think your brother was a traitor.
plugin.target: 是的，我認為你的兄弟是個叛徒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then you didn't know Roggvir, and you have no idea what it means to be a Nord of Skyrim!
plugin.target: 看來你不瞭解羅吉維爾，你不知道這對天際的諾德意味著什麼！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He did the honorable thing, even when he knew it would cost him everything.
plugin.target: 他做了件高貴的事，即使他知道那會讓他一無所有。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My brother was the best man in Solitude.
plugin.target: 我兄弟是獨孤城最好的人了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Apples, tomatoes, leeks, and cabbages! Fresh and ripe!
plugin.target: 新鮮熟透的蘋果、番茄、韭蔥還有捲心菜！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Fresh fish! Straight from the fjords!
plugin.target: 新鮮的魚，從海灣剛剛運來的！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Keep the cold at bay with our Spiced Wine!
plugin.target: 香料酒，使你遠離寒冷侵襲。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Spiced Wine, the taste of home and hearth!
plugin.target: 香料酒，居家暖爐邊的最佳選擇！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You won't get anything out of me, you filthy sons o' horkers.
plugin.target: 你從我這裡什麼也得不到，你這骯髒的長牙野種。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I stand with the Stormcloaks. You Imperial dogs will never break my will. Never!
plugin.target: 風暴斗篷與我同在。你這帝國狗將永遠無法摧毀我的希望。永遠也不！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: May knowledge of your divinity carry us through our daily trials.
plugin.target: 願你的神聖學識幫助我們度過每日的試煉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't you have trouble getting ripe goods here?
plugin.target: 你把這些貨物運過來難道沒遇過一些麻煩嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have my ways, but it's not easy these days.
plugin.target: 我有我的方法，不過這段時間大家的日子都不好過。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Blackblood Marauders have been plundering ships off the coast. A lot of people been hurt by their foolishness.
plugin.target: 黑血掠奪者在海上搶了不少船。好多人都因他們的胡鬧而受傷了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's been easier lately.
plugin.target: 最近要稍微緩和一些了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Blackblood Marauders haven't been here since the Icerunner attack, so my shipments have been more regular.
plugin.target: 在針對寒冰疾馳者的攻擊以後，就再沒人見過黑血掠奪者，所以我的貿易旅程更加有規律了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How are your sales?
plugin.target: 你的生意如何？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, very brisk. When the snow sets in, even the hardiest Nord needs some Spiced Wine to warm the blood.
plugin.target: 噢，相當不錯。特別是降雪開始後，即便是最強韌的諾德人也要依賴香料葡萄酒暖身。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you get a lot of business like that?
plugin.target: 你這樣子會有生意上門嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's never been an issue. People say you helped with the problems at Wolfskull Cave.
plugin.target: 那不成問題。有人說你幫忙解決了狼頭骨洞穴的麻煩。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I applaud anyone who assists the court.
plugin.target: 我喜歡那些為宮廷服務的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Radiant Raiment has the finest attire in all of Skyrim. That is how we...
plugin.target: 錦衣服飾店有著全天際最好的衣服，這就是我們如何……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Wait. You're that new bard. The one who saved the festival, aren't you?
plugin.target: 等等，你是那個新來的詩人，那個挽救了整個慶典的人，對嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That was a good bit of work.
plugin.target: 做得好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I suppose I would, but you're the only one who gets that greeting.
plugin.target: 是啊，但你是唯一一個享受到如此待遇的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're pretty dedicated to the Empire, then?
plugin.target: 你對帝國很忠心，是嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah... to be honest, no. But High King Torygg supported them, and now her lady Elisif has thrown in with them.
plugin.target: 啊……說實話，不是的，但至高王託依格支援他們，現在他的夫人艾利西弗也繼續堅持他的選擇。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You could say I'm a king's man at heart. Hmph. I guess that's "Jarl's man" now.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Did I see you arguing with someone?
plugin.target: 我看到你和別人在爭吵？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skald supports Ulfric's rebellion, and he doesn't like having a couple of old Legionnaires living in his town.
plugin.target: 斯卡德支援烏弗瑞克的叛變，而且他不想讓那些老軍團士兵住在他的鎮上。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He's a fool. A dragon has attacked Helgen. Dawnstar needs the Empire now more than ever.
plugin.target: 他是個蠢貨。一頭龍已經攻擊了聖地鎮。晨星比任何時候都更需要帝國的幫助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Give 'em the dogs, boys!
plugin.target: 放狗，小子們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How does Azura's Star work?
plugin.target: 阿祖拉之星如何運作？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I mentioned how the Star is a soul gem, only it never gets depleted. There's another rule the artifact follows.
plugin.target: 我說過阿祖拉之星是一個靈魂石，只是它永遠不會枯竭。這個神器運作時還遵循一項法則。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You can only store white souls in the Star, belonging to the lesser creatures. Azura's magic won't allow black souls to enter it.
plugin.target: 你只能在其中儲存白色的靈魂，即次級生物的靈魂。阿祖拉的魔法禁止黑色靈魂的進入。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As a mortal, Malyn's soul was black, so part of his work was breaking past Azura's rules. He was close before... well, I already told you.
plugin.target: 身為凡人，馬林的靈魂是黑色的，所以他的研究打破了阿祖拉的部分規則。他已經很接近目的了，但隨後發生的事……你知道的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How did the daedra drive Malyn insane?
plugin.target: 魔族是怎麼逼瘋馬林的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Azura is no ordinary daedra. She commands an entire realm inside of Oblivion. The more Malyn worked on the Star, the more she was able to damn him.
plugin.target: 阿祖拉不是一般的魔族，她控制著湮滅中某個領域。馬林對阿祖拉之星的研究越是深入，就越可能受到阿祖拉的詛咒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It started slowly at first. Malyn would see things that weren't there. Then he would yell at students over words they hadn't said.
plugin.target: 詛咒是漸漸發展的，一開始馬林會出現幻覺，然後他又因為幻聽而斥責他的學生。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then one day I walked in and Malyn had... killed a student, and in a horrific moment of inspiration, he started using her soul for his work.
plugin.target: 之後有一天我走進房間發現馬林已經……將一位學生殺死，然後突發奇想，開始用她的靈魂進行研究。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm looking for an Elven mage who studies stars.
plugin.target: 我在找一個研究星象的精靈法師。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What is it? What happened?
plugin.target: 怎麼了？發生什麼事了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There was an... unfortunate incident a few years ago. An Elven mage named Nelacar was exiled from the College over it.
plugin.target: 幾年前……發生了一件不幸的事，一位叫做內拉卡的精靈法師因此被逐出學院。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He's still in town, getting by plying spells to the people inside the Frozen Hearth. Disgraceful.
plugin.target: 他還在城裡，給凍爐旅店的居民表演戲法以維持生計。真丟臉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It was a few years ago. A few of the mages got overconfident and were exiled. They had no talent, anyway.
plugin.target: 那是幾年前的故事了。有幾個自大的法師被流放了。其實他們根本沒有什麼天賦。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I hear one of them, Nelacar, still hangs around the Frozen Hearth. Guess he has nowhere else to go, poor thing.
plugin.target: 其中之一，內拉卡，還是經常去凍爐旅店。我想他沒有其他的地方可去了，可憐的傢伙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, no, I'm not falling for that one again. Next thing you know, I'm getting yelled at for saying something inappropriate.
plugin.target: 噢，不，我不會再上當的。我不會再因為閒言碎語而被罵了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're so curious, talk to Nelacar, in the Frozen Hearth. He can tell you the whole sad story.
plugin.target: 如果你這麼好奇，去跟凍爐旅店的內拉卡談。他能告訴你這場悲劇的來龍去脈。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: "Dimwits"? What happened?
plugin.target: “傻瓜”？怎麼了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is there an Elven mage here that studies stars?
plugin.target: 這有個研究星星的精靈法師嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The mages are up in the College. You can ask them, if they'll let you in.
plugin.target: 法師都在學院裡。你可以問他們，如果他們讓你進去的話。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then again, Nelacar might know. He's an old-timer from the College, but he has a room here.
plugin.target: 這也是一樣，內拉卡或許知道。他是學院的老前輩，但是他在這有個房間。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Did you say an "elf" and "stars"? I hope you don't know what you're asking.
plugin.target: 你是說一個“精靈”和“星星”？我勸你別多管閒事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: "An elf that studies stars?" Where did you hear about that?
plugin.target: “一個研究星星的精靈”？你從哪聽到這個的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Studies stars you say? Why, there hasn't been a mage doing anything related to stars since... Oh...
plugin.target: 研究星星？這種事很久沒人做了，自從……噢……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why specifically stars? Wait, you aren't referring to... No, there's no way you would know about that.
plugin.target: 為什麼非要星星？等等，難道你是指……不，你不可能知道的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I know plenty of spells that produce light, but stars? Hmm. There was that problem a few years ago, but that couldn't be related.
plugin.target: 我知道許多能產生光明的法術，但是星星？嗯，幾年前出過這種事，但跟這無關。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Stars? You wouldn't be referring to that incident a few years ago? I still say that exile was far too harsh.
plugin.target: 星象？你不會是在說幾年前的那件事吧？我還是認為那次驅逐過於嚴厲。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why would anyone bother to study stars? Well, unless you're talking about that artifact that got all those... dimwits thrown out.
plugin.target: 為什麼會有人想去研究星星？嗯，除非你是在說那個東西……一群傻瓜因為它被趕了出去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Studies stars? I remember the last time the word "stars" was flown through the Hall of the Elements. Bad things had happened.
plugin.target: 研究星星？我記得上次聽到“星星”是在元素大廳。當時發生了很不好的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then let's get to it.
plugin.target: 那麼我們開始吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've been poring over the plans you brought us, and I'm convinced the Eyes of the Falmer are in the Dwarven ruins at Irkngthand.
plugin.target: 我一直在研究你帶回來的計劃，而且我相信伐莫之眼在苦悶之牙廢墟的矮人遺蹟裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Karliah and I will meet you there. Prepare yourself, lad. This will be a fight to remember!
plugin.target: 卡莉亞和我會在那和你碰面。做好準備，小夥子。這場仗將值得紀念。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've been poring over the plans you brought us, and I'm convinced the Eyes of the Falmer are in the Dwarven ruins at Irkngthand.
plugin.target: 我一直在研究你帶回來的計劃，而且我相信伐莫之眼在苦悶之牙廢墟的矮人遺蹟裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Karliah and I will meet you there. Prepare yourself, lass. This will be a fight to remember!
plugin.target: 卡莉亞和我會在那和你碰面。做好準備，小夥子。這場仗將值得紀念。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why tell this to me?
plugin.target: 為什麼要跟我說這個？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Karliah and I had a long discussion before you arrived here.
plugin.target: 卡莉亞和我在你來之前討論了很久。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thanks to your efforts, the Guild's been restored to its full strength and you've exposed the traitor in our midst.
plugin.target: 由於你的幫助，公會恢復了它的全部力量，而且你還揭發了我們中的叛徒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As a result, we both feel that you'd make an excellent replacement for Mercer as leader of the Thieves Guild.
plugin.target: 因此，你取代墨瑟成為盜賊公會的領袖是眾望所歸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: These fissures and cracks aren't encouraging. Malyn obviously was growing more desperate once he left the College.
plugin.target: 這些裂谷和縫隙看起來不太樂觀。馬林在離開學院後一定選擇了更偏激的作法。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you work here all day?
plugin.target: 你整天都在這工作嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes. Ever since my mother died a few winters ago. I play songs and help with the drinks when I have the time.
plugin.target: 是的，我母親在幾年前死了。我有空的時候就唱唱歌，給酒館幫幫忙什麼的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you the court wizard?
plugin.target: 你是宮廷法師嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you could call it that. The Jarl can make all the demands in the world, I'm not setting one foot on that battlefield.
plugin.target: 如果你想這麼叫的話。不管領主提出那些要求，但我都不想再踏上戰場。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I fought in the Great War. I cut enough young lives short, I'm not going to do it again.
plugin.target: 我曾參與浩大戰爭，奪走了許多年輕的生命，我不想再這麼做了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire created the Forsworn? How?
plugin.target: 帝國創造了棄誓者？怎麼回事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Through neglect. During the Great War, they let the unwashed natives retake The Reach and declare their own sovereignty.
plugin.target: 由於疏忽。在浩大戰爭中，他們讓骯髒的當地人重新奪回邊塞領並宣稱了對其的統治權。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Stormcloaks were forced to retake The Reach on our own, but that taste of independence emboldened them. And the Forsworn were born.
plugin.target: 風暴斗篷被迫靠我們自己的力量去重新奪回邊塞領，但是自由的感覺讓他們更加勇敢，於是棄誓者誕生了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In the end, we took back Markarth, but those damn Forsworn still stalk the hills and roads, looking for revenge.
plugin.target: 最後，我們奪回了馬卡斯城，但是那些可惡的棄誓者仍然潛伏在山丘和道路上，找尋復仇的機會。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's your position on the war?
plugin.target: 你在這場戰爭中持什麼立場？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Imperials were weak. They created this Forsworn problem, but now that we're in charge we'll solve it.
plugin.target: 那些帝國士兵很軟弱，他們引發了棄誓者這些麻煩，既然現在由我們負責，我們就會解決這麻煩。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Once the war is over, I'll petition Ulfric to send the militia and we'll cleanse The Reach of this menace.
plugin.target: 一旦戰爭結束了，我將請求烏弗瑞克派兵前來淨化邊塞領。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then the Forsworn will be where they belong. In the mines, bringing us wealth.
plugin.target: 然後那些棄誓者將回到屬於他們的地方。在礦洞裡，幫我們製造財富。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire lost The Reach before? How?
plugin.target: 帝國曾經失去過邊塞領？怎麼回事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When the Aldmeri Dominion invaded the Imperial City, the Legion all but turned a blind eye to the other provinces.
plugin.target: 當先祖神洲入侵帝都時，軍團完全沒空顧及其他領地。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Many of the disgruntled natives of The Reach used the opportunity to depose the Empire, and founded what they called an independent kingdom.
plugin.target: 許多心存不滿的邊塞領當地人把握住這個機會，廢除了帝國的統治，並且建立了他們所說的獨立王國。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It was little more than a chaotic uprising, but The Reach was removed from Imperial authority for two years before we reclaimed it.
plugin.target: 這就和混亂的暴動差不多，但是邊塞領仍然獨立了兩年，然後帝國才採取收復行動。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But the leaders of the uprising refused our offers of peace. They fled into the hills and became the Forsworn.
plugin.target: 然而暴動的領導者拒絕了我們和平的提議。他們逃進山嶺並且成為了棄誓者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Has the war been hard on Markarth?
plugin.target: 馬卡斯城曾歷經了一場苦戰嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It all started here. This rebellion. When the Empire lost The Reach during the Great War, we became desperate.
plugin.target: 這城市是這場叛亂的開端。當帝國在浩大戰爭中失去邊塞領時，我們只能冒險嘗試別的方法。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We promised a group of Nord militia free worship in exchange for their help retaking the hold. Then the elves found out about it.
plugin.target: 我們向一些諾德軍隊做出承諾，給予他們崇拜塔洛斯的自由，以此作為幫助我們奪回領地的條件。然後精靈們發現了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We were forced to arrest all of them. Ulfric Stormcloak, their leader, used the whole thing as proof that the Empire had abandoned Skyrim.
plugin.target: 我們被迫逮捕他們所有人。烏弗瑞克·風暴斗篷，他們的領導者，把這件事當做帝國背棄天際的證據。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The rebels called it "The Markarth Incident." It was the founding day for the Stormcloaks, and where this war really started.
plugin.target: 叛軍稱之為“馬卡斯城事件”。它是風暴斗篷的誕生之日，也是這場戰爭真正的開端。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Dare I ask where all this meat comes from?
plugin.target: 我可以問你這些肉是從哪來的嗎？

plugin.source: Malyn wanted to alter the Star. He was dying. Disease. He thought he could store his own soul inside. Become immortal.
plugin.target: 馬林因疾病瀕死，他想改變那顆星的功能，注入自己的靈魂以達成不朽。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It drove him mad. Students started dying. Eventually, the College exiled him. He took a few loyal disciples to Ilinalta's Deep and vanished.
plugin.target: 這讓他陷入瘋狂。學生們接連死亡。最後，學院驅逐了他。他帶上幾個忠實的弟子去了伊琳娜塔深淵，自此銷聲匿跡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look, I don't care who asked you to find the Star, but don't take it back to Azura. The daedra are evil. They're the reason Malyn went insane.
plugin.target: 聽好，我不在乎是誰要你去找阿祖拉之星的，但是不要把它帶回給阿祖拉。魔族是邪惡的。他們是導致馬林發瘋的罪魁禍首。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Easy there. The numbness will pass. Just don't strain yourself.
plugin.target: 放鬆。麻木的感覺很快會過去，別緊張。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've done it. The Star has been cut off from Azura, and Malyn's soul finally has some measure of peace, even if it is non-existence.
plugin.target: 我們成功了。這顆星石已經脫離了阿祖拉的控制，馬林的靈魂最終得到了些許平靜，雖然這平靜來自於虛無中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, that all depends on you now. Doesn't it?
plugin.target: 這個嘛現在要取決於你了，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you always drunk?
plugin.target: 你總是這麼醉醺醺的嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What can I expect in return for my help?
plugin.target: 我幫了你能得到什麼好處？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My family is everything to me. Clear the fort and on top of the posted reward, you can have whatever items you'd like.
plugin.target: 家人是我的一切。清除堡壘裡的敵人，你可以在懸賞的報酬之外再拿走你喜歡的任何東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you have a plan?
plugin.target: 你有計劃嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The front gate is locked, so you'll need to use the mine entrance behind us. Open the front gate and we'll try and give you some support.
plugin.target: 正門被鎖上了，你得從我們後方的礦場進去。把正門開啟，我們會給你力所能及的支援。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sounds like more than just "bad blood."
plugin.target: 好像不僅僅是“積怨”這麼簡單吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You ask a lot of questions for a mercenary. Just get in there and open the gate. We'll try and provide help once that's done.
plugin.target: 作為一個傭兵你問得太多了。你只要進去開啟門就行了，在那之後我們會盡量給你提供援助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I suspect Brurid planned this. There's been bad blood between us since the king's death.
plugin.target: 我懷疑是布魯瑞在背後操作這件事，在國王死後我們之間積怨已久。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But to invade my home, kidnap my family...
plugin.target: 但是闖進我的家，綁架我的家人……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm the best.
plugin.target: 我是最棒的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good, the place is crawling with bandits. We lost some good men trying to take it earlier.
plugin.target: 很好，那地方到處是土匪。先前我們派人去平定時損失了不少得力悍將。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's your problem?
plugin.target: 你遇到什麼問題了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nothing. I'm busy, and I don't like being bothered unless I'm expecting something from you.
plugin.target: 沒事。我很忙，我不喜歡被打擾，除非你對我有利用價值。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, don't give me that look. Fine. I suppose I can find some menial task to set your mind on. Hmm...
plugin.target: 噢，別用那種眼神看我。好吧。我想我可以找一些差事讓你有事可做。嗯……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We have something of a vampire problem. Bodies have been found with blood drained. I know of a den nearby you can wipe out as a precaution.
plugin.target: 我們有個關於吸血鬼的任務。有人發現了被吸乾血的屍體。我知道附近有個巢穴，你可以先去清空它作為熱身。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're the Jarl? I'm looking for work.
plugin.target: 你是領主？我在找工作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Winterhold has lost much of its history, and with that much of its power. I aim to change that.
plugin.target: 冬堡遺失了很多歷史，也失去了與那等同的國力。我立志要改變這種狀況。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've heard rumors of the resting place of the Helm of Winterhold, the very same helm that Jarl Hanse wore in the First Era.
plugin.target: 我聽到了很多關於冬堡之盔下落的傳聞，它就是第一紀元中漢斯領主戴的那個頭盔。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hanse was in line to be High King of Skyrim, you know. Having that might get the ear of the other holds and give me some authority.
plugin.target: 你知道，漢斯是天際至高王之位的順位繼承人之一。有了那個的話，別的領地就有可能會更加尊重我的發言，使我擁有更多影響力。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have the Fine-Cut Void Salts.
plugin.target: 我有精製虛無鹽。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's the first bit of good news I've had since I set sail a year ago.
plugin.target: 這是我出海一年以來聽到的第一個好訊息。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here's your cut.
plugin.target: 這是你的那一份。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened to the salts?
plugin.target: 那些鹽後來怎麼樣了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sailors are what happened to them. They got drunk and ended up losing the merchandise in some cave.
plugin.target: 那些水手弄丟了，他們喝醉，然後把貨弄丟在某個山洞裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're not afraid of a little exploring, I'll pay good gold to get those salts.
plugin.target: 如果你不怕冒險，幫我把貨找回來的話，我會給你一筆不錯的酬勞。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I pursue Alduin, the World-Eater.
plugin.target: 我在追殺奧杜因，世界吞噬者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A fateful errand. No few have chafed to face the Worm since first he set his soul-snare here at Sovngarde's threshold.
plugin.target: 這是宿命之旅。自從它在松加德的門檻處設下靈魂陷阱，很多人都想面對這條大蟲。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But Shor restrained our wrathful onslaught - perhaps, deep-counseled, your doom he foresaw.
plugin.target: 但是朔爾阻止了我們憤怒的襲擊——現在想來，也許他早已預見你的命運。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: From Adrianne?
plugin.target: 從阿德里安那裡？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, this must be that weapon for the Jarl. Poor girl, so eager to prove herself. I'll present it to Balgruuf when his mood is... agreeable.
plugin.target: 啊，這一定就是那把為領主打造的武器。可憐的孩子，這麼急切想證明自己的能力。我會把它呈給巴爾古夫的，在他的心情稍微……平靜一點的時候。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you. Please, take these few coins, for services rendered.
plugin.target: 謝謝你。請拿著這些錢吧，作為你的報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have a sword for you, from your daughter.
plugin.target: 我有一把劍要給你，你女兒託我帶來的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you work the forge all day?
plugin.target: 你整天都在打鐵嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Aye, that I do. I've got to, if I hope to be as good as Eorlund Gray-Mane some day. In fact, I just finished my best piece of work.
plugin.target: 啊，是啊。如果我希望有一天能與厄倫德·灰鬃一樣優秀，那我就只能不斷打鐵。其實，我剛剛完成了我最好的作品。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's a sword. I made it for the Jarl, Balgruuf the Greater. It's a surprise. I don't even know if he'll accept it, but...
plugin.target: 我打了一把劍。是為領主、強者巴爾古夫所特別打造的。不過我沒事先報告這件事，所以不知道他會不會接受。但……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Listen, could you take the sword to my father, Proventus Avenicci? He's the Jarl's Steward. He'll know the right time to present it to him.
plugin.target: 聽著，你能把這把劍帶給我的父親，普羅萬圖斯·阿文奇嗎？他是領主的總管。他一定能在最合適的時間把它呈給領主。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is the College dangerous?
plugin.target: 學院裡危險嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Goodness, no!
plugin.target: 天吶，不！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're simply scholars, they mean no one harm. I've had... several conversations with Arch-Mage Aren over the years.
plugin.target: 他們只是學者，不會危害他人。在這幾年裡我……和首席法師阿冉談過幾次。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, he's perfectly polite, if a bit guarded.
plugin.target: 他顯得彬彬有禮，雖然警戒心強了一點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How did the Oblivion Crisis impact Winterhold?
plugin.target: 冬堡在湮滅危機中受到了什麼影響？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You may have noticed the College, just to the north there. Very prestigious place. Mages from all over Tamriel traveled here to seek knowledge.
plugin.target: 你可能注意到了學院，它就在這裡的北方。一個久負盛名的地方。泰姆瑞爾各地的法師都來這裡尋求知識。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After the Oblivion Crisis was over, many felt that magic users were to blame. Elves, to be specific. It created a great deal of tension.
plugin.target: 湮滅危機結束後，很多人覺得那些使用魔法的人應該受到譴責，其實就是指精靈族。這一度造成了緊張局面。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A good many Dark Elves were driven from the city, and people became... uncomfortable with the presence of the College.
plugin.target: 很多暗精靈從城市裡被趕出去，而且人們開始……對學院反感。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yeah, but raising draugr to take on both the Imperials and the Stormcloaks? That's just crazy.
plugin.target: 是啊，但是召喚屍鬼去跟帝國和風暴斗篷對抗？簡直是瘋了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This must be their hive. We'll have to keep silent if you want to avoid drawing their attention.
plugin.target: 這一定是他們的巢穴，我們最好保持安靜以免被發現。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The only reason he'd do that would be to block pursuit. It must be Mercer.
plugin.target: 那樣做的唯一理由就是堵住追兵。一定是墨瑟做的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We'll have to find another way around.
plugin.target: 我們必須找其他的路繞過去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What did you lose?
plugin.target: 你弄丟了什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My Amulet of Arkay. It's the source of my divine powers and also a sacred badge of office.
plugin.target: 我的阿爾凱護符。它是我的聖潔力量的來源，也是這座大廳的神聖象徵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I misplaced it in the catacombs. I'd look for it, but I have been hearing noises down there. I fear the dead have become... restless.
plugin.target: 我錯把它留在了地下墓穴。我曾試圖找過，但底下似乎傳來某種聲音，恐怕下面的死屍已經……蠢蠢欲動了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Without that amulet, I'm powerless to confront them. Would you be willing to search for it?
plugin.target: 沒了護身符我將無力對抗它們。你能幫我找一下嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Dragons, now, is it? Please, Mother. If you keep on like this everyone in town will think you're crazy.
plugin.target: 現在又變成龍了？拜託啊媽，你老是這樣，大家都以為你瘋了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What? What is it now, Mother?
plugin.target: 什麼？搞什麼啊，媽？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've killed dozens like you. (Persuade)
plugin.target: 你這樣的人我都殺了不知多少了（說服）。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No need to get hasty. I... I was just testing you. You can go on ahead.
plugin.target: 別生氣啊，我……我開玩笑的。你可以走了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let 'em go, Hewnon. All clear.
plugin.target: 沒事了，海農，我們走。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your eminence, my scrying has suggested nothing in the area. Dragon Bridge is under Imperial control. This is likely superstitious nonsense.
plugin.target: 閣下，我的占卜在該地區並未發現任何事，龍橋鎮仍在帝國的控制之下。這應該只是些迷信的鬼話。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have much to thank you for, little one. When you die, I will raise you and you can take your place by my side.
plugin.target: 我必須感謝你，小傢伙。如果你死了我會使你復活，並讓你服侍我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here's the pommel stone of Mehrunes' Razor.
plugin.target: 這是梅魯涅斯利刃的劍柄寶石。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Our master craftsman are nothing compared to the perfection of the daedra. Look how it shines.
plugin.target: 我們的大師級工匠在魔族的完美工藝面前也得甘拜下風，看看它的耀眼光彩。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here's your gold, as promised.
plugin.target: 這是答應給你的報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have the blade shards of Mehrunes' Razor.
plugin.target: 我有梅魯涅斯利刃的刀刃碎片。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look at them. The legendary sharpness of a Daedric weapon. Marvelous.
plugin.target: 看啊，傳說中無比鋒利的魔族武器，太不可思議了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And here's your payment for the shards.
plugin.target: 這是你的報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's this about becoming an Agent of Nocturnal?

plugin.source: I knew when you walked into the Hall of the Dead that you were special.
plugin.target: 當你一踏進亡者之廳時，我就看出你的不同凡響了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And here you are. Champion of Namira. Keeper of her ring. You're everything I hoped you'd be.
plugin.target: 而現在你來到了這裡，娜米拉的勇士和戒指的守護者。你沒有辜負我的重望。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Steady now! They may be uglier than Imperials, but they'll go down just the same.
plugin.target: 鎮定點！也許他們長得比帝國人還醜，但他們一樣都得死。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's done it! Alright, boys, let's get moving. We've got more-
plugin.target: 結束了！好了，夥計們，繼續前進。前面還多著呢……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hmm... that looks like some kind of claw from a statue. I wonder what it's used for?
plugin.target: 嗯……這看起來像是某尊雕像上的爪子。不知道有什麼作用。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Even if one of these pictures tells us where the crown is, I'm betting we're going to have to find a way through that door.
plugin.target: 就算這些畫裡面有關於王冠下落的線索，我們肯定還得想辦法通過那扇門。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hmm... looks like this is as far as the Imperials got.
plugin.target: 嗯，看起來帝國士兵只能走到這裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One thing at a time. We're here for the crown. Any of these carvings show a crown?
plugin.target: 一樣一樣來。我們是來找王冠的。這些雕刻上有沒有畫上王冠？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Steady. A few dusty bonewalkers aren't going to stop us any more than the Imperials could.
plugin.target: 穩住。幾個灰頭土臉的骷髏和帝國士兵一樣，都阻止不了我們前進。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You there, Unblooded. See if you can find another way through. We'll charge in to help as soon as we hear fighting.
plugin.target: 你，菜鳥，看看你能不能找到另一條通路。一開打我們就衝進去幫忙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, you sure about that? Then please, be my guest and go strolling on in there. We'll stay here and watch your back...
plugin.target: 你確定嗎？那好吧，那你進去吧。我們留在這裡掩護你後方……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Not good enough. I'll shake the extra coin out of you if I must. (Intimidate)
plugin.target: 還不夠。如果必要的話我會把錢從你身上抖出來。（威嚇）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hold on, there. I suppose, in the, uh, interest of research I... I can spare a few more coins. Double and a half its value. That's all I can muster.
plugin.target: 你等等。呃……為了研究的話……我可以再付點錢。我會出比這東西價值兩倍半的錢。只能這樣了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think you can do better than that. (Persuade)
plugin.target: 我想你還能付更多。（說服）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well... I suppose important research is worth every coin. All right. You have yourself a deal. How's double and a half its value in trade?
plugin.target: 好吧……我想重要的研究花再多的錢也是值得的。行，成交了。我付多兩倍半的價錢怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm here about the <Alias=Item>.
plugin.target: 我是為了<Alias=Item>而來的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You are? Very good... may I see it?
plugin.target: 是嗎？太好了……能給我看看嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There have been murders in Windhelm?
plugin.target: 最近風舵城發生了好幾起謀殺案？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: None of that matters to me. Until someone takes a Dunmer, I'll let Windhelm deal with its own problems.
plugin.target: 那些都不關我的事。風舵城會自己解決這些問題，除非有人殺了丹莫。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How are the Dark Elves treated in Windhelm?
plugin.target: 風舵城裡暗精靈的待遇如何？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, you see where we have to live. This forgotten alley. All the filth from the upper quarters flows downhill, like they say.
plugin.target: 你自己看看我們住的地方吧。這個被遺忘的巷子。就像他們說的，上方城區什麼汙穢都往山下流。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good luck getting one of the guards to help with anything.
plugin.target: 你想讓某個衛兵幫你忙？祝你好運吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I tried to get Ulfric to even come down here to see the squalor, but the High Lord of His Mightiness couldn't find the time.
plugin.target: 我甚至試過請烏弗瑞克親自下來看看這骯髒的地方，但這位青天大老爺抽不開身。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why are there so many Dark Elves here?
plugin.target: 為什麼這裡有這麼多暗精靈？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are the people of Windhelm devout?
plugin.target: 風舵城的居民虔誠嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Like anyone, a crisis will push them towards devotion. I've been seeing a lot of the Shatter-Shields, since they lost their daughter.
plugin.target: 危機會促使他們變得虔誠，就像任何人一樣。自從他們失去了女兒以後，我已經看到很多碎盾的成員了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hillevi Cruel-Sea comes in a lot, but I haven't seen her husband here in years.
plugin.target: 希勒維·酷海經常過來，但我好幾年沒見過她的丈夫了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ulfric prays for strength. I speak to Captain Lonely-Gale, but he doesn't spend much time here. Too busy.
plugin.target: 烏弗瑞克始終渴望力量。我和孤風船長談過，但他沒辦法花太多心思在這。太忙了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What does Talos have to do with the war?
plugin.target: 塔洛斯和這場戰爭有什麼關係？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire's Elven puppetmasters never cared much for the idea of a human becoming a divine. So the worship of Talos is outlawed.
plugin.target: 帝國的幕後主使——精靈從來都不喜歡一個凡人被尊為神。所以他們宣告禁止崇拜塔洛斯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skyrim doesn't take kindly to being told what to do. And to try and forget Talos, well... they may as well ordered us all to cut off our ears.
plugin.target: 天際的百姓不喜歡聽命於他人，也不喜歡被強迫忘掉塔洛斯，這麼說吧……他們還不如下令我們全部把自己耳朵割掉呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's there to do in the city?
plugin.target: 在城市裡能幹些什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're looking to pass the time, you can give Calixto a few septims and gawk at whatever oddity he's come across lately.
plugin.target: 如果你想消磨時間的話，可以付些錢給卡利斯托，聽點他的最近遇到的奇聞異事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're in need of goods, there's a market. If it's a soft bed and a hot meal you're after, there's Candlehearth Hall.
plugin.target: 如果你想買東西，這裡有一個市集。如果你想要吃頓熱騰騰的飯菜、睡個好覺，可以去燭爐堂旅店。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who are the prominent citizens in Windhelm?
plugin.target: 誰是風舵城裡的名人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There's an author named Adonato staying at the inn. He's published a few works of historical fiction.
plugin.target: 酒館裡住著一位作家，名叫阿多納託。他寫過一些歷史小說。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The clans Shatter-Shield and Cruel-Sea see most of the gold that passes through the city.
plugin.target: 碎盾幫和酷海幫掌管著這座城市大部分的金錢流通。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And obviously you have Ulfric, the Jarl and future High King.
plugin.target: 當然還有領主和未來的至高王烏弗瑞克。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, and that busybody Viola Giordano. She's got her nose in everyone's business, which I guess is one way of being prominent.
plugin.target: 哦，還有那位好事者維尤拉·喬爾丹諾。她誰的閒事都愛管，這也是出名的一個方法吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There's an author named Adonato staying at the inn. He's published a few works of historical fiction.
plugin.target: 酒館裡住著一位作家，名叫阿多納託。他寫過一些歷史小說。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The clans Shatter-Shield and Cruel-Sea see most of the gold that passes through the city.
plugin.target: 碎盾幫和酷海幫掌管著這座城市大部分的金錢流通。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, and that busybody Viola Giordano. She's got her nose in everyone's business, which I guess is one way of being prominent.
plugin.target: 哦，還有那位好事者維尤拉·喬爾丹諾。她誰的閒事都愛管，這也是出名的一個方法吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Folk are talking about murders.
plugin.target: 人們都在談論兇殺案。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Terrible shame, that. Seems we have a killer on the loose here in Windhelm.
plugin.target: 這事可真是丟臉。看來我們風舵城裡藏有一個連環殺手。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He's claimed three victims that I know of, though maybe there's more that haven't been found yet.
plugin.target: 他已經殺了三個我認識的人了，也許還有更多受害者沒被發現。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All lovely ladies too. Let's hope the guards find that demon soon, and introduce him to the headman's axe.
plugin.target: 而且死的都是年輕漂亮的女性。希望那些衛兵能夠快點逮到這個惡魔，送他上斷頭臺。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What kind of captain are you?
plugin.target: 為什麼別人叫你船長？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, nothing. At least not anymore. Folk just call me that because of what I used to do.
plugin.target: 咳，沒什麼。至少現在不是了。人們只是因為我以前是船長才這麼稱呼我的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I was a sailor for many a year. I made my coin as a trader and in time, I bought my own ship.
plugin.target: 我當了很多年的水手。靠做買賣賺錢，過了好一陣子才買了屬於我自己的船。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When I retired here in Windhelm, most folk already knew me as Captain Lonely-Gale, and the name just stuck.
plugin.target: 我退休後在風舵城安頓下來時，大家都知道我叫孤風船長了，所以就一直這麼叫了下來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My men have their orders. But it's a big city, and there's a war on. Plus these murders.
plugin.target: 我的人手絕對奉命行事。但這是座大城市，外面又在打仗，還發生了謀殺案。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A few Dark Elves getting shoved around doesn't really amount to much.
plugin.target: 幾個暗精靈被推來喚去算不了什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That should do. Now - inhale deeply.
plugin.target: 那樣應該行了。現在……深呼吸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Keep your wits about you, and watch your Shield-Brother's back.
plugin.target: 注意保持警惕，掩護你的盾友。.
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Their spies must've found out we know about the crown, and they don't want us to have it. But they won't stand in our way.
plugin.target: 他們的間諜一定發現我們知道王冠這件事了，也一定不想讓我們得到的。不過他們無法阻止我們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Listen up, Legionnaires. Those Stormcloaks are here for the same reason we are.
plugin.target: 聽著，軍團士兵們。那些風暴斗篷和我們是對著同一個東西來的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No! There's got to be more skooma... Shut up! Shut up! Don't lie to me, J'zhar! You hid it! You always try to steal it from me!
plugin.target: 不！肯定還有更多的斯庫瑪……閉嘴！閉嘴！別騙我吉扎爾！你藏起來了！你一直想從我這裡偷走它！ !
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where is it? I know you were trying to keep it for yourself, J'zhar... You always try to keep it for yourself!
plugin.target: 在哪兒？我知道你藏起來了混球……吉扎爾……你一直想佔為己有！ !
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Exactly. Road patrols were cut in half because the Jarl needed soldiers. Now the bandits are bolder than ever.
plugin.target: 完全正確。因為領主急需人手，巡邏的衛兵被削減了一半，所以強盜們現在越來越猖獗了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They've been raiding the farms for food, and supplies are scarcer than ever. Maybe I should sell swords and armor instead.
plugin.target: 他們洗劫農場，掠奪食物，資源比從前都少了。也許我應該改賣武器和防具。.
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you daft? I told you not kill any of them. How much clearer do you need me to be?
plugin.target: 你聾了嗎？我告訴過你千萬不能殺人，要我說多少次？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How about the gold? Did you remember to bring it or was that too difficult an instruction as well?
plugin.target: 錢呢？你記得帶來了嗎？這個命令對你來說很難執行嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My Jarl, is there anything else you need?
plugin.target: 您有什麼要吩咐的嗎，領主？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd like to offer you a place in my court, as a Thane. It's mainly an honorary title, but there are a few perks.
plugin.target: 我想在宮廷賜你一個武衛的地位。雖然只是個榮譽頭銜，不過也有一些好處。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now, by law and tradition, I can only grant this title to one who is known throughout Eastmarch, and who owns property in Windhelm.
plugin.target: 按照法律和傳統，我只能把這個頭銜賜給在東陲聞名遐邇以及在風舵城擁有房產的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you do good works for the people and purchase a home from my Steward, I'll name you my Thane.
plugin.target: 如果你為人民做好事，並從我的管家那裡買一棟房子，我就封你為武衛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm the Jarl's Thane. I demand you let me go at once.
plugin.target: 我是領主手下的武衛，我命令你立刻放了我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Jarl has appointed me to be your Housecarl. It's an honor to serve you.
plugin.target: 領主任命我做你的侍衛，很榮幸為你服務。

plugin.source: There is room in my court for a new Thane. It's an honorary title, mainly, but there are a few perks someone like you could make use of.

plugin.source: By taking back Falkreath, we control access to The Reach, Whiterun, and The Rift. We should never have given it up.
