plugin.source: Would you grant entry to the Dragonborn?
plugin.target: 我是龍裔的話可以進入嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Dragonborn?
plugin.target: 龍裔？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's been so long since we've had any contact with the Greybeards. Do you really have the Voice?
plugin.target: 自從我們失去與灰鬍子的聯絡以後，已經過了很長一段時間了。你真的會龍吼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I would be most impressed to see that.
plugin.target: 我如果能親眼見到會感到非常佩服。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So the Staff of Magnus is in Labyrinthian?
plugin.target: 那麼瑪格努斯之杖就在迷城？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, yes. Probably.
plugin.target: 哦，是的。可能吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I mean, yes. Certainly it is, but that doesn't matter now, because I know you're hoarding something even more important at your college.
plugin.target: 我的意思是，是的。當然是了，但現在已經無所謂了，因為我知道你在學院裡藏了更重要的東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Council will be informed of this. They will find out what you're up to.
plugin.target: 議會會知道這件事。他們會查出你的目的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, mage from Winterhold, despite your intentions I've beaten your little game.
plugin.target: 所以，冬堡的法師，不管你是有意還是無意，我還是比你技高一籌。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Even if all you've said here is lies, I know you have something in Winterhold the Synod Council will be very interested in.
plugin.target: 就算你再怎麼說謊，我也知道你在冬堡有一些希諾學會很感興趣的東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So fine, trudge off to Labyrinthian in search of your staff. I shall return to Cyrodiil and deliver my full report to the Council.
plugin.target: 很好，你要前往迷城找到法杖。我回賽瑞迪爾把完整報告交到議會手中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This is not over, I assure you.
plugin.target: 事情還沒結束，我向你保證。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I would think you'd have more respect for a Nightingale.
plugin.target: 我還以為你會更加尊敬一名夜鶯成員。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A Nightingale? Oh, I had no idea. My apologies.
plugin.target: 一名夜鶯？噢，我不知道你是。我道歉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Whoa, there. Don't you recognize a fellow Guild member?
plugin.target: 哇哦，兄弟。你沒認出公會成員嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Of course! I've seen you at the Flagon. My mistake.
plugin.target: 當然了！我在漏壺見過你。這是我的不對。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do I look like I have any money? (Persuade)
plugin.target: 我看起來像有錢的樣子嗎？（說服）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No, I guess not. Well, get out of here before I change my mind.
plugin.target: 不，我不這麼覺得。好吧，在我改變主意之前離開這裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Walk away. Right now. (Intimidate)
plugin.target: 馬上滾開。（威嚇）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well. I, uh, can see you're not one to be trifled with. Let this be a warning to you!
plugin.target: 哦，我，呃…知道你是個不好惹的人。這次就當作是個警告吧！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd rather die!
plugin.target: 我寧願死！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then I guess that's your last request, fool!
plugin.target: 那就是你最後的請求了，蠢貨！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All right, hand over your valuables, or I'll gut you like a fish.
plugin.target: 好吧，交出你身上值錢的東西，否則我會把你像條魚一樣宰了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hail, Nightingale! Luck has shined down on me and made me a rich man. Here is your cut, as promised.
plugin.target: 你好，夜鶯！今天是我的幸運日，要發大財了。這是我之前答應要給你的那一份。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hail, brother! I saw you walking there and thought you might need this.
plugin.target: 你好，兄弟！我看見你走去那裡，覺得你可能需要這個。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hail, sister! I saw you walking there and thought you could use this.
plugin.target: 你好，姐妹！我看見你走去那裡，覺得你應該用得上這個。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With the threat gone Pelagius is under the delusion that he's safe, which means you've helped him out... sort of. And we're that much closer to home.
plugin.target: 解除了威脅之後，佩拉吉奧斯以為自己安全了，也就是說你幫助了他……某種程度上。而我們也離家更近了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There's that word again, "Nightingale."
plugin.target: 又是這個詞，“夜鶯”。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There were three of us. Myself, Gallus, and Mercer. We were an anonymous splinter of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
plugin.target: 我們三個人。我，加盧斯和墨瑟。我們曾經是裂谷城內盜賊公會的無名小卒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps I'll tell you more about it later. Right now, you need to head for Winterhold with the journal and get the translation.
plugin.target: 也許之後我可以告訴你更多。現在你要帶著日記到冬堡去，找到能翻譯的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here, take these as well, they may prove useful for your journey.
plugin.target: 這些給你，也許在路上能派上用場。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps it could be translated.
plugin.target: 也許有人能翻譯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Enthir... Gallus' friend at the College of Winterhold. Of course...
plugin.target: 恩希爾…加盧斯在冬堡學院的朋友。當然…
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The only outsider Gallus trusted with the knowledge of his Nightingale identity.
plugin.target: 他是唯一一個帶有夜鶯身份，受加盧斯信任的外人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How will you prove it now?
plugin.target: 現在你要怎麼證明？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My purpose in using Snow Veil Sanctum to ambush Mercer wasn't simply for irony's sake.
plugin.target: 我本來想在雪幔聖所來伏擊墨瑟，但諷刺的是，看來沒那麼簡單。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Before both of you arrived, I recovered a journal from Gallus' remains. I suspect the information we need is written inside.
plugin.target: 你們兩個到來之前，我在加盧斯的遺物裡發現一本日記。我懷疑裡面有我們需要的情報。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why capture Mercer alive?
plugin.target: 為什麼要活捉墨瑟？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mercer must be brought before the Guild to answer for what he's done. He needs to pay for Gallus' murder.
plugin.target: 在公會對墨瑟的所作所為採取行動之前，必須把他帶回來。他要為殺死加盧斯付出代價。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened after Gallus died?
plugin.target: 加盧斯死後發生什麼事了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Guild was thrown into disarray. Several stepped up and tried to claim Gallus' former position as Guild Master.
plugin.target: 公會陷入一片混亂。好幾個人站出來想要侵佔加盧斯的公會會長位置。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sides quickly formed behind these men and the Ratway became a bloodbath.
plugin.target: 所有人都立刻選邊站，接著鼠道便血流成河了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't you walk away from me!
plugin.target: 別想那麼容易走掉！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't have time for this.
plugin.target: 我沒時間玩遊戲。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh! Well, in that case, lead on. I'm right behind you.
plugin.target: 噢！那種情況的話，你帶路。我跟在你後面。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm fine. But the Night Mother has another task for me. Let's go.
plugin.target: 我沒事。夜母還有其他工作交給我。走吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Vighar is dead.
plugin.target: 維吉納死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What exactly do you need from me?
plugin.target: 確切的說，你需要我做些什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You may have seen the open grave in our graveyard. Most of the townsfolk think it's the work of a corpse thief.
plugin.target: 你應該都見過我們墓園裡那敞開的墓穴了。多數鎮民都認為那是偷屍賊做的好事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The truth is less pleasant. It is...was, the grave of Vighar, my own ancestor, dead for centuries now.
plugin.target: 真相總是殘酷的。它是…曾是維吉納的墳墓，他是我的祖先，已經死去幾個世紀了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He is also a vampire. My family is entrusted with keeping him buried, but recently someone stole the wardstone, and Vighar escaped.
plugin.target: 他也是一個吸血鬼。我的家族被叮嚀說要讓他長眠在地下，但是最近有人偷了魔法石，於是維吉納逃走了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Destroy Vighar, my long dead vampire ancestor. Have you changed your mind?
plugin.target: 毀滅維吉納，我那死去很久的吸血鬼祖先。你改變主意了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What did you want my help with?
plugin.target: 你想要我幫什麼忙？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You were helpful before. I have need of your help again, if you're willing.
plugin.target: 你以前幫了很多忙。我還想要你幫忙，如果你願意的話。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hello.
plugin.target: 你好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It is the Champion of Namira! I was just about to eat. Here, you should have the first bite.
plugin.target: 它是娜米拉的勇士！我正想吃點東西呢。拿著，你應該吃第一口。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where is this shrine?
plugin.target: 聖壇在哪裡？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In the mountains to the northeast. I'll mark it on your map.
plugin.target: 在東北方向的群山之中。我會在你的地圖上標出來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hello.
plugin.target: 你好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sibbi Black-Briar.
plugin.target: 西比·黑棘。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Guess I should have known. Maven and Sibbi have been at odds ever since she had him tossed into jail.
plugin.target: 我早就應該知道。自從瑪雯把西比扔進監獄後，他們兩個就一直有過節。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look, if I were you, I'd proceed carefully. Crossing Maven is one of the first things you learn not to do when you're down here.
plugin.target: 聽著，如果我是你，我會小心行事。在這裡，不要去惹瑪雯是你必須要學會的第一件事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As far as the Guild's concerned this is between Sibbi and Maven, so we're going to officially stay out of it.
plugin.target: 只要公會認為這件事只涉及瑪雯和西比，我們就能置身事外。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Heh. So Sibbi finally got the nerve to bare his teeth, eh?
plugin.target: 所以西比終於忍不住露出銳牙了，嗯？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look, this sounds like a family matter and I don't want the Guild in the middle of it. You do what you want.
plugin.target: 聽著，這聽起來只是他們的家務事，我不希望公會去摻一腳。隨便你怎麼做吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Just don't expect us at your back when Maven has your head on the executioner's block.
plugin.target: 要是瑪雯把你送上斷頭臺，別指望我們會幫你撐腰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When it was over, Atmah, Hafnar, and I stared, pale-faced, at one another, unwilling to admit we'd made a terrible mistake.
plugin.target: 一切都結束後，奧特瑪、哈弗那和我雙目無神，面色蒼白，互相支援著，誰都不想提到我們犯的重大錯誤。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I knew you'd come... eventually.
plugin.target: 我知道你遲早會來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Doesn't anyone care that Orthorn stole things from the College?
plugin.target: 沒人在意奧拓恩從學院偷了東西嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Not enough to bother with. Arch-Mage Aren's approach to these things is just to let them sort themselves out.
plugin.target: 這還不到大驚小怪的程度。首席法師阿冉處理這些事情的時候，都是以順其自然為原則的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Although now it looks like you'll be doing the sorting. Good luck with that.
plugin.target: 現在看來是由你來負責處理此事，祝你好運吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's no business of yours, Son. Mind you keep your nose out of it.
plugin.target: 和你無關，孩子。記住，別多管閒事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Time to die, hero!
plugin.target: 死吧，英雄！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Go ahead, try and fight back!
plugin.target: 來吧，試著還手阿！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Die already so I can take your stuff!
plugin.target: 去死吧，你的東西我要了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Whatcha gonna do? Huh? Whatcha gonna do?
plugin.target: 你想怎麼樣？哼？想怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Gonna split your belly like an old woman's purse!
plugin.target: 要像撕口袋一樣扯開你的肚皮！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Gonna rip you... open!
plugin.target: 我要把你……撕碎！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: For The Reach!
plugin.target: 為了邊塞領！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nord... dog!
plugin.target: 諾德……狗！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Filthy... barbarian!

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My only regret is that she doesn't host them more often.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Have you tried the wine? It's better than anything in the Blue Palace.

plugin.source: Though I confess, being surrounded by so many wealthy and important people makes me feel more than a little nervous.

plugin.source: I am the Steward of Whiterun. I serve Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach.
plugin.target: 我是白漫城的管家。為龍臨堡的巴爾古夫領主服務。

plugin.source: Truth be told, I'd be more comfortable if I were back there. I get nervous in the company of so many worthies.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I made a lot of friends in a lot of ports, and the Thalmor approach me with a generous offer.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I give them access to my business associates, and they keep my coffers full.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Quite often, yes. The only thing I enjoy more than luxury is sharing that luxury with those who can appreciate it.

plugin.source: But I also enjoy learning the latest gossip and hearing the most intriguing rumors.

plugin.source: Your crops seem to be thriving.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you fancy keeping your purse filled with gold and your head on your shoulders, I'd stay out of those awful tunnels.
plugin.target: 要是你想平安無事就遠離那地方。

plugin.source: There's an entrance down by the canal, but I'd highly advise you to stay out of there... it's the Thieves Guild's territory.
plugin.target: 運河附近有個入口，但我建議你別靠近……那是盜賊公會的領地。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If I were you, I'd keep my feet dry and stay up here.
plugin.target: 如果我是你，我會遠離那地方的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's our name for the old sewers that run under the city.
plugin.target: 那是我們對舊下水道的稱呼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It used to be a huge system hundreds of years ago, but it fell into decay, just like the rest of Riften.
plugin.target: 幾百年前它曾經是一個巨大的系統，但和裂谷的其他地方一樣，現在已經衰敗不堪。

plugin.source: The Guild stocks the place full of thugs that aren't good enough to join, so watch yourself if you venture down there.
plugin.target: 公會在裡面安置了很多暴徒，如果你要進去就當心點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about the Thieves Guild.
plugin.target: 告訴我盜賊公會的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They live below the streets in the Ratway like dirty animals. And trust me, they're no better than the vermin that slink out of there for scraps.
plugin.target: 他們像骯髒的動物一樣在大街下的鼠道中生活。他們也不比垃圾堆裡的那些害蟲好多少。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They make it difficult for decent people to earn a living. Of course, not many decent people live here in the first place.
plugin.target: 他們讓正直的人無法順利生活。當然了，這裡也沒多少正直的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We're all eager to see them brought to justice. Maven Black-Briar has assured me that they're being dealt with appropriately.
plugin.target: 我們都希望將他們繩之以法。瑪雯·黑棘向我保證過已經著手處理他們了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As one of our city's most influential citizens, she's taken it upon herself to oversee their incarceration.
plugin.target: 作為我們城裡最有影響力的公民，她以將他們抓捕歸案為己任。

plugin.source: Sadly, they're proving elusive but I have confidence that Maven won't give up until this city has been rid of them all.
plugin.target: 可惜的是，他們十分狡猾。但我有信心，瑪雯一定會將他們通通抓起來的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're vermin... garbage. They're exactly what makes this city such a horrible place to live.
plugin.target: 他們是害蟲……垃圾。就是他們把這城市搞得烏煙瘴氣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How appropriate they should live in the Ratway with the rest of the trash.
plugin.target: 他們就是應該在鼠道和那些垃圾住在一起。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They'd stop at nothing to take your last bit of food if that's all you had.
plugin.target: 他們會毫不猶豫拿走你最後一口食物。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Ratway's too good a place for that scum.

plugin.target: 龍裔？你在說什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 在最古老的傳說當中，古老到天際仍然有龍存在的時候，龍裔會殺死它們、奪取它們的能力。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's what you did, isn't it? Absorbed the dragon's power?

plugin.source: Why the name "Drunken Huntsman"?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; manually reviewed target

plugin.source: Yes, I hear that question often.
plugin.target: 很多人問這個問題。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; manually reviewed target

plugin.target: 你不是裂谷本地人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've been adventuring across Tamriel since I was a fresh-faced young woman barely able to swing a blade.
plugin.target: 自從我還是一個稚氣未脫的小女孩，甚至很難揮舞一把劍的時候我就開始在泰姆瑞爾冒險了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My travels have taken me from High Rock to Valenwood, Elsweyr to Morrowind and all points in between.
plugin.target: 我的旅程途徑高巖和威木省，艾斯維爾和晨風之間的所有地方。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why is your shop down here in the canal?
plugin.target: 你的商店怎麼在這運河旁邊？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, the moisture in the air is better for the ingredients. It isn't every day that you get your hands on fresh nirnroot or painted troll fat.
plugin.target: 空氣中的水分對原料來說是好的。不是每一天你都得去碰新鮮的奈恩根和鮮豔的巨魔脂肪的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It also makes it easier to gather water when the canal is right out the front door.
plugin.target: 這也讓取水更加容易因為運河就在大門旁邊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Besides, I also prefer the quiet. I didn't open this business for browsing. Come in, buy what you need and get out.
plugin.target: 而且，我偏好寧靜。我做生意不是讓人來參觀的。進來吧，買完你需要的東西然後就出去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about Maven Black-Briar.
plugin.target: 告訴我關於瑪雯·黑棘的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Lady Maven could buy or sell anyone in Skyrim. I wouldn't be surprised if she's the one pulling the strings around this city.
plugin.target: 瑪雯女士能買通或者出賣任何天際的人。我可不會覺得奇怪如果她是真正控制這座城市的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: She's always welcome in Mistveil Keep and between you and me, I'm pretty sure she even has some pretty influential friends within the Empire.
plugin.target: 她在霧隱堡壘永遠是受歡迎的，而且這話只限於我們之間，我很確定她甚至在帝國裡也有一些很有影響力的朋友。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd also warn you not to cross her. She employs quite a few... troubleshooters to take care of messy problems.
plugin.target: 我也要警告你不要讓她發脾氣。她僱傭了很多……糾紛解決者來處理棘手的問題。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You seem to be well acquainted with wealth.
plugin.target: 你看起來很瞭解財富。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Wealth is my business. Help me out and I can add to yours. Would you like a taste?
plugin.target: 財富是我的事業。幫幫我，我會給你好處的。有沒有興趣？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Glad Orthus was able to find someone competent to help out.
plugin.target: 很高興奧蘇斯能找到一個有用的人來幫忙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You handled yourself pretty well back at Japhet's Folly. We'll remember that.
plugin.target: 你在賈菲特堡壘表現的很不錯。我們會記住的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you like it out here, away from everything?
plugin.target: 你喜歡遠離一切，待在這偏僻山野裡嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Other people just make things complex. Out here, Hern and I can get everything we need from the occasional traveler.
plugin.target: 其他人只是讓事情更復雜。在這山野裡，赫恩和我能從偶爾路過的旅行者身上弄到我們需要的一切東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you get many guests?
plugin.target: 客人多嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We have guests as often as we can, but there aren't a lot of travelers these days. The war keeps people off the roads.
plugin.target: 客人跟平常一樣多，但是這些天旅者變少了，因為戰爭讓人們不敢出遠門。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ayleid, Dwemer, Daedric... not even Falmer. None of them are a match. Quite curious indeed.
plugin.target: 亞歷德，鍛莫，魔族人……甚至還有伐莫。他們都不匹配。確實很奇怪。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Surely there's more you can tell me.
plugin.target: 你肯定還有更多可以告訴我的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There is indeed much that we know that you do not. That does not mean that you are ready to understand it.
plugin.target: 確實有許多事我們知道而你不知道。那並不意味著你已經準備好理解他們了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do not let your easy mastery of the Voice tempt you into the arrogance of power; that has been the downfall of many Dragonborn before you.
plugin.target: 不要自恃能輕易掌控龍吼而產生對力量的傲慢，這就是在你之前許多龍裔滅亡的原因。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I will try to follow the Way of the Voice.
plugin.target: 我會嘗試遵從龍吼之道的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That is commendable. But remember, the dragon blood is itself a gift of Akatosh. Do not try to deny that gift.
plugin.target: 這是值得讚賞的。但是記住，龍血自身就是阿卡託什的恩賜。不要嘗試否認那種恩賜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your destiny requires you to use your Voice - why else would Akatosh have bestowed this power upon you?
plugin.target: 你的命運要求你使用你的龍吼——除此之外阿卡託什還會有什麼原因將這種力量賜給你？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you remember to use your Voice in service to the purpose of Akatosh, you will remain true to the Way.
plugin.target: 如果你能在使用龍吼時，記住這是為阿卡託什的意圖服務，那麼你將保持在這條道路上的虔誠。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I don't follow your philosophy. Why help me learn the Voice?
plugin.target: 但是我不遵從你們的宗旨，為什麼幫助我學習龍吼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Dragonborn is an exception to all the rules - the dragon blood itself is a gift of the gods.
plugin.target: 龍裔是所有規則的例外——龍血自身就是眾神的恩賜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If we accept one gift, how can we deny the other? As Dragonborn, you have received the ability to Shout directly from Akatosh.
plugin.target: 如果我們接受了一個禮物，我們如何拒絕其它的？作為龍裔，你已被賜予了直接來自阿卡託什的龍吼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We therefore seek to guide you on the proper use of your gift, which transcends the restrictions which bind other mortals.
plugin.target: 我們因此爭取引導你正確使用你的天賦，這種天賦能超越束縛在其他凡人身上的限制。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Degaine the beggar got himself kicked out of the Temple of Dibella. Caused quite the ruckus.
plugin.target: 乞丐德加因讓他自己被趕出了蒂貝拉神殿。造成了很大的騷動。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm looking for work.
plugin.target: 我在找工作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skjor was looking for you earlier.
plugin.target: 剛才，斯科約爾在找你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 你介意幫我煮點吃的嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here you are. I added a little mead into the recipe. I think it tastes better. Let me know what you think tomorrow, and I'll make another one.
plugin.target: 給你，我在食譜中加了點蜂蜜酒。我想它嚐起來會更美味。明天讓我知道你的感想，我會再做一次的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Use Dragonrend! It's the only chance to defeat him!
plugin.target: 用龍魂撕裂！這是打敗它的唯一機會！

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 哈！太對了，我的朋友。太對了……

plugin.source: Ha ha! I'd rather have two bottles of mead than two wenches, friend.
plugin.target: 比起兩個女人我更寧願喝兩瓶蜂蜜酒，朋友。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Black-Briar Mead? What are you trying to do? Poison me?
plugin.target: 黑棘蜜酒？你打算做什麼？毒死我？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps you'd like to share this Black-Briar Mead with me instead?
plugin.target: 或許你也會想和我一起分享這瓶黑棘蜜酒？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Black-Briar? How dare you shove that swill in my face. I'd rather drink mammoth drool!
plugin.target: 黑棘？你怎麼敢對我說這樣的話。我寧可喝長毛象的口水！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I would love to share a drink with you, friend!
plugin.target: 我很樂意與你一同喝酒，朋友！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, nothing like fine spirits to help raise your... well, your spirits!
plugin.target: 哈，沒什麼比好酒更能打起你的……嗯，你的精神！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good to see you. Come on in.
plugin.target: 很高興見到你。進來吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Aren't you a sight for sore eyes.
plugin.target: 你怎麼看起來這麼嘔心。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hello friend. Make yourself at home.
plugin.target: 你好朋友，別拘束，像在自己家一樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Can I help you?
plugin.target: 我能為你效勞嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You lost?
plugin.target: 你迷路了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I trust you're not planning any trouble. What can I do for you, friend?
plugin.target: 我相信你也不想找麻煩的。有什麼事能為你效勞嗎，朋友？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're here to purchase, I have many spells available. Do come in.
plugin.target: 如果你是想買東西，可以在我這裡買到些法術。快進來吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Welcome, welcome. There are many things here that cannot be found elsewhere.
plugin.target: 歡迎。很多東西你在別處是買不到的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah. Good to have a customer! You need food or drink, you say the word.
plugin.target: 有生意真好！要吃要喝，儘管直說。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah good, back for some more Black-Briar Mead, eh?
plugin.target: 很好，又回來喝黑棘蜜酒了嗎，嗯？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So what should I wear to the Blue Palace?
plugin.target: 那麼，要去藍宮的話我應該穿什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're really going to the Blue Palace? That presents an opportunity.
plugin.target: 你真的要去藍宮？有個機會給你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you are willing to wear one of Radiant Raiment's outfits and speak to the Jarl, I would not only pay you but let you keep the outfit.
plugin.target: 如果你願意穿錦衣服飾店的衣服去和領主說話，我不僅會付給你報酬，還會把衣服送給你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Um, excuse me. Could I buy two leeks?
plugin.target: 呃……打擾了。我能買兩根韭蔥嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's the word around town?
plugin.target: 城裡有什麼傳聞嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Generally, if you want rumors, you should talk to Corpulus. That said... I did see a visitor pass through on his way to the Blue Palace.
plugin.target: 大體來說，如果你想聽傳言，就應該和科普盧斯談。據說……我之前確實看見有位訪客路過這到藍宮去了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think I may wait until the Burning of King Olaf to have a Spiced Wine.
plugin.target: 我想我可以等到火燒奧拉夫節和香料酒到來的日子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's too bad the Burning of King Olaf was called off this year. I think some of the younger bards would have really gotten a kick out of it.
plugin.target: 很遺憾今年的火燒奧拉夫節取消了，真糟糕。我想很多年輕詩人本能從中收穫不少樂趣的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Absolutely not. I prefer to be near enough to come visit, but free to come and go as I please.
plugin.target: 當然不。我比較想待在附近以便探訪，但來去要隨我意。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, a few reasons come to mind.
plugin.target: 呃……我想到了幾個理由。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In my days as a riverboat captain, I was known to run a tight ship.
plugin.target: 在我當內河船船長的時候，就以紀律嚴明而聲名遐邇。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That, and I made my fortune knowing when to spend my septims, and when not to. I can't stand waste.
plugin.target: 而且我還懂得何時該花錢，何時不該花錢，靠著這種經驗積累了財富。我不能容忍浪費。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about the city's history.
plugin.target: 告訴我關於這座城市的歷史。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Windhelm is one of the oldest human cities in all of Tamriel. In fact, it was the capital of the First Empire, which was founded by Ysgramor.
plugin.target: 風舵城是全泰姆瑞爾中最古老的人類城市之一。事實上，它是伊斯格拉謨建立的第一帝國的首府。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Palace of the Kings in which you now stand is one of the last buildings that remain from that era.
plugin.target: 你現在所處的眾王之殿是那個時代遺留下來的最後一批建築物之一。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Long ago, the Empire used the city to garrison troops who guarded the passes to Morrowind.
plugin.target: 很久以前，帝國利用這座城市來駐紮部隊，以保護通往晨風省的道路。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And now, thanks to you, the city is back under the Empire's banner.
plugin.target: 多虧有你，這座城市又重歸帝國旗幟下了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you are, then you make your way to Windhelm and talk to the man himself. If you're not, well, friend, you'd best walk away before this gets ugly.
plugin.target: 如果你是，那就去風舵城找他本人。如果你不是，那麼朋友，最好趕快走開，否則我就不客氣了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you are, then you talk to the man himself. If you're not, well, friend, you'd best walk away before this gets ugly.
plugin.target: 如果你是，就去找他本人。如果你不是，那麼朋友，最好趕快走開，否則我就不客氣了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about your group.
plugin.target: 告訴我關於你的組織的事情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At first they called us that to belittle our cause. But we gladly accept being named for Ulfric Stormcloak, the only true High King of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 一開始別人稱呼我們為“風暴斗篷”是貶低我們的事業。但我們很樂意接受風暴斗篷領袖烏弗瑞克的命名，他是天際真正的至高王。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We are the true sons and daughters of Skyrim, and Ulfric... he's the truest of us all.
plugin.target: 我們是天際真正的兒女，而烏弗瑞克……他是我們之中最純正的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We fight to make our land great once more, to raise up strong, noble Thanes, and lay low false Jarls and the cowards who hide behind them.
plugin.target: 我們是為了讓這片土地再次繁榮昌盛而戰，把那些虛偽的領主和支援他們的膽小鬼們拉下馬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The sound of our fury is a storm about to break on the heads of our enemies. Our friendship, a cloak of true brotherhood for all who would wear it.
plugin.target: 我們對敵人發起雷霆之擊時的狂暴憤怒就像風暴一樣。還有就是同袍們都穿著斗篷，象徵著我們的兄弟情誼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why are you called Stormcloaks?
plugin.target: 你們為何自稱“風暴斗篷”？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How do you feel about this war?
plugin.target: 你對這場戰爭有何看法？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skyrim is the birthplace of humanity. The birthplace of honor. And those snowbacked Imperials renounced both when they laid down before the Thalmor.
plugin.target: 天際是人性和榮耀的誕生之地。而那些軟骨頭的帝國人在梭默面前放棄了這兩樣東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Worse still, to pay for the privilege to keep his throne, the Emperor sells Skyrim and our very gods - Talos, no less! - to the damn elves.
plugin.target: 更糟的是，為了得以保住王位，皇帝付出了高昂代價，他把天際和咱們的神——當然是塔洛斯！——出賣給該死的精靈了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And what did Torygg do? He and the Jarls that supported him? They took the Emperor's gold. Sold out their people for a slave master's "peace treaty."
plugin.target: 而託依格和支援他的領主們幹了什麼？他們拿了皇帝的金幣。為了一個奴隸主的“和平協定”而出賣了他們的人民。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ulfric did right killing him. Soon we'll rid Skyrim of Elves, their bloody Justiciars, and the Jarls in their pockets. The whole damn lot of them.
plugin.target: 烏弗瑞克殺他殺得好。我們很快就能除掉天際的精靈，除掉他們那些混蛋審判者，還有那堆傀儡領主們。得把他們全部除掉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And we'll cleave through the Legion to get to them.
plugin.target: 我們要把軍團打個落花流水。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How do I join?
plugin.target: 我要加何加入？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Think you've got the mettle, eh?
plugin.target: 看來你很有勇氣嘛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Honestly, the Legion can use all the able bodies it can muster. We have our hands full. A dead king, a rebellion, and now dragons? Skyrim's a mess.
plugin.target: 說實話，軍團需要所有能幹的人。我們人手不足。先是國王被殺，後來出現了叛亂，現在又冒出一堆龍。天際真是一片大亂啊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you're serious, make your way to Solitude. Our headquarters is Castle Dour. You'll find General Tullius there, commanding our forces in Skyrim.
plugin.target: 如果你是認真的，就到獨孤城去。我們的總部在陰鬱堡。你可以去找圖留斯將軍，他是我們在天際的部隊的總指揮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But talk to Legate Rikke. She handles the local recruiting.
plugin.target: 去找瑞姬副官吧。她負責本地的新兵招募事宜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How does one join the Imperial Legion?
plugin.target: 要如何加入帝國軍團？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 看來你很有勇氣嘛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 如果你是認真的，那就來對地方了。我們的總部在陰鬱堡。你可以去找圖留斯將軍，他是我們在天際的部隊的總指揮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who are the Forsworn?
plugin.target: 棄誓者到底是誰？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're remnants of the old rulers of Markarth. Natives of The Reach. Followers of the old ways.
plugin.target: 他們是馬卡斯城舊統治者們的餘孽，邊塞領的本土居民，也是一群老傳統的追隨者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Nords drove them out of the city. Ulfric Stormcloak and his men. That was about 20 years ago.
plugin.target: 後來那些諾德人，烏弗瑞克和他的手下，把他們趕出了城市。那大約是二十年前的事了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But somehow they're still here, and they're killing people.
plugin.target: 然而他們還是陰魂不散，在這裡到處亂殺人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Be careful. They're faster than you think.
plugin.target: 小心點，他們的動作比你想像中更快。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hello.
plugin.target: 你好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Be careful with Sapphire. She mixes with all sorts of nasty people.
plugin.target: 小心藍寶石。她身邊都是些下三濫。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Forget it. I'm going to speak to Brynjolf.
plugin.target: 算了。我去告訴布林喬夫吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Whoa, whoa. Calm down. Let's just think about this for a moment.
plugin.target: 哇哇，冷靜點。有事好商量嘛。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: (Sigh) You win. Tell Shadr he can forget the debt.
plugin.target: 唉，你贏了。告訴沙德，叫他不用還那筆錢了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Drop the debt or answer to me. (Intimidate)
plugin.target: 快放棄那筆債務，否則我要讓你吃不了兜著走。（威嚇）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All right, all right! Take it easy. No idea why you'd care about a stranger so much, but this isn't worth a fight.
plugin.target: 好吧，好吧！冷靜點。不知道你做什麼那麼關心一個陌生人，不過不會為了他跟你打架的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell Shadr I'm forgetting about his debt.
plugin.target: 告訴沙德不用還我的錢了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll just pay it off for him. (<BribeCost> gold)
plugin.target: 我來幫他還錢。（賄賂<BribeCost> 金幣）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't know why you'd help a stranger like that, but a septim's a septim... don't care where it comes from.
plugin.target: 真不明白你為什麼要這樣幫一個陌生人，不過人情歸人情，數目要分明……錢財不問來路。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You can tell Shadr his debt's been paid.
plugin.target: 你可以告訴沙德他已經還清了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You and I both know this is a setup. (Persuade)
plugin.target: 你和我都知道這是設計好的。（說服）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All right, all right. I guess I made enough from his shipment. No need to waste any more time threatening a stable hand.
plugin.target: 好吧，我確定我從他的貨物裡搶的已經夠多了。沒什麼必要再威脅他了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell Shadr he doesn't owe me anything.
plugin.target: 告訴沙德他沒欠我什麼了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What does this have to do with dragons?
plugin.target: 這跟巨龍有什麼關係？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, no mere brute mercenary, but a thinker - perhaps even a scholar?
plugin.target: 啊，不再是個野蠻的傭兵了，而是個思想家 ，或許還是個學者？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You see, when the stories of dragons began to circulate, many dismissed them as mere fantasies, rumors. Impossibilities.
plugin.target: 你看，當龍的故事開始流傳時，很多人認為那些故事只是幻想、是謠言、是不可能的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One sure mark of a fool is to dismiss anything that falls outside his experience as being impossible.
plugin.target: 一個蠢蛋的明顯特徵，就是以自我為中心地把一些未親自經歷的事物當作不可能。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I began to search for information about dragons - where had they gone all those years ago? And where were they coming from?
plugin.target: 但我已經開始收集巨龍的訊息，它們這些年都去哪裡了？現在又從哪兒冒出來？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Look out - you're about to step in your own shock rune.
plugin.target: 小心，你快踩到自己的閃電符文上了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's at Fort Hraggstad?
plugin.target: 有什麼在哈格斯塔德要塞？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The ancients built many of the fortresses that dot the landscape of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 天際各地到處是古代人建造的堡壘。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sadly, most have fallen into disrepair. And nearly all have been overrun with bandits or other vagabonds.
plugin.target: 不幸的是，大多數城堡都已破損了。而且幾乎都被強盜和流氓佔據了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Fort Hraggstad is one of the few that remains mostly intact.
plugin.target: 哈格斯塔德要塞是少數還儲存完好的要塞了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We're going to install a garrison there, but first, you're going to clean out the bandits that have moved in.
plugin.target: 我們打算在那裡派遣一支駐軍，但在此之前，你得先過去把強盜都清除掉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm sending you to clear out Fort Hraggstad. If you survive, you'll pass.
plugin.target: 我派你去清空哈格斯塔德要塞。要是你活下來了，你就通過了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you die, then I'll have no further use for your corpse.
plugin.target: 要是你死了，那我要你的屍體也沒用。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you ready to test yourself at Fort Hraggstad?
plugin.target: 你準備好到哈格斯塔德要塞進行測試了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: About that test...
plugin.target: 關於那個考驗……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I was set free. I could've gone anywhere. I came here to fight for the Empire.
plugin.target: 我被釋放了，本來去哪兒都行，不過我還是來為帝國戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hmm. I suppose that's true. Fine.
plugin.target: 看來像是真的，好吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why don't you have a chat with Legate Rikke?
plugin.target: 你去找瑞姬副官吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I believe we've already met.
plugin.target: 我們已經見過面了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Have we?
plugin.target: 有嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh. Oh, of course.
plugin.target: 哦，當然了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You were at Helgen!

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We have it on good authority that Ulfric has raised enough men to attack the city of Whiterun. The Jarl, however, refuses the Legion's support.
plugin.target: 我們根據可靠地情報得知，烏弗瑞克招集了大量的兵馬足以攻擊白漫城。然而，白漫城領主卻拒絕接受軍團的幫助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This missive should convince him. Be aware, soldier, these documents contain sensitive intelligence for the Jarl's eyes only.
plugin.target: 這封公文應該能讓他相信了。戰士，你要小心，這些檔案裡包含有隻有領主能看的敏感軍情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's the Jagged Crown?
plugin.target: 鋸齒王冠是什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A legendary crown, dating back to King Harald's time, or before. A powerful relic of a golden age, long since passed.
plugin.target: 那是一頂傳奇的王冠，可追溯至哈拉爾德國王或者更早的時代。那是一件很久很久以前，黃金時代的強大聖物。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Legend has it that the crown is made from the bones and teeth of ancient dragons, and is said to increase the power of the wearer.
plugin.target: 傳說中，那頂王冠是由古代的龍骨和龍牙製成，聽說它還能增進佩戴者的力量。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Whatever the truth, if Ulfric gets his hands on it, it would be a powerful symbol around which to rally support for his cause.
plugin.target: 無論傳說是真是假，要是讓烏弗瑞克得到了，這個強大的象徵將會成為烏弗瑞克拉攏人心的利器。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You called me "Auxiliary"?
plugin.target: 你叫我輔助軍士？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Heh. Hardly likely.
plugin.target: 不大可能。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Forsworn have a king?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Madanach. The King in Rags.
plugin.target: 襤褸之王邁德納奇。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: While we were off fighting the Elves in the Great War, Madanach was busy ruling over The Reach.
plugin.target: 當我們與精靈們在激戰時，邁德納奇趁機統一了整個邊塞領。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Until Ulfric came and put them down.
plugin.target: 直到烏弗瑞克來把他們都搞定。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What? By the gods, Betrid...
plugin.target: 什麼？哦，天啊，貝垂德……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I want answers about the Forsworn.
plugin.target: 我想知道關於棄誓者的事情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're crazy. Think they rule The Reach.
plugin.target: 他們都是瘋子。整天以為自己統治著邊塞領。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, guess who really runs things around here? Me. I own the mines. I make the coin pass to the right hands.
plugin.target: 你以為是誰在這裡打理一切？是我。是我掌握著礦場，把賺來的錢交給適當的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That answer your damn questions? Now get out.
plugin.target: 這樣回答你他媽的滿意了沒？給我滾吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I need to see Thonar.
plugin.target: 我得見託納爾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm afraid he's asked not to be disturbed. He has important business.
plugin.target: 恐怕不行，他說了別去打攪他。他有重要的事務要處理。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What kind of patrons do you have?
plugin.target: 你們的客人都是些什麼樣的人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: For one, the landowners of The Reach. It goes without saying that they rely heavily on us for our silver and support.
plugin.target: 首先是，邊塞領所有的地主。我想也不用詳加解釋了，他們當然非常需要我們的銀子和支援。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All the miners, farmers, and laborers in The Reach get their daily wages through us.
plugin.target: 所有的礦工、農民、和整個邊塞領的體力勞動者都是通過我們領工資的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nepos the Nose handles that part of our business. He has a way with the workers.
plugin.target: 我們這方面的生意都是“大鼻子”奈波斯在打理。他很會跟工人們打交道。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I want to know about the Silver-Bloods.
plugin.target: 我想了解一下銀血氏族的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's an old family. Very well respected throughout The Reach.
plugin.target: 那是個歷史悠久的家族了。在邊塞領一直擁有很高的威望。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Silver-Bloods run nearly all the lands in this hold, as well as the local inn.
plugin.target: 銀血氏族控制著這塊領地幾乎所有的土地，就像本地那間旅舍一樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And, of course, they own Cidhna Mine, the finest prison and source of silver in Skyrim.
plugin.target: 當然了，他們還支配著希訥礦坑，那是天際最好的監獄和銀礦了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Weylin got his orders from Nepos.
plugin.target: 韋林是從奈波斯那裡得到命令。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nepos the Nose? He's been in Markarth forever. And he's well respected among the natives of The Reach.
plugin.target: “大鼻子”奈波斯？他一直都在馬卡斯城。而且他在邊塞領本地人當中的威望很高。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good work. Here's your gold. I have a feeling Nepos gets his own orders, though. If you find out, I'll have more for you.
plugin.target: 做得好。這是你的酬勞。但我感覺奈波斯也有他自己的行動。要是你能找出來，我會給你更多報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You mentioned an uprising.
plugin.target: 你提到了一次起義。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Markarth and The Reach are our lands. That is why we are the Forsworn. We cannot claim the home that is rightly ours.
plugin.target: 馬卡斯城和邊塞領本是我們的領土。這也是我們成為棄誓者的原因。因為我們沒辦法奪回自己的家園。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But then, during their war with the Elves, we had our moment. We drove the Nords out of The Reach in a great uprising.
plugin.target: 但在他們與精靈們展開戰爭時，我們把握了時機。在一次偉大的起義中，我們把諾德人都趕出了邊塞領。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then Ulfric and his men came. Those of us who didn't run were executed, except for myself, my king, and a handful of others.
plugin.target: 然後烏弗瑞克帶著手下趕到了。除了我，陛下，和其他幾個人之外，那些沒有及時逃跑的戰友們都遭到了處決。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who's Madanach?
plugin.target: 邁德納奇是誰？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He is the King in Rags. A man who once held all The Reach within his grip.
plugin.target: 他是襤褸之王。一個曾經統治著整個邊塞領的男人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He stokes the passions of the downtrodden in this city. Directs them to kill the enemies of the Forsworn in our name.
plugin.target: 他鼓動起被壓迫者們的熱情，以棄誓者的名義，引領群眾消滅敵人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All from inside Cidhna Mine. A Nord prison. The irony is quite thick.
plugin.target: 一切都來自於希訥礦坑，諾德人的監獄裡。真是赤裸裸的諷刺啊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Did you know Weylin?
plugin.target: 你認識韋林嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh yes. I know everyone who sleeps in the Warrens. Kind of the one who passes the keys around.
plugin.target: 哦，認識。我認識窩棚裡所有人。我算是負責管理大家的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I guess someone else will be taking his room now.
plugin.target: 我想現在已經有人在用他的房間了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What are the Warrens?
plugin.target: 窩棚是什麼東西？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's where you go when you can't afford a room anywhere else. About the time they opened the mines, someone got the idea to throw beds in here.
plugin.target: 那是個你在別處付不起房租時就會去的地方。在有人開礦的時候，就有人想到在這裡設立床鋪、供人住宿了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Laborers. The sick. The lame. We're all here.
plugin.target: 我們所有的勞工，包括病的，瘸的，全都在這裡了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What do you know about the Forsworn?
plugin.target: 你對棄誓者瞭解多少？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Every other day, seems one of the laborers runs off to the hills saying he'll join the Forsworn.
plugin.target: 每天都有一個工人跑下山，說他要加入棄誓者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You don't like the Nords? Fine. But pledging your whole life to killing them? That's just dumb.
plugin.target: 你不喜歡諾德人？沒問題。但是發誓要花一輩子的時間去屠殺他們？太愚蠢了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You better start caring. (Intimidate)
plugin.target: 你最好配合一下。（威嚇）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hold on there. I just remembered something. The last time we handed out pay.
plugin.target: 等一下。我好像想起來我們最後一次分發工錢的事情了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Little extra slip of paper for Weylin. Took it right to his room.
plugin.target: 給韋林的檔案裡有些小錯誤。馬上把這個送到他房間裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you care about money? (<BribeCost> gold)
plugin.target: 你對金幣有興趣嗎？（賄賂<BribeCost> 金幣）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: For that amount, I can. Fine. I did notice something odd the last time we handed out the pay.
plugin.target: 看在這個數目的份上，我可以。好吧，我確實在最後一次分發工錢的時候注意到了一些怪事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Little extra slip of paper for Weylin. Took it right to his room after he got it.
plugin.target: 給韋林的檔案裡有些小錯誤。等他到了馬上把這個送到他房間裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: (Invisible Continue)
plugin.target: （保持隱形）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm one of General Tullius' agents. I was sent to investigate the Treasury House and the Silver-Blood family.
plugin.target: 我是圖留斯將軍的密探。我的任務是調查珍寶屋及銀血氏族。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They own Cidhna Mine, one of the toughest jails in Skyrim. I was hoping I could buy or steal the deed, but I don't think that's how things work here.
plugin.target: 他們是天際最險惡的監獄之一——希訥礦坑的老闆。我一直想購買或者偷到他們的契約，但都沒有成功。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mark my words. Thonar Silver-Blood was behind that attack in the market. Somehow.
plugin.target: 記住我的話。託納爾·銀血肯定是市場襲擊事件的幕後黑手。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're hiding something. (Persuade)
plugin.target: 你在隱瞞著什麼？（說服）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Was is that obvious? Damn. I must be losing my touch.
plugin.target: 有這麼明顯嗎？見鬼。我肯定是說漏嘴了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your discussion sounded like an argument to me.
plugin.target: 聽起來你們的討論像是在吵架。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, perhaps that is why you're merely an apprentice here.
plugin.target: 因為你只不過是個學徒才會這樣認為。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's the White-Gold Concordat?
plugin.target: 白金協定是什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's the peace treaty that ended the war with the Elves of the Aldmeri Dominion.
plugin.target: 這是一個停戰協議，把我們與先祖神洲的精靈之間的戰爭畫上了句號。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Dominion recognized the heresy of proclaiming Talos a god. Talos was a great man, and a great Emperor... but that does not make him a god.
plugin.target: 先祖神洲認為把塔洛斯尊為神明是異端邪說。塔洛斯是個偉人，一個偉大的皇帝……但是，他並不是神。

plugin.source: Long ago, I was an orphan on the streets of Corinthe. I stowed away aboard a trade ship that brought me here. It was Ri'saad who found me.
plugin.target: 很久以前，我是寇林瑟街頭的一個孤兒。我偷偷上了一條貨船來到這裡。後來瑞'撒德找到了我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He provided the funds to start this caravan, and put me in charge of it. I owe him more than I could ever hope to repay.
plugin.target: 他提供了成立這支商隊的資金，讓我負責。他對我的知遇之恩，我怎麼報答都不夠。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you work for Ri'saad?

plugin.source: He hired the others and paid for my goods. I am allowed to run the caravan, but I pay Ri'saad a percentage of my profits.
plugin.target: 其他人都是他僱請的，還出錢幫我進貨。由我來經營商隊，抽出一定的利潤給瑞'撒德。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I say this without bitterness, for it was Ri'saad who saved me from a life of servitude aboard a trading ship.
plugin.target: 這些事情說起來毫無苦難之感，因為是瑞'撒德把我從商船的奴役生活中救出來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I am grateful to have the life that I do now. It is a far cry from my days as an orphan on the streets of Corinthe.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm curious about your homeland.

plugin.target: 虎人來自於一個名叫艾斯維爾的遙遠大陸，北邊與賽瑞迪爾相接，南邊與藍色閃耀的大海相鄰。

plugin.source: Elsweyr is an arid land of deserts and rocky canyons, where the sun shines warmly, always.
plugin.target: 艾斯維爾是一個到處都是沙漠和岩石峽谷的不毛之地，那裡總是充滿著陽光。

plugin.source: There are cities so ancient, the sands have swallowed them whole. But now I will say no more, for I miss my home greatly.
plugin.target: 那裡還有一些被沙子吞沒的先古城市。但我不想再說下去了，這會讓我變得好想念家鄉。

plugin.source: Tools, wares, and weapons, all for sale at fair prices.
plugin.target: 工具、雜貨和武器，價格公道，童叟無欺。

plugin.source: I don't know how I do it. It just happens.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You were given this gift by the gods for a reason. It is up to you to determine how best to use it.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you find Staubin, it would be good to see any notes he may have collected. I doubt you'll find him alive, though.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm on it.

plugin.source: You should wait until nightfall before trying to sneak in. Talos preserve you.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How's business?

plugin.source: Working with the Guild again is the best decision I've ever made. Protection, respect, and a constant flow of coin... it couldn't get any better.
plugin.target: 再次和公會合作是我做出過的最正確的決定。受人保護，被人尊敬，還有花不完的錢……好得不能再好了。

plugin.target: 最重要的是，我們不用再偷偷摸摸的搞走私了。藉助公會在獨孤城的影響力，我可以大搖大擺地從正門出入。

plugin.source: Business is absolutely booming, my friend.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've taken to hiring a few extra men of my own just to keep up with all the shipments.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Old Delvin certainly takes care of his own, doesn't he?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd take this a bit more seriously, if I were you. If a dragon decides to attack Whiterun I don't know if we can stop it.
plugin.target: 我建議你認真對待此事。如果一頭龍要來襲擊白漫城，我們都不知道能否抵擋得住。

plugin.source: You should come too.

plugin.source: Goodbye.
plugin.target: 再見。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I will consider the offer, but I'll have to discuss it with the other caravans.
plugin.target: 我會考慮這個提議的，但我要與其他商隊討論一下。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mark my words, I'll be Jarl again someday!

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't judge Dengeir too harshly. He's old, but he means well.

plugin.source: Keep a song in your heart to ward off the gloom.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have your amulet.

plugin.source: There it is. Ah... Home...

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you ever need the skills of a Khajiit warrior by your side, I would be honored to travel with you.
plugin.target: 如果你需要一個虎人戰士在身邊，我很榮幸能陪伴在你左右。

plugin.source: Until then, here. This is for you, in thanks.
plugin.target: 那先道別了。這個給你，代表我的謝意。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I could get your amulet back.

plugin.source: Who's Rjorn and why do you want his drum?

plugin.source: Why would a necromancer want your flute?

plugin.source: I recovered your flute.

plugin.source: That's it! Wonderful! I knew I could count on you.
plugin.target: 就是這個！太好了！我就知道可以相信你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't have any money to give you, but I can show you a few tricks I learned playing for the Winterhold wizards.

plugin.target: 勒琳娜，那個沒腦子的學生偷了我的長笛，賣給了某個亡靈法師。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I just got a ransom note for it. That flute has been handed down for seventeen generations!
plugin.target: 我為這個長笛懸賞了一筆報酬。那支長笛已經流傳十七代了！

plugin.source: Well, don't just stand there. Go get my flute!

plugin.source: That damn fool! I should wring her neck!
plugin.target: 那個該死的蠢貨！我應該扭斷她的脖子！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've found Finn's lute.
plugin.target: 我找到了芬恩的魯特琴。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What? You did? Oh sweet Divines! You did!
plugin.target: 什麼？真的？哦，天啊！你找到了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There is no way I can pay you what this lute is worth. But I can teach you a few tricks I've learned over the years.
plugin.target: 我沒法給你相當於這把琴價值的獎勵，但我可以教你一些多年來我學到的技巧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's so important about Finn's Lute?

plugin.source: Finn was the bard who invented the eight-course lute that is commonplace today.
plugin.target: 當代最流行的八弦魯特琴就是吟遊詩人芬恩發明的。

plugin.target: 在他成功給魯特琴加上額外的琴絃前，吟遊詩人只能使用六絃的魯特琴。

plugin.source: The lute they stole is Finn's original eight-course lute. I doubt they even realize its true value.
plugin.target: 他們偷的那把魯特琴，是芬恩原裝的八弦魯特琴。我懷疑他們根本不懂這琴的真實價值。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your chief Talos hunter?
