plugin.source: Well, well. Look at you. Your kinsmen have turned you into an animal, Nord. A wild beast caged up and left to go mad.
plugin.target: 好啦，好啦。看看你。你的親戚把你變成了一隻動物，諾德人。一隻被關在籠子裡的，只能在孤獨中發瘋的野獸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I, uh, learned of a certain stone tablet said to be housed in Bleak Falls Barrow - a "Dragonstone," said to contain a map of dragon burial sites.
plugin.target: 我，啊，聽說了有一塊石板擺放在荒瀑古墳——那是一塊“龍石”。據說上頭刻著一張龍之古冢的地圖。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Go to Bleak Falls Barrow, find this tablet - no doubt interred in the main chamber - and bring it to me. Simplicity itself.
plugin.target: 去荒瀑古墳，找到這塊石板……它肯定是葬在主墓室——然後帶回來給我。就這麼簡單。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why set up shop here?
plugin.target: 為什麼在這裡開店？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Wasn't by choice, I can tell you that.
plugin.target: 我可以告訴你，是因為別無選擇。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Options were in short supply. Ranmir and I grew up here, and nearly any money I make, he drinks away.
plugin.target: 那時候我的選擇不多。我和蘭米爾從小在這長大，而且只要是我賺的錢，都會被他喝進肚子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Without the coin to pack up and leave, I decided to take to trading.
plugin.target: 因為沒錢可以收拾行李搬遷，所以我決定做生意。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This didn't interfere with the Nightingales?
plugin.target: 這不會和夜鶯有衝突嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: These priests weren't a threat to the Skeleton Key or the conduit to Nocturnal's realm, so they were tolerated.
plugin.target: 這些祭司對骷髏鑰匙和諾克圖娜爾位面的聖泉不造成威脅，所以我們容忍他們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One of their ceremonies involved the Pilgrim's Path, a so called "test of worthiness."
plugin.target: 他們有一種儀式牽涉到朝聖者之路，那儀式被稱為“虔誠之試煉”。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If a pilgrim was able to complete the path, it was said that they would live forever in twilight. What that means is anyone's guess.
plugin.target: 據說如果一個朝聖者能按規定走完那條路，他將成為一個與暗影同在的人。沒有人猜得出那意味著什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll take the tour. (2 gold)
plugin.target: 我要參加觀光。（2 金幣）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Splendid! If you'll just follow me, I'll tell you tales and show you wonders such as you've never seen.
plugin.target: 太美好啦！你只要跟著我，我就會給你講很多傳說故事而且讓你帶著完全的新鮮感參觀那些奇蹟。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You mentioned a tour?
plugin.target: 你剛才說觀光？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Indeed I did! For a few septims, I'll tell you about some of the most interesting curiosities in my collection.
plugin.target: 我確是做到了！給我幾金幣，我會告訴你我的故事中最令人好奇的部分。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How did you assemble this collection?
plugin.target: 你是怎麼收集到這些藏品的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My sister and I inherited a modest sum of money. We decided to travel and seek out whatever adventures we could find.
plugin.target: 我和我的姐妹繼承了一筆相當數目的遺產。我們決定去旅行並參加任何能遇到的冒險。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As we journeyed across Tamriel, we encountered tales of exotic and wondrous artifacts. We decided to collect as many as we could.
plugin.target: 我們穿行泰姆瑞爾的時候，聽到關於一些詭異而奇妙的神器傳說。我們決定要盡力收集這類傳說，越多越好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: My sister passed away some years ago, so I settled down here and opened the House of Curiosities.
plugin.target: 我的姐妹幾年前去世了，於是我來這裡安頓下來並開了這家傳奇之屋。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think she would be happy to know that our collection has brought smiles to faces both young and old.
plugin.target: 我想她如果知道我們的收藏能讓無論年輕或年老的面龐都現出笑容的話一定很高興。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How's life under Stormcloak rule?
plugin.target: 風暴斗篷統治下的生活怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, the Stormcloak guards drink a lot more than the Imperials did, so I've been making more money lately.
plugin.target: 這個嘛，風暴斗篷衛兵喝的酒比帝國的衛兵多得多，所以我最近賺得多了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: On the other hand, they're a violent bunch. Every night a fight breaks out and I end up with a smashed chair or broken table.
plugin.target: 但另一方面，他們是具有暴力傾向的一群人。每天晚上都會發生鬥毆而最終我總是要面對一張壞桌子或一把壞椅子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, not much has changed, really.
plugin.target: 所以，實際上，沒什麼大的變化。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You guard the caravan?
plugin.target: 你負責保護商隊？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes, I was hired to protect the others as we walk the roads of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 是的，我被僱來保護那些行走在天際上道路的旅客。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It is a thankless task and I would rather be back home in Elsweyr, but I have little choice.
plugin.target: 這是個吃力不討好的工作所以我想回艾斯維爾的家去，但我沒有太多選擇。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ahkari freed me from a prison in Cyrodiil, and now I must repay my debt to her.
plugin.target: 阿卡利把我從賽瑞迪爾的一個監獄裡放出來，但現在我必須還他錢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: A word of advice, my friend -- do not mix gambling and drink. Taken together, they will empty your pockets of every septim.
plugin.target: 朋友，給你個建議——不要既喝酒又賭博。如果你兩者皆有的話，你的口袋很快就空了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What dangers does the caravan face?
plugin.target: 商隊會遇到什麼危險？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skyrim is filled with all manner of dangerous beasts.
plugin.target: 天際到處都有危險的野獸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Wolves, trolls, mammoths, and giants would all like to make a meal of us.
plugin.target: 狼，巨魔，長毛象，還有巨人都喜歡把我們當成美味餐點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But the dragons are the most fearsome. Lucky for us, they don't seem to hunt along the roads.
plugin.target: 但龍是最可怕的。幸運的是，它們似乎不會在道路上捕獵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The torture room. Gods, I wish we didn't need these...
plugin.target: 這是間酷刑室，天啊，我希望我們不用進這房間……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I had a daughter once. She'd be 23 this year. Married to some hot-headed silver worker or maybe on her own learning the herb trade.
plugin.target: 我曾經有個女兒。她還在的話今年應該二十三歲了。可能和一個急脾氣的銀匠結婚或者自己一個人學習草藥交易。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Nords didn't care who was and who wasn't involved in the Forsworn Uprising. I had spoken to Madanach once, that was enough.
plugin.target: 諾德人不關心誰參與了棄誓者的暴動而誰沒參與。我曾經和邁德納奇說過一次話，而這就足夠了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But my little Aethra didn't want to see her papa leave her. She pleaded to the Jarl to take her instead.
plugin.target: 但我的小艾斯拉不想看到爸爸離開她。她求領主讓自己代替我受刑。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And after they made me watch as her head rolled off the block, they threw me in here anyway, to dig up their silver.
plugin.target: 他們強迫我看著她的頭顱滾下斷頭臺，而且還是把我扔進了這裡，要我替他們挖銀礦。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I had questions about the Forsworn.
plugin.target: 我想問幾個關於棄誓者的問題。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This was our land. We were here first. Then the Nords came and put chains on us. Forbid us from worshipping our gods.
plugin.target: 這曾我們的土地。是我們先定居在這裡的。然後諾德人來了，用鐵鏈奴役我們，也禁止我們信奉自己的神。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Some of us refused to bow. We knew the old ways would lead us back to having a kingdom of our own.
plugin.target: 我們中有一些人拒絕屈服。我們知道那些能讓我們重新建立自己的王國的古老方法。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That is who we are. The Forsworn. Criminals in our own lands. And we will cut a bloody hole into The Reach until we are free.
plugin.target: 那就是成為棄誓者。一群我們自己土地上的罪犯。我們會持續用鮮血來染紅邊塞領的土地，直到我們重獲自由。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let's start with revenge!
plugin.target: 就找你尋仇好了！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then come for me, "son of Skyrim." Come for me!
plugin.target: 那就來啊，“天際之子”。來啊！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then come for me, "daughter of Skyrim." Come for me!
plugin.target: 那就來啊，“天際的姐妹”。來啊！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: (Invisible Continue)
plugin.target: （保持隱形）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're one of us now, you see? A slave. The boot of your kinsmen stepping on your throat. Maybe if you understood that, I could help you.
plugin.target: 你現在是我們中的一員了，明白了嗎？你是一個奴隸了。你的同胞已經一腳踩在你的喉嚨上了。等你明白這一點時，我才能幫你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You have a lot to answer for.
plugin.target: 你要為很多事情負責。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do I? What about you? What right did you have to meddle in my affairs? Kill my people? Was it worth it? Your truth?
plugin.target: 是嗎？那你呢？你有什麼權利干涉我的事情、殺我的人？難道你這麼做就是為了尋求所謂的真相？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What does your position as Thalmor Ambassador involve?
plugin.target: 請問您身為梭默大使有什麼職責？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One of my main duties is to foster a better understanding between the Aldmeri Dominion and the people of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 我的其中一項主要職責是促進先祖神洲與天際人民之間的相互理解。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I also oversee the activities of the Thalmor Justiciars throughout Skyrim, although this has been most unfortunately disrupted by the war.
plugin.target: 我也擔負著監督天際各處梭默審判者的活動的職責，不過這一職責不幸地被戰爭打斷了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skuldafn fen kos dinok.
plugin.target: 斯庫達芬 芬 科斯 迪諾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Alduin saraan hin sil ko Sovngarde!
plugin.target: 奧杜因 薩蘭 辛 希爾 科 松加德！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Het siiv nunon dinok.
plugin.target: 海特 西弗 儂昂 迪諾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Boziik, Dovahkiin. Nuz mey.
plugin.target: 波茲，都瓦克因。怒 梅。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I blackmailed <Alias=Steward> for the information.
plugin.target: 我通過勒索<Alias=Steward>弄到了情報。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That was crafty. I'm sure having a Steward in the pocket will come in handy.
plugin.target: 真聰明。身邊有個管家真是省事很多。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Lucky for us, that the wagon recently had a little accident. They're stranded now. Just up the road!
plugin.target: 我們運氣好，那輛貨車最近出了一場事故。它現在被擱置了，就在路邊上！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We're outnumbered, but I have a plan.
plugin.target: 我們寡不敵眾，但我有個主意。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You got here just in time.
plugin.target: 你來的正及時。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I talked to Braig.
plugin.target: 我跟布萊吉談過了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Imagine hearing a story like that, over and over. Each time a different family. Each time a different injustice.
plugin.target: 想像一下一遍又一遍地聽聞那樣的故事。每次都是不同的家庭遭遇不同的不公正。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your meddling above ground reminded me of how removed I've been from the struggle. My men and I should be in the hills, fighting.
plugin.target: 你在地面上的所作所為讓我想起自己離這場鬥爭有多遙遠了。我的手下和我應該加入這場鬥爭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You think your story justifies the murders the Forsworn have committed?
plugin.target: 你以為你的故事可以證明棄誓者犯下的殺人罪行是正當的嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm not Madanach. I was never a leader of the Forsworn. The only anger I can justify is my own.
plugin.target: 我不是邁德納奇，也從來不是棄誓者的首領。這是我唯一能夠為自己辯解的事情。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But every family in The Reach has a story like mine. There are no innocent onlookers in this struggle. Just the guilty, and the dead.
plugin.target: 但是在邊塞領的每一個家庭裡都有一個跟我一樣的故事。這場鬥爭中沒有無辜的旁觀者。只有有罪之人和死人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I found this note on Ulag's body.
plugin.target: 我在烏萊格的屍體上找到這個字條。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Did you? So Ulag didn't make it past those giants then? More's the pity.
plugin.target: 是嗎？看來烏萊格沒能躲過那些巨人了？真遺憾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you found any of the sap, I'd be willing to pay you the same cut I offered him. Better price than you are likely to find otherwise.
plugin.target: 如果你找到汁液的話，我會付你跟他一樣的價錢。這個價錢比任何地方都要好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skyrim is my home.
plugin.target: 天際就是我的家園。

plugin.source: Not so sure of yourself, after all?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You kill an ice wraith out there, and I'll have all the proof I need about you.
plugin.target: 你要是在那裡殺掉一個冰怨靈，就證明了你的能力。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you ready for Serpentstone Island?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: About that test...

plugin.source: Only the foolish or the courageous approach a Jarl without summons...

plugin.source: As you can see, I have much that requires my attention. If you're inclined to gab, there are some nice prison guards you may like to meet...
plugin.target: 你也看到了，我有很多事情要做。如果你只想廢話，我可以帶你去跟監獄衛兵聊聊……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your words give voice to what we all feel, Ulfric. And that's why you will be High King.
plugin.target: 你的話說出了我們所有人的心聲，烏弗瑞克。我們推舉你為至高王是沒錯的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But the day words are enough, will be the day when soldiers like us are no longer needed.
plugin.target: 但到了說話也能解決問題的那一天時，就不需要我們這樣的戰士了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I fight for the men I've held in my arms, dying on foreign soil.
plugin.target: 我為了與我並肩戰鬥、長眠在異國他鄉的手足兄弟們而戰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I fight for their wives and children, whose names I heard whispered in their last breaths.
plugin.target: 我為了他們在嚥下最後一口氣時仍然魂牽夢縈的妻兒老小而戰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The simplest way to put it is "knowledge," but there's nothing simple about an Elder Scroll.
plugin.target: 用最簡單的話說就是“知識”，但只要涉及上古卷軸的就不可能簡單。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's a reflection of all possible futures and all possible pasts.
plugin.target: 它反映出所有可能的未來和所有可能的過去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Each reader sees different reflections through different lenses, and may come away with a different reading.
plugin.target: 每個讀者通過不同的視角會看到不同的反映，得出的也會是不同的結果。

plugin.source: But at the same time, all of it is true. Even the falsehoods. Especially the falsehoods.
plugin.target: 但同時，每個人看到的都是真實的。即使是謊言，尤其是謊言。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you okay?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Aela said we would need a hagraven's head. I already have one of them, but she said it was a special kind.
plugin.target: 艾拉說我們需要一個烏鴉鬼婆的頭顱。我已經有一個了，但她說必須是要特殊的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And that you knew where to get more. Let's go find one!
plugin.target: 你不是知道到哪裡去弄嘛。我們去找一個來！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is there any work to be done?
plugin.target: 有什麼工作要做的嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There is always work for the Companions. But there is a more personal task before me.
plugin.target: 戰友團一般不會閒著。但我這裡有一項私人任務要給你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let's go kill a dragon.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes! I like the way you think. There are whispers of where we might find one too.
plugin.target: 好！我喜歡你的想法。我也聽說有個地方可以找到龍。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They say he killed twelve of the Imperial Legion and shattered their bones with his breath.
plugin.target: 人們說它殺了十二個帝國軍團士兵，用它的吐息就讓這些士兵粉身碎骨。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think you and I are worth about a dozen soldiers each. We'll send that beast back where it came from.
plugin.target: 我認為你和我都各頂得過十二個當兵的。我們會把那頭怪獸送回它孃胎裡去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Rumors and ramblings should be ignored.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's the kind of thing Kodlak used to say. And he was right. But still, I'd like to see for myself.
plugin.target: 克拉科過去經常這麼說。而且他說的很對。但我仍然要親眼見到才相信。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes, they're real. I've seen them.
plugin.target: 是的，它們是真實存在的。我見過它們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, I envy you. Facing such a beast in combat. Smelling its blood on the air. That is what songs are sung about, Shield-Brother.
plugin.target: 我羨慕你可以在戰鬥中面對這樣一隻野獸，聞到空氣中它的血腥味。完全就是頌歌中唱的那種場面啊，盾友。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ha ha! I envy you. Facing such a beast in combat. Smelling its blood on the air. That is what songs are sung about, Shield-Sister.
plugin.target: 我羨慕你可以在戰鬥中面對這樣一隻野獸，聞到空氣中它的血腥味。完全就是頌歌中唱的那種場面啊，盾友。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is this what we're looking for?
plugin.target: 這是我們要找的東西嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That definitely matches the description of the totem from Skjor's old book. Let's get it to the Underforge.
plugin.target: 那東西絕對符合斯科約爾古書中關於圖騰的描述。我們把它帶到地下熔爐去吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's it! That's the second Totem. Quickly, let's put it back with the other one.
plugin.target: 就是這個了！那是第2個圖騰。快把它帶回去跟另一個放在一起。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At last... the final Totem is ours. Let's go complete our set.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 鋸齒王冠是什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 深淵中的利刃釋放，巨龍從天而降，冰雪的悲傷無法遺忘，至高王戴著他的鋸齒王冠！

plugin.source: Going way back to King Harald's time or even before, the High King always wore the Jagged Crown. It was the symbol of his might and power.
plugin.target: 回溯到哈拉爾德國王時代甚至更早時，至高王總是戴著鋸齒王冠。這是其偉大權力的象徵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The crown is made from the bones and teeth of ancient dragons, and it is said to contain a portion of the power of every king who has worn it.
plugin.target: 這個王冠是由古龍的牙和骨頭製成的，據說只要戴過這個王冠的國王，就會有一部分的力量存留在王冠裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: True or not, who would dare deny Ulfric's claim, when the legendary Jagged Crown sits upon his brow?
plugin.target: 不管是否屬實，當這頂傳奇的鋸齒王冠戴在烏弗瑞克的頭上時，誰敢把它搶下來？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It will be there. You'll see.
plugin.target: 會在那裡的，走著瞧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It exists. And it will be the symbol of the righteousness of our cause. Think about it.
plugin.target: 它是存在的。而且它將成為我們正義事業的象徵。考慮一下吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Jagged Crown! It heralds back to a time before Jarls and Moots.
plugin.target: 鋸齒王冠！它早在各大領地和領地代表大會之前就存在了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Back to the time when a king was a king because his enemies fell before him, and his people rose because they loved him.
plugin.target: 它的存在可以追溯到古早的年代，擊敗所有的敵人，並受到所有人民愛戴才能稱之為王的那個年代。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Skyrim needs that king. You will be that king, Ulfric. You must be.
plugin.target: 天際需要那種王者。你將會成為那種王者，烏弗瑞克。你必須如此。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All the more reason, then. The crown would legitimize your claim.
plugin.target: 但這是你稱王的必要條件，王冠可以使你的權力合法化。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And damn the Moot!
plugin.target: 去他的領地代表大會！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We should risk letting those milk drinkers put Torygg's woman on the throne? She'll hand Skyrim over to the elves on a silver plate.
plugin.target: 難道我們要冒險讓託依格的老婆繼位嗎？她會把天際拱手讓給精靈族。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm looking for work.
plugin.target: 我在找工作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The braggarts in The Reach always claim that no prisoner escapes their mine.
plugin.target: 邊塞的牛皮大王們總是聲稱他們的礦場中不會有犯人逃脫。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What you don't hear about are the ones who break off from their escorts on the way to Markarth.
plugin.target: 但他們可不知道有犯人在押送到馬卡斯城的途中逃脫。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It seems that law-breakers in The Pale have no desire to stay there. I don't blame them.
plugin.target: 看到蒼原的犯罪分子不想待在那裡。這也不能怪他們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You seem quite exhausted.
plugin.target: 你好像精疲力盡了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is it that obvious? (Sigh) I've got my hands full here.
plugin.target: 這麼明顯嗎？唉，我都快忙死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Between the farm chores, cultivating my supply of nirnroot, and keeping a tight rein on my sister Aduri, there's little time for rest.
plugin.target: 除了農場的各種工作，我還要種植奈恩根，還要管好我的妹妹阿都麗，一點休息的時間也沒有。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How did you accomplish such a feat?
plugin.target: 你是如何取得這些成就的？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I had quite the mentor. He taught me everything he knew about the nirnroot and its strange properties.
plugin.target: 我有一個優秀的導師。他傳授了我關於奈恩根奇怪特性的一切知識。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I haven't seen him in many years. I wonder what became of him...
plugin.target: 我有好多年沒見到他了，不知道他現在怎麼樣了……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As I recall, Yisra was trying to improve flame cloak spells to better work in Skyrim's harsh environment.
plugin.target: 在我印象中，伊斯拉之前在嘗試改進火焰斗篷法術，使它在天際的嚴苛環境中能發揮更好的作用。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ilas-Tei was practicing Illusion spells. She was having trouble with the calm spells, I believe, but only ever worked with skeevers.
plugin.target: 伊爾拉斯-泰在練習幻術魔法。她好像在鎮定法術方面遇到了問題，不過她也只在惡鼠身上使用過。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: And then there's Borvir and Rundi. Twins, though they rarely agreed on anything.
plugin.target: 然後是伯維爾和倫蒂。這兩人是雙胞胎，不過兩人的意見很少一致。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Those two boys were obsessed with mead. Convinced they could concoct something to compete with Honningbrew.
plugin.target: 這兩個小子都對蜂蜜酒著迷。他們打算釀造出一種可以跟蜜之釀酒莊一比高下的酒來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Something about using frost magic to chill the mead for a certain period of time. I felt it was a waste, but the Arch-Mage let them proceed.
plugin.target: 他們的方法是利用寒霜法術把蜂蜜酒冷藏一段時間。我認為這是浪費時間，但首席法師讓他們放手去做。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You said something about missing apprentices?
plugin.target: 你剛才提到有學徒失蹤了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, that, yes. The group prior to yours has disappeared entirely.
plugin.target: 啊，是的。比你先進來的前一批的學徒集體失蹤了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's possible that there was less than the necessary amount of oversight. That's still being looked into.
plugin.target: 雖然這事不算是管理方面的疏忽。但仍在調查當中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But we've had no contact with them for quite some time now.
plugin.target: 不過到現在為止我們與他們失去聯絡已經有一段時間了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Arniel wondered if perhaps they'd somehow managed to get themselves lost in the Outer Realms, but I think that's giving them too much credit.
plugin.target: 阿內爾懷疑他們可能不知怎的在外層位面迷了路，但我認為這是太抬舉他們了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Have you ever met with the Psijic Order?
plugin.target: 你沒有遇到過賽伊克修會？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Personally? No, not I. One of their number used to advise the Arch-Mage when I was but an apprentice here.
plugin.target: 就我個人而言嗎？沒有。過去他們有一個成員曾給首席法師當顧問，當時我還只是這裡的一個學徒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But that was a great many years ago, before all the members of the order were called back to the Isle of Artaeum, and it disappeared entirely.
plugin.target: 那是在很多年前的事情了，後來所有修會成員都被召回阿塔尤姆島，隨後整個消失掉了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What do you know about the Psijic Order?
plugin.target: 你對賽伊克修會有什麼瞭解嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No more than anyone else, I don't think.
plugin.target: 跟大家一樣不怎麼了解。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're a very old order. Predated the Imperial Mages Guild by quite a bit.
plugin.target: 他們是一個很古老的修會。遠早於帝國的法師公會。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In fact, the Mages Guild was founded in opposition to the idea of the Psijic Order, that only an elite few should have control over magic.
plugin.target: 事實上，法師公會就是針對賽伊克修會的宗旨而成立的，後者的宗旨認為只有少數精英才能控制魔法。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No one has seen or heard from them in over a hundred years now, though.
plugin.target: 不過他們已經消聲匿跡超過一百年了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm not certain what use it would be.
plugin.target: 我不清楚它有什麼作用。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The staff is said to be able to absorb great amounts of energy. Perhaps it can interact with the Eye in a way that nothing else can.
plugin.target: 據說這個法杖可以吸收大量能量。也許只有它才可以某種方式與瑪格努斯之眼互動。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't know, not for sure.
plugin.target: 我也不大清楚。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But perhaps the staff can absorb some of the energy coming out of the Eye, weaken it. Allow us to get close to Ancano.
plugin.target: 但也許這個法杖可以吸收從瑪格努斯之眼中流出的能量並削弱它。這樣一來我們就可以接近安卡諾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Madanach has been found to be the true murderer of Markarth. On behalf of the city, I apologize for your wrongful imprisonment.
plugin.target: 我們發現邁德納奇是馬卡斯的真正殺人兇手。我代表本城向你之前遭遇的錯誤羈押表示抱歉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, it's you! Sorry to hear about your imprisonment. I'm sure the guards didn't mean to throw you in jail.
plugin.target: 哦，是你啊！我對你之前被關押表示遺憾。那些衛兵肯定不是故意把你扔進監獄的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think I'll hang onto it.
plugin.target: 我會緊緊抓住它的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm sorry, I've come too far to lose it now.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Can I have it? It's worthless to you, but I can pay.
plugin.target: 能給我嗎？它對你來說沒什麼用，但我可以付錢買下來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've found this scroll.

plugin.source: Could it really be? This is what I've been looking for.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's already clear.

plugin.source: You've already taken care of it? Thank you, friend.

plugin.target: 如果你找來你認為有能力的新人，我肯定會接見他們的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Remember though, being a Blade is a lifelong commitment. Their loyalty has to be with us once they're in.

plugin.source: So this is all the Blades? Two people?

plugin.source: The Thalmor hunted us down, remember? It wasn't exactly great for recruitment.

plugin.source: But we have a headquarters of a sort now. We will rebuild the Blades. Someday.
plugin.target: 但我們現在有一個基地了。終有一天我們會重建刀鋒衛士的輝煌的。

plugin.source: You must have your hands full with the change in government.
plugin.target: 你一定是忙著在跟政府做交換吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, it could be worse. The former Steward, Proventus, kept very detailed records.
plugin.target: 可能會更糟的。前任管家普羅萬圖斯作了極其詳細的記錄。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But yes, it's been a lot of work. Vignar doesn't want the change to disrupt the lives of his people. They've got enough to deal with already.
plugin.target: 不過也是，這費了很大功夫。維吉納不想讓這個改變干擾他同胞的生活。他們的麻煩已經夠多了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What are your top priorities as the new Jarl?
plugin.target: 作為新的領主，你最先要處理的是什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, first an' foremost there's repairs to make an' wounds to heal. Folks are depending on us getting the city back in working order.
plugin.target: 呃……首先我們要把壞東西修好、把傷者治好。民眾還得靠我們把城市完好地奪回來呢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Once things settle down, I'll be lookin' to recruit more guards for the city, then shore up our stores of food an' water.
plugin.target: 一旦事情安排妥當，我會想辦法招募更多的衛兵，然後鼓勵民眾開辦日用品商店。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The Empire might try an' take the city back, or worse, we'll get a visit from a dragon. We've got to be ready for both.
plugin.target: 帝國可能會設法奪回這座城市，更糟糕的情況是有巨龍“造訪”我們。我們要作好萬全準備。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Your clans used to be friends?
plugin.target: 你們兩個家族曾經是朋友？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Aye, we used to be fast friends, though it was long ago.
plugin.target: 對，我們之間的曾經有著深厚的情誼，不過那是很久以前的了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We were two of the city's oldest an' most-respected clans, an' we could trace our histories all the way back to Ysgramor's companions.
plugin.target: 當時我們是本城最古老和最受尊敬的兩個氏族。我們的歷史可以追溯到伊斯格拉謨的戰友團時代。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But then Olfrid got rich an' decided he an' his kin were too good for us simple, backwards Nord folk.
plugin.target: 不過之後奧弗瑞德有錢了，認為我們單純落後的諾德人配不上他們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: When the troubles began, he took the Empire's side. We haven't spoken much since then.
plugin.target: 當起義開始後，他選擇支援帝國。在那之後我們便幾乎斷絕了往來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Is running a mill difficult?
plugin.target: 經營一家木材廠很辛苦嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With just myself and one child, it's damn near impossible.
plugin.target: 就我跟一個孩子？幾乎不可能正常運作。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With Leifnarr gone, it's really put me in a terrible bind. I'm having trouble making ends meet.
plugin.target: 雷夫納爾不在了，我陷入了困境，只能靠微薄收入為生。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At this rate, we won't last more than a few more seasons at best. Then I'll just have to sell the old place.
plugin.target: 照這樣下去，我們堅持不了幾個季度了。到時只能把舊的房產變賣了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll try to find him.
plugin.target: 我會盡力找他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good. If you see him, tell him Grosta said he can go straight to Oblivion... he's not welcome here anymore.
plugin.target: 好。如果你見到他，告訴他格羅斯塔叫他滾得遠遠的……這裡不再歡迎他了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I found Leifnarr's body.
plugin.target: 我找到了雷夫納爾的屍體。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No, it can't be... oh my... and all this time, I was thinking he'd been unfaithful to me. I feel so stupid.
plugin.target: 不，不可能……我的天……一直以來，我都認為他拋棄了我。我真是太傻了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened to Leifnarr?
plugin.target: 雷夫納爾怎麼了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He said he was going east towards the border of Morrowind to trade some of our grain to some folks at Broken Helm Hollow.
plugin.target: 他說他要往東去晨風省邊境那裡，把我們的穀物賣給裂盔山谷的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I waited and waited, and he never came back. Probably shacked up with some Elven whore. Good riddance to him, I say.
plugin.target: 我等啊等，他一直沒回來。也許是跟某個精靈婊子跑了，剛好把我們這兩個包袱給甩掉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If I only knew where he was, I'd sure give him a piece of my mind.
plugin.target: 如果我知道他在哪裡，一定會過去罵到他臭頭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've had trouble with thieves?
plugin.target: 你跟盜賊有什麼過節嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you kidding me? We're all alone out here except for a few guards who couldn't give a damn about us.
plugin.target: 你在開玩笑嗎？我們在這裡孤立無援，那些該死的衛兵根本就不想幫助我們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We make easy pickings for thieves looking to steal everything we worked so hard for.
plugin.target: 在那些想把我們辛勤勞動成果全都搶走的盜賊看來，我們是肥得流油的目標。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Not only did they take my bow, but they took all of our coin as well. Nothing's sacred to these people.
plugin.target: 他們不僅拿走了我的弓，還拿走了我們的所有錢財。簡直就是一幫下流無恥的賤狗。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't know how you got it back, and I don't want to know. Frankly, I don't even care... I'm just so glad to see it again.
plugin.target: 我不知道你是怎麼把它弄回來的，也不想知道。老實說也不關我的事……我只是很高興看到它拿回來了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here, this is all I can afford to give you as compensation. Hope it's enough.
plugin.target: 這個給你作為酬勞，我只能出這麼多了，希望你不會介意。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No need. It's right here.
plugin.target: 沒必要。它就在這裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's it! That's my bow!
plugin.target: 就是這個，這就是我的弓！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sorry, I try and avoid thieves.
plugin.target: 對不起，我不想去惹盜賊。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll see what I can do.

plugin.source: Thanks. It will be nice to have it back... means a lot to me.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened to your bow?

plugin.source: A few days ago, some thieves from Riften broke in here and stole it! Can you imagine? Took the only thing of value we had.
plugin.target: 幾天前，一群來自裂谷城的盜賊闖了進來，把它搶走了！這張弓是我們擁有的唯一有價值之物，真難以置信。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you have the guts to head into the Ratway and get my bow back, I'll pay you what I can.
plugin.target: 如果你有膽量去鼠道把我的弓拿回來，我會盡我所能報答你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now everyone... get back to work.

plugin.source: And I'm sure you could do it too.
plugin.target: 我也相信你會成功的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Alright.
plugin.target: 好吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: This is it.

plugin.source: Whiterun's army will no doubt be bolstered with Legionnaires. And those walls around Whiterun are old, but they still stand.
plugin.target: 白漫城的守軍肯定有軍團的支援。它的城牆雖然古老，但老而彌堅。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You were right, Galmar.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm back from Darkwater Crossing.
plugin.target: 我從黑水岔口回來了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ah, yes... seems he sent back my satchel stuffed with letters. I look forward to reading them.
plugin.target: 喔，太好了……看來他送回我裝有信件的包裹了。我很想馬上拆開來看。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I appreciate the delivery, here... I want you to have this. I insist.
plugin.target: 辛苦你了，這個給你吧。請一定要收下。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You're not well? What's wrong?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I had a bad fall in the mine when I was bringing some food to the men.
plugin.target: 我送飯進礦場的時候，不小心摔了一跤，摔得很重。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I was pretty bad off for a while, but a Priest of Mara was passing through on his way to Dawnstar and healed me to the best of his abilities.
plugin.target: 我休養了一段時間，但是有一個正前往晨星的過路瑪拉祭司，盡他所能治好了我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm still pretty sore and I can't really walk too far without having to rest for a while.
plugin.target: 不過現在傷處還很痛，每走一段路就要休息一下。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The town guards can't help you?
plugin.target: 城裡的衛兵不肯幫你嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They're as useless as a fifth wheel on a wagon. Gave me some sort of line about "keeping an eye out for enemy soldiers."
plugin.target: 他們全都是沒用的傢伙。找他們幫忙就推說“要防止敵人來襲”什麼的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's the point in protecting this place if the mine's completely useless? Idiots.
plugin.target: 如果這礦場完全沒用了，那他們還有什麼東西好保護的？真是白痴。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about the spiders infesting the mine.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One day we were cracking rocks in the deepest part of the mine and the next day they were all over the place.
plugin.target: 有一天我們在礦場最深的部分挖掘，第二天它們就佔據了整個礦場。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd give my eye teeth if it meant getting those damn spiders out of the mine!
plugin.target: 如果可以把那些該死的蜘蛛趕出礦場，我就給我的眼睛裝上尖牙！

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 但用他們同源的血液可以製造一種仿製品。這一招很巧妙。他們沒有料到，不，他們不可能料到。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How did he end up in Skyrim?
plugin.target: 他怎麼會到了天際？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, after I fled Morrowind during the eruption, I made my way here... my family had purchased this farm and it's all we had left.
plugin.target: 呃……在火山爆發期間我逃離了晨風省，來到了這裡……我家族購買了這座農場，這是我們唯一剩下的資產了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Years later, Sinderion simply showed up at our doorstep asking to stay for a while... said he was going to do field research.
plugin.target: 幾年後，辛德萊昂突然出現在我們家門口，請求待一陣子……他說打算進行實地考察。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He stayed with us for decades... became an uncle of sorts to Aduri.
plugin.target: 他跟我們待了幾十年……變成了阿都麗的叔父。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Did Sinderion teach you how to grow nirnroot?
plugin.target: 辛德萊昂教了你如何種植奈恩根？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes. He was an absolute genius when it came to the nirnroot.
plugin.target: 是的。他在奈恩根方面絕對是個天才。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sinderion made it his life's work, developing all sorts of interesting concoctions.
plugin.target: 辛德萊昂用了一生時間來調變各種有趣的藥物。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: One day, these beautiful plants will make us famous and we can finally move off this farm... thanks to Sinderion.
plugin.target: 終有一天，這些漂亮的作物會讓我們成名，搬出這個農場……屆時一切都要歸功於辛德萊昂。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here you are.
plugin.target: 這些給你吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you.
plugin.target: 謝謝。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've done alchemy a great service by helping to complete Sinderion's work.
plugin.target: 你完成了辛德萊昂的研究，對鍊金術作出了重要貢獻。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'd like to give you this tome... it's one of Sinderion's greatest works. I believe you've more than earned it.
plugin.target: 我要給你這本書籍……這是辛德萊昂最偉大的著作之一。這是你應得的獎勵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've gathered quite a few of them, I see.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll search through Sinderion's notes and find some more information about the Crimson Nirnroot and its properties.
plugin.target: 我會翻閱辛德萊昂的筆記，找到更多有關深紅奈恩根及其特性的資訊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 黑境……這地方聽起來好熟悉啊！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Of course! It's where my mentor, Sinderion, said he was going to do his field research.
plugin.target: 沒錯了！我的導師辛德萊昂說過他要去這個地方進行實地考察。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's been... years I think, but perhaps you could still find him.
plugin.target: 好像已經……過了很長時間了，也許你還是能找到他的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've found Sinderion's remains.
plugin.target: 我找到了辛德萊昂的遺體。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I knew this day would eventually come.
plugin.target: 早知道會有聽到這個訊息的一天。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At least poor Sinderion died doing what he loved, his field research. I told the old fool he should take it easy, but he was too stubborn.
plugin.target: 至少可憐的辛德萊昂至死都在進行他鐘愛的事業，做他的實地考察。我跟他說過不要急於求成，他就是不聽。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps someday I'll continue where he left off. It's the least I can do considering how much he did for me.
plugin.target: 也許有一天我會繼承他的事業，因為他為我付出這麼多，至少我可以通過這樣來報答他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, your secret is safe with me.
plugin.target: 我不會洩露你的秘密的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I should hope so. The Dark Brotherhood is also known to place contracts on those who associate with the Morag Tong as well.
plugin.target: 希望如此。據說黑暗兄弟會也會把那些與魔拉格堂有聯絡的人當成目標。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, unless you wish a visit from one of their own, I'd suggest you follow your own advice and keep your mouth shut.
plugin.target: 因此，我建議你信守承諾，守口如瓶，否則就等著黑暗兄弟會的人找上門來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps you should have joined the Dark Brotherhood.
plugin.target: 也許你應該加入黑暗兄弟會。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Have you taken leave of your senses?
plugin.target: 你瘋了嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If the Dark Brotherhood discovered I had been with the Morag Tong, they would come after me with a vengeance.
plugin.target: 如果黑暗兄弟會發現我曾經是個魔拉格堂成員，他們就會找我報仇的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Better to stay out of sight and ply my trade with the Thieves Guild than risk a contract on my head.
plugin.target: 最好還是躲起來，默默的幫盜賊公會做事，至少這樣還能保住我這顆頭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Who are the Morag Tong?
plugin.target: 魔拉格堂都是些什麼人？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So, where do you hail from?
plugin.target: 那麼，你們出身於哪裡？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Morrowind of course. Any Dunmer worth their weight in ash would tell you the same.
plugin.target: 當然是晨風省。任何有尊嚴的丹莫都會這樣回答你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I used to be a member of the Morag Tong.
plugin.target: 我過去是魔拉格堂的一個成員。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Maybe you aren't meant to know.
plugin.target: 也許你不一定要知道。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Perhaps. They could be nonsense... inane scribbles done by someone in idle boredom.
plugin.target: 也許吧。可能本來就毫無意義……只是某人在無聊時的瘋狂塗鴉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But if not... if they actually mean something, they might tell me where I am from... what ship I was on. Everything.
plugin.target: 但如果不是的話……如果它們確實代表著什麼，也許可以弄清楚我是從哪裡來、坐哪艘船……弄清楚一切。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why would you leave all that behind?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm eager to try.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You must help me find my Arvak. He doesn't deserve to be in a place like this!
plugin.target: 你一定要幫我找到我的阿瓦克。它不應該留在這種地方！

plugin.source: I see. Now that would explain much.

plugin.source: They were eventually forced to put him down. The Jarl banished them from the hold, but they stuck to their cause.

plugin.source: I've only heard stories. Not sure if any of them are true.

plugin.source: Like that they were supposed to guard some vampire here, but wound up all becoming vampires themselves when they saw how powerful he was.

plugin.source: I guess it doesn't matter now. At least Isran is trying to do something noble with the name.

plugin.source: If you can manage that, the Dawnguard may still have use for you.

plugin.target: 你可以給我血咒箭嗎？

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 我瞭解你為了我還有瑟拉娜做的事情。但是我一直不喜歡那預言，我也不想參與其中。抱歉了。

plugin.source: I knew you had it in you! Arkay wasn't so sure. Between you and me, I think he didn't expect you to make it.
plugin.target: 我就知道你很可靠。阿爾凱對你就沒那麼有信心了。偷偷跟你說，他原本不認為你會成功的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But not me! I knew it all along!
plugin.target: 但是我可沒那麼想！我自始至終都相信你。

plugin.source: I'd like to treat some arrows with your blood.
plugin.target: 我想要把你的血塗在我的箭上。

plugin.source: I think you'll need to find some arrows first. Only Elven ones will work for this, remember?

plugin.source: So I am. I guess we could use my blood. Do you have any arrows? Elven arrows? I'm not going to just bleed on any old thing.
plugin.target: 沒錯，我們可以用我的血液。你身上有箭嗎？必須是精靈的，我可不打算把我的血用在隨便一支箭上。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That I am. So I'm guessing you want to just use my blood, then?
plugin.target: 我是。所以你只是想用我的血？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Let's just get this over with. Do you have any Elven arrows?
plugin.target: 要就快吧。你有精靈箭嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Can I use your blood, then?
plugin.target: 那麼，我可以用你的血液嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you were anybody else, I'd probably be taking some blood from you for asking that.
plugin.target: 如果你是別人的話，光是那樣問，我可能就會吸乾你的血了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You wouldn't like it.
plugin.target: 你不會喜歡的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I can see this having its uses. Do you have any Elven arrows on you?
plugin.target: 我看得出來這有好處。你身上有精靈箭嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Killing their leaders should discourage them from an out and out war with us.

plugin.source: Good.

plugin.source: Never.

plugin.source: Very well, then. You leave me no choice!

plugin.source: Let's run as far from him as we can.

plugin.source: Well, don't just stand there. Go find me another Steward.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm sure there's plenty of people in Raven Rock to choose from.

plugin.source: Well, find her. Tell her I want apple cabbage stew, with some canis root tea.
plugin.target: 去找她啊。告訴她我想要喝一碗蘋果捲心菜湯，搭配犬根茶。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where is that ash sucking Steward of mine? Varona!

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 給我點時間。我腦中還有尼洛施大師把你變形時的殘像。

plugin.source: Sometimes being Master Neloth's apprentice is... painful.

plugin.source: One day I will inherit his power. It will all be mine. Mark my words.

plugin.source: I heard you paid my debt to Mogrul. I don't know how I can ever repay you.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Do you need all your toes? I could really use a fresh toe for... nevermind. You aren't moldy enough.

plugin.source: It was fascinating to watch those tentacles grow out of your eyes.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Miraak was a formidable opponent. I wonder what he would have been like as my apprentice?
plugin.target: 秘拉克是非常優秀的對手。他要是當我的學徒不知道會怎麼樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've found you a new Steward.
plugin.target: 我替你找到了新的管家。

plugin.source: That Drovas man?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I suppose he'll do. He makes dreadful canis root tea, though.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I should be grateful. Here, take this for your efforts.
plugin.target: 不過，我應該感激你。來，這是你的酬勞。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 對了，你要的話可以使用我的法杖附魔器。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Uh... you mean leave Raven Rock? For good? To go work for a crazed Telvanni wizard?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: On second thought, nevermind. I can get new stuff.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you nuts?

plugin.source: Don't be ridiculous. Who would run this place?

plugin.source: Ask around at The Retching Netch.
plugin.target: 你應該去嘔吐氣母問問。

plugin.source: Someone there might be crazy enough, or drunk enough, to do it.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Nah. I don't think so.

plugin.target: 再說，他應該只要丹莫吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 我之前每早起來手都磨破長繭，我現在終於知道為什麼了。你為我做的，我心懷感激。

plugin.source: Traveling beyond The Bulwark will be much safer as a result of your victory at Fort Frostmoth. Many thanks.

plugin.source: If you're looking to buy, then I'm looking to sell.

plugin.source: Miserable... just miserable. Oh, I hate this place.

plugin.target: 或許我的壽命不像暗精靈那麼長，但至少我沒有離棄自己的家園。

plugin.target: 我們這裡販售最道地的暗精靈食物跟飲料。吉迪思只提供最好的品質。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mogrul doesn't lend coin to outlanders. Look somewhere else.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It was in Ildari Sarothril's grave.
plugin.target: 在伊達利·撒洛西里的墓裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 伊達利？原來是我的錯。在塔瓦斯之前，她曾經是我的學徒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: She volunteered for one of my experiments involving heart stones.

plugin.source: It was quite annoying when she died.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm not sure the dragons are about you.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Really? When this is over, you'll have to tell me about it.
plugin.target: 真的嗎？等這些結束，你一定要跟我詳細說明。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I saw a dragon once.
plugin.target: 我曾經看過龍。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: How do you know you are under attack?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Ash spawn keep appearing.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 而且我的塔樓有一部分在某個夜晚突然枯萎。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Then my Steward was killed. You had to find me a replacement.
plugin.target: 接著我的管家被暗殺。你還得幫我找個新的。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 付他錢？為什麼？

plugin.source: Well, I might soon. Neloth does pay well.

plugin.source: Nightwielder's creations don't really hold up in comparison to what can be made today, but they have a sentimental value for me. You understand?
plugin.target: 夜舞者的創作跟現今的法杖相比已經跟不上時代了，但是它們對我來說有情感上的意義。你懂嗎？

plugin.source: I know why you're asking, Mother. I am happy here, but I want to know more of the world outside our lands.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes, Papa.

plugin.source: What did you learn from the Briarheart?
plugin.target: 你研究荊棘之心有什麼發現？

plugin.target: 相連結的靈魂絲線總共被打了三個結。一個在心臟，一個在精神，一個在身體。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I promise that any unrelated memories I run across will be kept in the strictest of confidences.
plugin.target: 我答應你，我看到任何不相關的記憶都會絕對保密。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here, you deserve a bit of a reward for your efforts... that was a lengthy trip for you, I'm sure!
plugin.target: 這裡，獎勵你的辛勞……那肯定是一趟漫長的旅程吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What do Briarhearts have to do with Heartstones?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, I'm hoping to do something similar... if I could connect a living being to the forces of the Red Mountain, well... that would be formidable.
plugin.target: 我希望可以做出相同的效果。要是我能將活體生物跟紅山的力量相結合……那樣會很強大。

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, let's not waste time talking about it, then!

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I see that new leader's coming is yet far off in the distant horizon.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 上古的知識。當造物主將索瑟海姆交給斯卡爾後，就一直由薩滿代代相傳。

plugin.target: 那是附魔過的冰，跟鐵一樣硬、跟死亡一樣冰冷。魔冰可以被製作成強大的武器，但是隻有斯卡爾的鐵匠知道如何鍛造它。

plugin.source: Until our next meeting, Skaal-friend. May your hunts always bring you game and your crops grow tall and bountiful.

plugin.target: 有，而且我也把魔冰堆資源的地圖帶來了。

plugin.source: I know you faced great danger to bring this map to me. There are no words to tell how glad my heart is. Thank you, brave one.
plugin.target: 我知道你冒了很大的危險幫我把地圖帶來。什麼話都說出我內心的感激了。謝謝你，勇者。

plugin.source: I name you friend of the Skaal, and I will trust you with the knowledge of forging stalhrim.
plugin.target: 你證明自己是斯卡爾之友，我將傳授給你熔煉魔冰的知識。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you bring stalhrim here to my forge, you can use my tools to make what you will from it.
plugin.target: 如果你把魔冰帶來我這，我允許你使用我的工具來鍛造。

plugin.source: Haggling with you can be so... entertaining.

plugin.source: Hmm. Excellent question.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Once word gets out, there will be a lot of people to choose from.
plugin.target: 話一旦傳開，會有一堆人來報名。
