plugin.source: Father, you must not do this. That book is... wrong. Evil. Against everything you have taught me my whole life.
plugin.target: 父親，請別這麼做。這本書……有問題。是邪惡的。這本書否定了我這輩子跟你所學的一切。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What is happening? You must stop it!
plugin.target: 發生什麼事了？你必須阻止他！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Go. My father sacrificed himself so you could destroy Miraak and lift his master's shadow from the land.
plugin.target: 去吧。我的父親犧牲了自己好讓你去殺秘拉克，去把他主人的影響驅離這座島嶼吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You... liar... gah! I... I won't... I won't... Not... not for you...
plugin.target: 你這個騙子！我不會……為你……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Of course! I don't even want to hear the word "barrow" again. Ever.
plugin.target: 當然！我壓根再也不想聽到“石冢”這兩個字了。永遠也不想。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'll go to Raven Rock and you... you won't mention this to anyone. If you see me there, just... give a nod and I'll lend you a hand if you need it.
plugin.target: 我會回鴉石鎮，但是你不能跟任何人提起這件事。你以後如果需要我的協助，跟我點個頭，示意一下就行了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's... it's the least I can do. Just... keep this quiet.
plugin.target: 這……這是我唯一能報答你的方式。請你保密。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I believe you. Just... don't come back here.
plugin.target: 我相信你。但是……別回來這裡了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I... I don't remember. Ever since I got here to... to Kolbjorn... I've heard whispers. Voices. Thoughts. Imaginings.
plugin.target: 我……我不記得了。從我來到寇泊榮，就一直聽到低語、聲音、想法、幻象。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They've only gotten louder since I've stayed. Pounding, driving. A couple of times I blacked out. It was...
plugin.target: 待的時間越久，聲音就越大聲，不斷地衝擊我。有幾次我甚至昏迷了。這是……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It was just before the draugr woke up.
plugin.target: 這都是屍鬼醒來之前發生的事。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What's going on here?
plugin.target: 這裡發生什麼事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, don't just stand there! Go deal with the draugr while I try to hold the survivors together.
plugin.target: 別光是站在那裡看啊！你去處理屍鬼，我負責安撫生還者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm still working on it.
plugin.target: 我還在努力。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good. I'm glad I can count on you, at least.
plugin.target: 很好。我就知道還能指望你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I think we're almost to the bottom of the Barrow, but... it's going to be everything I can do to find more miners.
plugin.target: 我們就快抵達石冢的底部了，但是我得找到更多的挖掘工才能繼續挖下去。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've... developed quite the reputation. But for enough gold... I can do it. Just barely.
plugin.target: 雖然我們已經聲名狼藉了，不過只要給我足夠的錢，應該勉勉強強還能找到人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: All the draugr are dead.
plugin.target: 所有的屍鬼都死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: That's good. But until we can account for all the miners, I won't be able to recruit more. Keep searching. It should be safe now.
plugin.target: 很好。不過我得先知道所有工人的下落，才能召募新的人手。你繼續找吧，裡面應該安全了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've dealt with the draugr.
plugin.target: 我把屍鬼都解決掉了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I should have figured. Damn.
plugin.target: 我就知道。該死的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, at least we can get back to work. But hazard pay keeps piling up, and this won't be getting any cheaper.
plugin.target: 至少我們可以復工了。但是危險津貼的金額不斷攀升，這次又要花一大筆錢了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm going to hire some mercenaries this time too. Having some people around who know how to fight should...
plugin.target: 這次我還打算僱一些傭兵，在身邊留一些知道如何戰鬥的人……
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, it'll set the miners at ease. And hopefully keep them alive. But they won't be cheap either.
plugin.target: 那樣挖掘工人會比較安心，也能讓他們保住性命。但那又是一筆龐大開銷。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's going to hit three thousand this time, I'm afraid. Have you got that on you?
plugin.target: 這回恐怕要三千金幣。你身上有那麼多錢嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've defeated the draugr and located the missing miners. They're dead.
plugin.target: 我擊敗了屍鬼並且找到失蹤的挖掘工。他們都死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Draugr again. I mean, we should have expected it, right? What else do you find in these damn crypts, but waves and waves of draugr?
plugin.target: 又是屍鬼。我是說……這應該是可以預見的吧？在這些該死的墓穴裡，除了一波又一波的屍鬼之外還會有什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: At least six of the diggers are dead. The rest of them ran off, and I don't blame them.
plugin.target: 已經死了至少六個挖掘工。其他人都跑了，但是我一點都不怪他們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've had some luck with these things before. Do you think you could... go back in? See if anyone's still alive?
plugin.target: 你知道怎麼應付這種情況。你可以……回去裡面嗎？看看還有沒有人生還？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What is it this time?
plugin.target: 這次又如何了？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, that's a start. Unless there's some way past that dead end, though, we're still stuck here.
plugin.target: 至少是個開始。不過我們必須找到方法穿過那條死路，否則就卡住了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've dealt with the draugr.
plugin.target: 我把屍鬼都解決掉了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, perhaps there's some hope for us yet.
plugin.target: 嗯。看來我們還有希望。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now, I have to go recruit some more miners... it won't be easy, seeing as none of their friends came back from the first attempt.
plugin.target: 我現在必須僱用新的挖掘工……但這有難度，畢竟其他工人也知道自己的朋友都命喪黃泉了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We'll have to sweeten the pot a bit, this time. I think I'll need... say, two thousand septims to hire replacements.
plugin.target: 我們必須拿點誠意出來。我想我需要差不多……兩千金幣來僱用新的工人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've dealt with the draugr and found a way past the dead end.
plugin.target: 我處理掉那些屍鬼了，而且也找到方法穿過死路。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You ever hear of Ahzidal?
plugin.target: 你有聽過阿季達嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He was the first great Nord enchanter, maybe even the first human to master Elven methods.
plugin.target: 他是諾德族的第一個偉大附魔師。或許也是第一個精通精靈之術的人類。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: His best work was buried with him, though. A set that my patron calls "the Relics" are supposed to be down in his tomb.
plugin.target: 但是他的傑作都跟他一起被埋起來了。有一系列被我的贊助者稱為“聖物”，聽說就在他的墓穴裡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now, they're old, and they're powerful. A combination like that makes them pretty valuable to certain people, and I happen to know certain people.
plugin.target: 那東西雖然古老，但力量強大。這樣的特質在特定人士眼中價值連城，而我剛好認識某些這樣的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: So what's this treasure you were after?
plugin.target: 你在找什麼寶物？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Don't insult me. You don't have nearly enough for this to be worth my time, or yours.
plugin.target: （失敗）別侮辱我了。你那點錢根本買不起我的時間，連你自己都嫌少吧？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Here's a little gold for your tale. (<BribeCost> gold)
plugin.target: 這筆錢給你，把故事說完吧。（賄賂<BribeCost> 金幣）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've wasted enough of my time already. Just... just let me be.
plugin.target: （失敗）你已經浪費我太多時間了。請你走開。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Spare me the walk. Just tell me. (Persuade)
plugin.target: 不要讓我白跑一趟嘛。就告訴我嘛。（說服）
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's Ralis' problem now.
plugin.target: 就讓雷利思傷腦筋吧。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Geldis put you up to this? Another adventurer without a coin to his name? Dammit, I told him not to waste any more of my time.
plugin.target: 是吉迪思叫你來的嗎？又一個分無分文的投機者嗎？該死的，我都叫他別再浪費我的時間了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Are you going to be able to lead this place still?
plugin.target: 你還有辦法率領這些人嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Whoa. Not so close.
plugin.target: 哇哦。別靠太近。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Good idea. They might leak out. Don't want them crawling into your head too. Like me. They're in my head. Right now. Saying things.
plugin.target: 好主意。它們可能會溢位去。別讓它們爬進你的頭裡。就像我這樣。它們在我腦袋裡。現在正在說話。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Hello.
plugin.target: 你好。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The secrets. They're in my head. I can't get them out.
plugin.target: 那些秘密。它們在我的腦袋裡。我拿不出來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Can anyone hear me? I am a prisoner of the Thalmor. Help!
plugin.target: 有人聽到我說話嗎？我被梭默監禁了。救命！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Please, someone help me!
plugin.target: 救命，誰來救我！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Why would someone want to kidnap Baldor?
plugin.target: 為什麼有人要綁架保德？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, there is one reason that comes to mind.
plugin.target: 嗯，我只想得到一個原因。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Baldor is the keeper of an ancient tradition, the forging of stalhrim. It is an art we Skaal hold sacred.
plugin.target: 保德是一項古老傳統的守護者，也就是魔冰的熔煉方式。對我們斯卡爾而言那項技藝是神聖的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If someone wanted to make such weapons, they would have to get that knowledge from Baldor.
plugin.target: 如果有人想要製作那種武器，他們必須通過保德取得那知識。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What did she do with the prisoners?
plugin.target: 她對囚犯做了什麼事？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Horrible things. Experiments... and worse.
plugin.target: 很恐怖。除了實驗之外……還有更糟的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm the last one. The others are all dead now.
plugin.target: 我是最後一個了。其他人都死了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: If you find her, don't make her end quick.
plugin.target: 要是你找到她的話，別讓她死得太快。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We should check these rooms for supplies before going forth.
plugin.target: 我們繼續前進之前應該檢視房間裡有沒有物資。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We will have that stalhrim, and there's nothing you can do to stop us!
plugin.target: 我們遲早會拿到魔冰。你無法阻止我們的！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Take your time. I shall follow you when you are ready.
plugin.target: 你慢慢來。等你準備好我就會跟著你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There's an intruder in the fort! Repel the invader immediately!
plugin.target: 有人闖入堡壘。立刻將他驅離！
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You will stop... whatever that was - so that the evil does not swallow the Skaal like it did Storn?
plugin.target: 你會阻止那個東西吧？千萬不能讓那股邪惡力量吞噬史東以後，還繼續吞噬整個斯卡爾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I don't understand. I... I thought the village was safe. What are we going to do now?
plugin.target: 我無法理解。我以為村莊是安全的。我們現在該怎麼辦？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh?
plugin.target: 嗯？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Since the Severin family... or whoever they were... turned out to be criminals, their property is now forfeit.
plugin.target: 既然瑟佛林家……雖然應該也是化名……被揭穿是罪犯，他們的財產已被全數充公。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As Councilor, I hereby award you Severin Manor and everything contained within.
plugin.target: 身為議員，我在此將瑟佛林的宅邸以及裡面的所有物品賜予你。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You've earned your citizenship here, and I hope you'll consider staying with us as a member of our community.
plugin.target: 你獲得了公民權，希望你願意留下來加入我們這個大家庭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Thank you, Councilor.
plugin.target: 謝謝你，議員。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You wanted to speak to me, Councilor?
plugin.target: 你想找我談話嗎，議員？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: They did it to gain our confidence, Councilor. They had us all fooled.
plugin.target: 他們那樣做是為了騙取我們的信任，議員。他們騙了所有人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I should have been more vigilant. I'm sorry.
plugin.target: 我應該更有警覺心的，我很抱歉。

plugin.source: Of course, this is all just theory and conjecture. It is likely we will never know the truth.

plugin.source: How did you end up on Solstheim?

plugin.source: Long story, but I don't see the harm in sharing it with you.

plugin.target: 我前一個僱主是一個真正的諾德人。他身穿動物毛皮、臉上有紋刺……是一個傳統的傢伙，這樣說你應該懂。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: He had an insatiable bloodlust and was extremely stubborn... one of the toughest employers I've ever had.
plugin.target: 他那人嗜血若狂而且非常固執……是我遇到過最剽悍的僱主之一。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm not chasing that map. It's a fool's errand. I'm done. Leave me alone.
plugin.target: 我不要去找那張地圖。只有白痴才會那樣做。我不要了。離我遠點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What happened to the mine?

plugin.source: It used to be one of the richest ebony mines in Morrowind, but it dried out years ago.
plugin.target: 這裡曾經是晨風省最豐富的黑檀礦產地，只是幾年前被挖空了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now, we're barely holding out here. Without the mine, Raven Rock doesn't feel like it can last much longer.
plugin.target: 我們現在也是在苦苦撐著。少了礦坑，鴉石鎮應該也撐不了多久了。

plugin.source: The giant air-floaters from the Dark Elf lands. Only the brave dare to hunt them, only the strong survive them.
plugin.target: 那是生長在暗精靈土地上的巨大飄浮生物。只有勇者才敢獵殺他們，也只有強者才能免於一死。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Come. Test yourself against the beast with us. We all will share in the glory of the hunt!
plugin.target: 來吧。加入我們面對野獸。我們將一同分享狩獵的榮耀。

plugin.source: Surprised you've never heard of it.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's an island northeast of here. Has a small Dark Elf town called Raven Rock and a handful of Nords living in Skaal Village.
plugin.target: 那是一座島，位在這裡的東北方。島上有一個暗精靈城鎮叫做鴉石鎮，還有一群諾德人住在斯卡爾村。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: But I'm not going back there. There's something wrong about that place.
plugin.target: 但是我不想要回去那裡。那個地方很不對勁。

plugin.source: What can you tell me about Morrowind?
plugin.target: 關於晨風，你可以告訴我什麼？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You are too young to remember the Nerevarine. Defeated Dagoth Ur and saved us all from the blight.
plugin.target: 你還太年輕了，不會記得尼瑞瓦因。他擊敗達格斯·烏爾，拯救我們免受那場疫病風暴危害。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: There is the big island of Vvardenfell, and the coastal mainland.
plugin.target: 主要是由一座叫做瓦登費爾的大型島嶼，以及沿岸的內陸所組成。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: House Telvanni has its properties on Vvardenfell. I've never been to the mainland myself.
plugin.target: 泰爾瓦尼家族定居在瓦登費爾。我自己則從未到過內陸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's the homeland of the Dunmer. The lesser races call us Dark Elves.
plugin.target: 那是丹莫的家鄉。那些次等種族稱我們為暗精靈。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We built great works there, like Vivec and Ald'ruhn. Many of them are destroyed now, either by Red Mountain or the Argonian invasion.
plugin.target: 我們在那裡建立了幾座大城，像是維威克城跟奧德魯恩。現在大多已經被摧毀了，不是被紅山爆發就是被亞龍人襲擊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Oh, you better get used to this, Drovas. This isn't that unusual for Tel Mithryn.
plugin.target: 你最好習慣這一切，朵瓦士。這在泰爾密希臨都是很尋常的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Unearthly screams?

plugin.source: What have I gotten myself into?

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Once I've got stalhrim, how do I forge it into something useful?
plugin.target: 我拿到魔冰後，要如何把它融煉成有用的東西？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With skill and patience. It's very much like working ebony.
plugin.target: 你要有技巧跟耐心。就跟處理黑檀礦一樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Yes... I'd say if you know how to forge ebony, then you know everything you need to know in order to forge stalhrim.
plugin.target: 嗯……如果你懂得如何融煉黑檀礦，那你就知道如何融煉魔冰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Where can I obtain stalhrim?
plugin.target: 我在哪裡可以找到魔冰？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: You can find some in Raven Rock Mine, as well as that new source of stalhrim on the map you recovered from the elves.
plugin.target: 你在鴉石鎮礦場可以找到一些。另外你從精靈那邊拿到的魔冰地圖也會告訴你新的資源在哪。

plugin.source: Just be sure to bring an ancient Nord pickaxe with you. It's the only pickaxe that can mine the stalhrim properly without breaking it.
plugin.target: 記得身上要帶一把古代諾德鶴嘴鋤就是了。只有使用這種鶴嘴鋤才能採集魔冰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tell me about forging stalhrim.
plugin.target: 告訴我如何融煉魔冰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Well, first you'll need to obtain some stalhrim, of course, and then you'll need to work it.

plugin.source: Apparently there's a strange jester near the Loreius Farm, on the road north of Whiterun. It would seem he's transporting a coffin in a cart, but one of the wheels has broken off. It might be worth investigating.
plugin.target: 在白漫城北部道路邊上的羅瑞尤斯農場附近，有一個奇怪的小丑。他好像在用一個貨車運送一具棺材，但其中一個輪子壞掉了。這事可以去調查一下。

plugin.source: I met a strange jester named Cicero, who is transporting his mother's coffin. One of the wheels of Cicero's wagon has broken off, and he wants me to ask a farmer named Loreius for help.
plugin.target: 我遇到了一個名叫西塞羅的奇怪小丑，他正在運送他母親的棺材。西塞羅貨車的一個輪子壞掉了，他要我去請求一個名叫羅瑞尤斯的農夫的幫助。

plugin.source: Astrid, of the Dark Brotherhood, informed me that by killing Grelod the Kind, I have robbed her organization of a kill. I have been taken captive and moved to some remote shack. Astrid will only give me the key if I kill someone she has taken captive, to "repay my debt."
plugin.target: 阿斯垂德，一名黑暗兄弟會成員，她告訴我說殺了慈祥桂羅那類人，等於搶走她組織的一個暗殺物件。之後我就被俘虜了，被轉移到一個遙遠的小屋裡。只有我當殺了另一個阿斯垂德抓來的人並“償還我的債務”後，她才會給我鑰匙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have killed one of the captives as Astrid instructed, and must now gain entrance to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, which is located in the southern Pine Forest. Astrid has provided me with the correct passphrase - "Silence, my Brother."

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have killed an innocent person, gained entrance into the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and been officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood by Astrid. There's no turning back now.

plugin.source: Maven Black-Briar has sent me to Whiterun where I am to meet with someone named Mallus Maccius. Together, our goal is to bring down one of Maven's competitors, Honningbrew Meadery and discover where he obtained the financing to take her on.
plugin.target: 瑪雯·黑棘派我去白漫城見一個叫莫魯斯·馬修斯的人。我們的目的是一起扳倒瑪雯的一個競爭對手，蜜之釀酒莊，並且找出他資金的來源。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've become a key component in a cunning plan to frame Honningbrew Meadery's owner, Sabjorn, and have him imprisoned. The first part of the scheme is to approach Sabjorn under the guise of assistance with a pest problem he's having thanks to Mallus' tinkering.
plugin.target: 計劃是栽贓蜜之釀酒莊的老闆撒佈喬恩並把他關進監獄，而我是計劃的關鍵部分。計劃的第一部分是首先以幫助解決害蟲問題的藉口接近撒佈喬恩，幫他搞定莫魯斯搗出的小亂子。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sabjorn has provided me with poison I'm to apply to the nests deep within the tunnels under Honningbrew Meadery. As Mallus predicted, I should be able to use the very same poison to taint Sabjorn's mead as well.
plugin.target: 撒佈喬恩給了我毒藥，叫我放在蜜之釀酒莊下方管道深處的巢穴裡。而莫魯斯認為我也可以把這些毒藥拿去汙染撒佈喬恩的蜜酒。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The plan worked perfectly and Whiterun's Captain of the Guard was stricken with illness when he drank the poisoned mead. Sabjorn's been carted off to jail and Honningbrew Meadery is now closed.
plugin.target: 計劃進行得很完美，白漫城的衛兵隊長喝了酒之後感到十分不舒服。撒佈喬恩被關到監獄裡，蜜之釀酒莊也被迫關閉。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Now that Mallus' position as the owner of Honningbrew Meadery has been secured, I need to find any information explaining how Sabjorn was able to fund this costly operation.
plugin.target: 現在莫魯斯在蜜之釀酒莊的地位已經得到了鞏固，我需要找到任何可以解釋撒佈喬恩資金來源的資訊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The information I obtained from Honningbrew Meadery points to the same anonymous buyer of Goldenglow Estate. If successful, this individual would have completely estranged Maven Black-Briar from the Guild and destroyed it economically. It's becoming painfully obvious that it's time to shed some light on our mysterious adversary before they have a chance to strike again.
plugin.target: 我從蜜之釀酒莊獲得的訊息指向了金色光輝莊園的一個匿名買家。如果成功的話，這個人甚至可以把瑪雯·黑棘和公會徹底隔絕開來，並且摧毀公會的經濟來源。看來我們必須要先找出這個神秘敵人的真實身份，再進行下一次行動。

plugin.source: The tables have unexpectedly turned, and Mercer Frey has been revealed as Gallus' killer. I now find myself in Karliah's care after Mercer tried to murder me, claiming I'd outlasted my usefulness by witnessing their conversation. I've also discovered that Mercer, Gallus, and Karliah were members of some sort of group calling themselves "The Nightingales" - guardians in service to the goddess Nocturnal. What they're protecting or what this has to do with the Guild is still a mystery to me.
plugin.target: 情況有了巨大的轉變，墨瑟·弗雷似乎才是殺死加盧斯的兇手。在發現墨瑟準備殺死我之後，我發現我根本是被卡莉亞算計了，因為只有我聽到了他們之間的對話我才能為卡莉亞作證。我發現墨瑟、加盧斯和卡莉亞都是一個叫做“夜鶯”的組織的前成員，他們為諾克圖娜爾女神服務。他們保護的目標以及與公會的關係對我來說還是個謎。

plugin.source: I've learned that Septimus Signus, a preeminent scholar of the Elder Scrolls, is currently living in the far north, studying a Dwarven artifact. He might know where I can find an Elder Scroll.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Septimus Signus, a brilliant but mad scholar living in the northern ice fields. He's directed me to a dwarven observatory that supposedly houses an Elder Scroll. He doesn't care about the Scroll itself, but wants me to use some kind of machine there to inscribe a dwarven lexicon with the Scroll's knowledge and bring it to him.
plugin.target: 我見到了塞普汀默斯·希格諾斯，他是個聰明但是有些瘋狂的學者，住在北方的冰原。他指導我進入一個可能儲存有上古卷軸的矮人天文臺。他關心的不是卷軸本身，而是想要我使用那裡的某個機器刻寫出一本關於卷軸知識的矮人典籍出來並且帶給他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Septimus Signus and brought him a dwarven lexicon containing the distilled knowledge of an Elder Scroll. With it, he believes he can open the lockbox he's been studying. He will contact me when he has the secret.
plugin.target: 我見到了塞普汀默斯·希格諾斯並且把帶有上古卷軸學識的矮人方典帶給了他。有了它，他認為自己可以開啟之前一直在研究的矮人寶箱。他會在找到開啟方法後聯絡我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Septimus Signus and brought him a dwarven lexicon containing the distilled knowledge of an Elder Scroll. With it, he believes he can open the lockbox he's been studying by creating a mixture of blood that will resemble dwarven. I need to collect blood from several different races if I want to help him.
plugin.target: 我見到了塞普汀默斯·希格諾斯並且把帶有上古卷軸學識的矮人方典帶給了他。有了它，他認為只要能夠製造出類似矮人血液的混合物，他就可以開啟之前一直在研究的矮人寶箱。我需要收集不同種族的血液來幫助他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met a strange hermit named Septimus Signus, who needed the knowledge of an Elder Scroll and a collection of blood to open a dwarven lockbox he had studied for years. I helped him open it. It did not contain what he had expected, but instead a book of great knowledge, the Oghma Infinium.
plugin.target: 我見到了一個古怪的隱士，叫做塞普汀默斯·希格諾斯，他需要用上古卷軸的知識和一些血液樣本來開啟他研究了數年的矮人寶箱。我幫助他打開了它。內容物並非如他所想，而是一本蘊含了大量知識的書籍，無限智典。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir knew the name of the Shout, "Dragonrend", but could not teach it to me. However, he has agreed to show me the way to reach Paarthurnax, the Greybeards' leader, who lives at the top of the Throat of the World. plugin.source: The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants, and have been forbidden to leave their stronghold. Atub, the wise woman of the tribe, has asked me to find her troll fat and a Daedra heart so that she may contact Malacath for guidance.
plugin.target: 拉加施布林的獸人正受到巨人們攻擊，並被禁止離開他們的要塞。阿圖布，部落的女智者請求我幫她找到巨魔脂肪和一顆魔族之心，以便她聯絡瑪拉凱斯尋求指引。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Malacath has spoken to his followers and expressed disappointment in them. He is angry they allowed his shrine to be desecrated, and has commanded the chieftain of Largashbur, Yamarz, to return to the shrine and reclaim it.
plugin.target: 瑪拉凱斯對他的追隨者表達了不滿。他很生氣他的祭壇被玷汙了。他指示拉加施布林的部落酋長亞馬茲奪回它。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Despite being specifically instructed by Malacath to see to it himself, Yamarz wants my help in defeating the giants that have overrun Fallowstone Cave and the shrine of Malacath. He's promised to pay me in exchange for making sure he arrives there safely.
plugin.target: 儘管被瑪拉凱斯明言下令，亞馬茲還是希望我幫他打敗巨人並奪回法羅石洞穴和瑪拉凱斯祭壇。他答應只要我保證他安全到達祭壇，就給我報酬。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. Now he has offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, to which I have agreed.
plugin.target: 在被瑪拉凱斯命令奪回法羅石洞穴裡的祭壇後，亞馬茲堅持要我護送他安全抵達。現在他提議只要我能親手殺死巨人，他願意付額外的報酬。而我答應了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. He offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, but I declined. Yamarz died trying to fight the giant, so I suppose it's up to me now.
plugin.target: 拉加施布林獸人的詛咒解除了。部落領袖亞馬茲在瑪拉凱斯眼裡很無能，我用打敗巨人和奪回法羅石洞穴祭壇彌補了他的過失。瑪拉凱斯任命了古拉佐伯為新酋長，而我則是部落的新勇士。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After escorting Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and proving myself more worthy, Malacath has commanded me to return to Largashbur and deliver Shagrol's Hammer there.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The curse placed on the Orcs of Largashbur is lifted. Malacath has named Gularzob as the new chief, and has named me his new champion.

plugin.source: Arniel has finally revealed to me that his secret project deals with the disappearance of the dwarves, though he hasn't been clear about how his work relates to it. He's given me a warped soul gem, and asked me to find several Dwarven convectors in the various ruins around Skyrim. I'm supposed to place the gem inside a convector, and then heat it using a spell Arniel has taught me. When I've done this several times, I should return the gem to Arniel.

plugin.source: In Reachwater Rock, I found a cryptic message that said the tomb here had been sealed, and should be forgotten forever. What is the story of this place?
plugin.target: 我在觸水巖找到了一條神秘的訊息，聲稱這個墓穴已經被封印了，應該被人們永久地遺忘。這裡面有什麼秘密嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Folgunthur, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
plugin.target: 在佛古恩瑟，我在一個強大的屍鬼的屍體身上發現了一條神秘的訊息，譴責了它所犯下的先古的罪孽。它到底做了什麼事？為什麼它會被和一條破碎的項鍊埋葬在一起？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The entire incident was covered up, their names struck from every record. But the legend survived. Perhaps someone still knows the truth of this ancient tale.
plugin.target: 很久以前，大法師高爾多遭到謀殺，他的三個兒子也分別被哈拉爾德國王的御用戰鬥法師們獵殺。然而，這整起事件都被掩蓋，他們的名字被從每一條記錄上抹消。但是，傳說依舊延續著。也許總有一天，某個人能夠揭開這則古老傳說的真相。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The mage Daynas Valen spent his life searching for the truth of this tale, and came to Folgunthur with the key needed to unlock its secret.
plugin.target: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我打敗了三兄弟並且找回了項鍊的碎片。也許高爾多的墓穴裡埋藏著如何將這些碎片還原的秘密。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. The brothers were hunted down in secret and sealed in tombs across Skyrim. To reclaim the amulet, I will need to seek out their final resting places.
plugin.target: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。這三兄弟均被秘密地獵殺了，並且封鎖在了天際各地的墓穴裡。為了找回項鍊，我必須找到他們的長眠之地。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the brothers and reclaimed the fragments of the amulet. Perhaps Gauldur's tomb holds the secret to restoring it to its original form.
plugin.target: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我打敗了三兄弟的不死身軀，找到了項鍊的碎片，並在高爾多的墓穴裡重鑄了項鍊。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我找回了項鍊的碎片並且帶到了高爾多的墓穴，而在那裡我遭到了三兄弟的幽靈埋伏。

plugin.source: Serana and I have entered the Soul Cairn in pursuit of her estranged mother, Valerica, and the Elder Scroll she took when she fled Castle Volkihar.
plugin.target: 瑟拉娜跟我進入了靈魂石冢來找尋她分離多時的母親瓦蕾莉卡，以及她母親逃離弗基哈爾城堡時所帶走的上古卷軸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Serana and I have located Valerica imprisoned within a massive ruin. When confronted by us, Valerica revealed that Serana's blood is an integral part of the Tyranny of the Sun. After the reconciliation between the two of them, Valerica confessed to having the Elder Scroll hidden in her ramshackle living space. In order to free her from the prison, Serana and I will have to locate and slay the Keepers who maintain the barrier around the ruins.
plugin.target: 瑟拉娜跟我找到了瓦蕾莉卡，她被關在一座巨大的廢墟中。當我們跟她對質時，瓦蕾莉卡透露瑟拉娜的血是終結太陽霸權的關鍵之一。母女倆重修舊好後，瓦蕾莉卡承認上古卷軸就藏在她目前搖搖欲墜的監禁處中。為了將她釋放出來，我跟瑟拉娜必須找到並且擊殺維持防護罩的守護者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Serana and I have slain all three of the Keepers and the barrier around Valerica's prison has faded. We rejoined Valerica, who has agreed to take us to the location where the Elder Scroll is hidden.
plugin.target: 瑟拉娜跟我殺了三隻守護者後，瓦蕾莉卡監獄外圍的防護罩就消失了。我們與瓦蕾莉卡會合後，她答應要帶我們前往儲存著上古卷軸的地點。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: As Valerica was leading us to the Elder Scroll, an ancient dragon named Durnehviir swooped into the ruins and attacked. It proved to be a challenging battle, but we've emerged unscathed.
plugin.target: 在瓦蕾莉卡帶我們去拿上古卷軸的途中，一頭叫做度尼維爾的遠古巨龍突然衝進廢墟對我們展開攻擊。戰鬥非常具有挑戰性，但是我們平安撐過去了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: We've exited the Soul Cairn with the Elder Scroll in hand. Serana's mother, Valerica, is unwilling to return with us to Tamriel until we've dealt with her husband and thwarted the Tyranny of the Sun.
plugin.target: 我們帶著上古卷軸離開靈魂石冢。瑟拉娜的母親，瓦蕾莉卡，不願意跟我們回到泰姆瑞爾，除非我們解決掉她的丈夫並阻止他終結太陽的霸權。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've encountered Gelebor, a snow elf Knight-Paladin of the Chantry of Auri-El. He's requesting I kill his brother, Arch-Curate Vyrthur, who's been corrupted by the Falmer. I've been given an Initiate's Ewer which will ultimately provide me access to the Chantry's Inner Sanctum where both Arch-Curate Vyrthur and Auriel's Bow are located.
plugin.target: 我遇到了雪精靈蓋雷伯，他是奧瑞-艾爾聖殿的聖殿騎士。他要求我殺了他被伐莫腐化的兄弟，大祭司-維阿瑟。我拿到的入門生執壺可以引領我進入聖殿的內部聖所。大祭司-維阿瑟跟奧麗瑞的弓都會在裡面等著我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've completely filled the Initiate's Ewer given to me by Knight-Paladin Gelebor. All that remains is gaining access to the Chantry's Inner Sanctum where both Arch-Curate Vyrthur and Auriel's Bow are located.
plugin.target: 我已經將聖殿騎士蓋雷伯給我的入門生執壺填滿。我現在只需要進入聖殿的內部聖所就行了。大祭司-維阿瑟跟奧麗瑞的弓都會在裡面等著我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've gained access to the Chantry's Inner Sanctum. I should find and confront Arch-Curate Vyrthur in order to secure Auriel's Bow.
plugin.target: 我已可進入聖殿的內部聖所。我必須找到並且擊敗大祭司-維阿瑟來拿到奧麗瑞的弓。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: It's been revealed to me that the Tyranny of the Sun was created by Arch-Curate Vyrthur as his revenge upon Auriel for rebuking him when he was turned into a vampire. He possessed Auriel's Bow, but still needed the blood of a pure vampire to complete his ritual. This placed Serana in mortal danger, and I had no choice but to destroy him. I now possess the final piece of the Tyranny of the Sun, Auriel's Bow.
plugin.target: 我得知太陽霸權預言是大祭司-維阿瑟一手捏造，目的是報復奧麗瑞在他變成吸血鬼時的離棄。他雖然擁有奧麗瑞的弓，但是還需要純種吸血鬼的血才能完成儀式。瑟拉娜因此陷入致命的危機，我不得不殺死他。我現在獲得了實現太陽霸權預言的最後一塊拼圖，也就是奧麗瑞的弓。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: While exploring Dimhollow Crypt, I freed a young woman from an ancient sarcophagus. She asked me to guide her home, to a castle off the northern coast of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 我在探索幽窟地穴的時候把一名年輕的女人從古老的石棺中救出來。她請求我帶她回家，是一座位在天際北方海岸附近的城堡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I learned that the mysterious woman I freed from Dimhollow Crypt is named Serana. Her father Harkon is a powerful Vampire Lord, and in gratitude for bringing his daughter home, he offered me the gift of his blood. Now I must choose whether to accept the gift.
plugin.target: 我得知我從幽窟地穴救出的神秘女子叫做瑟拉娜。她的父親哈孔是一名強大的吸血鬼領主。為了表達我帶他女兒回家的感謝之意，他願意賜予我他的血作為禮物。我現在必須選擇是否要接受這份禮物。

plugin.source: When I returned to Castle Volkihar, Lord Harkon told me of a prophecy hidden in the Elder Scrolls that, if fulfilled, would end the tyranny of the sun over vampires. Now he has asked me to join him as he makes a proclamation to the court.
plugin.target: 我回到弗基哈爾城堡的時候，哈孔領主告訴我上古卷軸中隱藏著一則預言。若實現的話，將能終結太陽對吸血鬼的霸權。他要我跟他一起去將這件事宣告給他的宮廷成員。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Eager to unlock the secrets of an ancient prophecy thought to be hidden within Serana's Elder Scroll, Harkon has ordered his court to find a Moth Priest.
plugin.target: 哈孔認為古老的秘密隱藏在瑟拉娜手上的那本上古卷軸中。他為了儘速將秘密解開，因此命令他的宮廷成員找尋一名先祖蛾祭司。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Eager to unlock the secrets of an ancient prophecy thought to be hidden within Serana's Elder Scroll, Harkon has ordered his court to find a Moth Priest. I now have reason to suspect that there's a Moth Priest in Solitude.
plugin.target: 哈孔急迫地想要解鎖隱藏在上古卷軸的古老預言。他命令他的宮廷找回一名先祖蛾祭司。我有足夠的理由來懷疑一名先祖蛾祭司就在獨孤城中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I learned that a Moth Priest recently visited Solitude. He was thought to have stayed at the Winking Skeever.
plugin.target: 我得知一名先祖蛾祭司近期內曾拜訪過獨孤城。聽說他在眨眼惡鼠住宿過。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Harkon has ordered his court to find a Moth Priest who can read Serana's Elder Scroll. I now have reason to believe that a Moth Priest has recently visited Dragon Bridge.
plugin.target: 哈孔命令他的宮廷找到一名先祖蛾祭司來閱讀瑟拉娜的上古卷軸。我有足夠的理由來懷疑一名先祖蛾祭司近期內曾拜訪過龍橋鎮。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Harkon has ordered his court to find a Moth Priest who can read Serana's Elder Scroll. I followed the trail to Dragon Bridge and learned that a Moth Priest had just passed through town. He was last seen heading south along the road.
plugin.target: 哈孔命令他的宮廷找到一名先祖蛾祭司來閱讀瑟拉娜的上古卷軸。我跟著線索來到龍橋鎮並且得知一名先祖蛾祭司才剛通過城鎮。他被看到朝著南方的道路前進。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I'm one step behind the Moth Priest. After leaving Dragon Bridge, I searched along the road for any sign of his passing. I found an overturned wagon and some dead vampires and Imperial guards. Was this the Moth Priest's wagon?
plugin.target: 我距離先祖蛾祭司只有一步之遙了。離開龍橋鎮後，我沿著路尋找有關他行蹤的線索。我找到一臺翻覆的馬車，還有幾具吸血鬼跟帝國守衛的屍體。這難道是先祖蛾祭司的馬車嗎？
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Following Harkon's command to locate a Moth Priest, I followed the trail to Dragon Bridge. There, I learned that a rival band of vampires abducted the Moth Priest I've been tracking and took him to a place called Forebears' Holdout.
plugin.target: 我聽從哈孔的指令前去找尋一名先祖蛾祭司，一路追蹤到龍橋鎮。我在那裡得知一批敵對的吸血鬼擄走了我要找的先祖蛾祭司，並把他帶回一個叫做上祖洞窟的地方。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After a rival vampire faction captured the Moth Priest, I tracked them to Forebears' Holdout. Their leader has enthralled the priest and I will have to confront him in order to assert my own hold over him.
plugin.target: 敵對的吸血鬼陣營抓走了先祖蛾祭司後，被我一路追到他們的上祖洞窟。他們的領袖把祭司奴化了。我必須面對他才能讓他臣服於我。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After a rival vampire faction captured and enthralled the Moth Priest, I fought him and forced him to submit. Now it is my turn to enthrall the Moth Priest by using my newfound powers.
plugin.target: 敵對的吸血鬼陣營擄獲並且奴化了先祖蛾祭司。我擊敗了他並且強迫他投降。現在我將利用我的新能力把先祖蛾祭司轉化成我的奴僕。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Eager to hear the contents of Serana's Elder Scroll, Harkon commanded the court to find a Moth Priest. I have now captured one and made him my thrall, commanding him to return to Castle Volkihar. I must report this success to Harkon.
plugin.target: 哈孔大人急於得知瑟拉娜手中的上古卷軸內容，因此命令宮廷找到一名先祖蛾祭司。我如今抓到一個，也已將他變成我的奴僕。我命令他去往弗基哈爾城堡，我也要回到城堡向哈孔回報我的成果。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. She offered to join me in my fight to the summit, and I accepted her help.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。她願意協助我抵達高峰，我也接受她的幫忙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. She warned me that the Treasury of Arkngthamz was sealed by a dangerous tonal lock and protected by deadly traps.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。她警告我阿肯塔茲的珍藏庫被危險的調諧鎖封印住，同時也由致命的陷阱所守護。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. We made our way through the ruins and reached the summit together. There, she warned me that the Treasury of Arkngthamz was sealed by a dangerous tonal lock and protected by deadly traps.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。我們一同穿過了廢墟達到高峰。在那裡，她警告我阿肯塔茲的珍藏庫被危險的調諧鎖封印住，同時也由致命的陷阱所守護。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。通過她的協助，我成功破解了調諧鎖，找到被封印的珍藏庫廢墟。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury and found a strange glowing crystal shard within.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。通過她的協助，我成功破解了調諧鎖，也在珍藏庫的廢墟里面找到一塊散發神奇光芒的水晶裂片。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury and claimed the Aetherium shard within.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。通過她的協助，我成功破解了調諧鎖，也在珍藏庫的廢墟里面找到一塊散發神奇光芒的水晶裂片。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. Together, we found one of the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge. She left to search for the other shards and the Forge itself, and urged me to do the same.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。我們一起找到了一塊神光水晶裂片，總共有四塊。組成之後將會是開啟熔爐的鑰匙。她離開去找其他的裂片以及熔爐本身，並叫我也去找。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge, and now seek the entrance to the Forge itself.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。通過她的協助，我找到了四塊神光水晶裂片。組成之後將會是開啟熔爐的鑰匙。現在我們要找尋熔爐的入口。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge, and met her outside its long-sealed entrance.
plugin.target: 我在阿肯塔茲遇到了鬼魂卡提雅，她是一名在此處落難的冒險家。通過她的協助，我找到了四塊神光水晶裂片。組成之後將會是開啟熔爐的鑰匙。我在長久以來被封印的入口前跟她會合。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that made up the key to the Forge, and combined them to reveal the entrance to a long-sealed ruin.

plugin.source: <Alias=QuestGiver> has "suggested" I bestow the Gift of Harkon's Blood upon my spouse, <Alias=Spouse>. I should first render <Alias.PronounObj=Spouse> pliant through the use of Vampire's Seduction then embrace and bite <Alias.PronounObj=Spouse> on the neck. plugin.source: Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and decided to kill him for his crimes.
plugin.target: 雷利思·賽得瑞來到索瑟海姆的目的是要將阿季達聖物的創造者從寇泊瓊石冢中釋放出來。當他發現石冢被灰燼所掩埋時，他說服了我資助挖掘工作，並將工人們用作儀式所需的活祭品。我看穿了他的謊言，並決定殺了他以讓他為自己的罪付出代價。

plugin.source: I've stumbled across a Dark Elf in combat for his life with strange, ashen beings at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. He appears outnumbered, and he's requested I lend him a helping hand.
plugin.target: 我在鴉石鎮外的阿提烏斯農場遇見了一個暗精靈，他正努力和一群奇怪的、看似灰燼的怪物們交戰。他顯然寡不敵眾，於是他要求我出手幫忙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've stumbled across Captain Modyn Veleth fighting strange beings called "ash spawn" at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was outnumbered, so I engaged his attackers and lent him a helping hand.
plugin.target: 我在鴉石鎮外的阿提烏斯農場撞見了默丁·維黎施隊長正在與一群叫“灰燼魔”的怪物交戰。維黎施隊長寡不敵眾，因此我出手幫忙對付那些攻擊他的怪物。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Captain Veleth explained that the ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock for some time now, and he's been trying to locate their source. His lack of manpower and reluctance to leave the town without a commander are keeping him from finding out more. As a result of our conversation, I've agreed to help him deal with this situation. I need to begin by searching the Attius Farm for clues that might lead me to the ash spawn's source.
plugin.target: 維黎施隊長表示這群灰燼魔已經攻擊了鴉石鎮一段時日，而他一直在尋找它們的源頭。由於人手不足，且不放心讓鎮上在他離開時群龍無首，使他一直難以有所斬獲。在談過之後，我同意幫助他解決這個難題。我應該先從阿提烏斯農場找起，看看有沒有能讓我找出灰燼魔來源的線索。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: While assisting Captain Veleth at the Attius Farm, I've discovered a strange note. I should give this note to Captain Veleth in order to learn more about the origins of the ash spawn threat to Raven Rock.
plugin.target: 我在阿提烏斯農場救了維黎施隊長時，發現了一份奇怪的筆記。我應該把這份筆記交給維黎施隊長，以找出威脅鴉石鎮的灰燼魔是發源自何處。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Captain Veleth was alarmed by the strange note I recovered from the ash spawn at the Attius Farm. The note mentions Fort Frostmoth, the ruins of an Imperial fort located southeast of Raven Rock. According to him, the fort's been abandoned ever since the eruption of Red Mountain. He's sent me to Fort Frostmoth to kill the author of the note, General Falx Carius, before the town falls prey to his threats.
plugin.target: 看了我在阿提烏斯農場的灰燼魔身上找到的筆記後，維黎施隊長顯得很擔心。筆記中提到鴉石鎮東南方一座廢棄的帝國要塞“霜蛾堡壘”。據他說，那座堡壘自從紅山爆發後就遭到廢棄至今。他派我去霜蛾堡壘殺死寫下這份筆記的作者伐克思·卡里烏斯將軍，讓鴉石鎮免受他的威脅。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. I should return to Captain Modyn Veleth and inform him of my victory.
plugin.target: 我在霜蛾堡壘遺蹟中殺死了伐克思·卡里烏斯將軍，終結了灰燼魔對鴉石鎮的攻擊行動。我該回去告知維黎施隊長我的勝利。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth. I should examine his remains to determine what he was doing here.
plugin.target: 我在霜蛾堡壘遺蹟中殺死了伐克思·卡里烏斯將軍。我該檢視一下他的遺體，找出他在這裡做了些什麼。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: According to the letter I found on General Carius' remains, he appeared to be responsible for sending what he calls his "men" to attack the town of Raven Rock. I should bring this information to the guards in Raven Rock and let them know the threat has been eliminated.
plugin.target: 根據我在卡里烏斯將軍遺體中找到的信，看來就是他下令手下的“人”攻擊鴉石鎮的。我該告知鴉石鎮的守衛們此一資訊，並讓他們知道威脅已經被消滅了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was very pleased with my results, and awarded me a bounty in gold.
plugin.target: 我在霜蛾堡壘遺蹟中殺死了伐克思·卡里烏斯將軍，終結了灰燼魔對鴉石鎮的攻擊行動。維黎施隊長對我的表現非常高興，並且給了我賞金作為獎勵。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Captain Veleth told me that Adril Arano, Second Councilor of Raven Rock,  wanted to speak to me immediately. I should find him and discover the reason for his urgent message.
plugin.target: 維黎施隊長告訴我鴉石鎮的副議員阿德爾·阿拉諾希望能立刻和我談談。我該去找他弄清楚是什麼理由使他這麼焦急。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. For now, I've refused his request, but I should return to Adril when I'm ready to assist him.
plugin.target: 阿德爾·阿拉諾認為莫爾凡議員的生命面臨立即性的威脅，於是要求我幫忙。他認為烏倫家族的成員來到島上，並找上莫爾凡以報他處決烏倫家族祖先之仇。他要求我調查任何可能是刺客的人之身份，以試圖在不打草驚蛇的情況下逮到人。我暫時拒絕了阿德爾的要求，但等我準備好時，還是可以回去找他提供協助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. Adril suggests that I start by speaking to Geldis Sadri, the innkeeper at the Retching Netch Cornerclub. He's hoping that Geldis, who has quite the reputation as a gossip, might have some useful leads.
plugin.target: 阿德爾·阿拉諾認為莫爾凡議員的生命面臨立即性的威脅，於是要求我幫忙。他認為烏倫家族的成員來到島上，並找上莫爾凡以報他處決烏倫家族祖先之仇。他要求我調查任何可能是刺客的人之身份，以試圖在不打草驚蛇的情況下逮到人。阿德爾建議我可以去和嘔吐氣母街角酒吧的老闆吉迪思·薩德里談談。他希望吉迪恩可以發揮著名的八卦本領，給我一些指引。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Geldis Sadri has pointed out that someone is leaving ash yam offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb even though no Ulens live on Solstheim. He suggests that I stake the tomb out at night and discover the identity of the mystery visitor. Hopefully this person is either the assassin himself or can lead me to the assassin threatening Councilor Morvayn's life.
plugin.target: 吉迪思·薩德里指出雖然並沒有烏倫家族的成員住在索瑟海姆島上，但卻有人偷偷在烏倫家祖墳供奉灰燼薯。他建議我晚上躲在墳中，找出這位神秘訪客是誰。此人就算不是刺客本人，最少也能帶領我找到威脅莫爾凡議員生命的傢伙。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the Ulen Ancestral Tomb at night. This seems suspicious, as she doesn't belong to the Ulen family by name. I should bring this piece of evidence to Adril Arano immediately.
plugin.target: 我發現蒂莉蘇·瑟佛林在晚上來到烏倫家祖墳。這看起來很可疑，而她也不姓烏倫。我該立刻將這項證據回報給阿德爾·阿拉諾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've informed Adril Arano that Tilisu Severin was the mystery visitor leaving offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. Since this is not enough evidence to accuse her of a crime, he's sending me to Severin Manor in order to uncover solid evidence that exposes Tilisu as an assassin.
plugin.target: 我告訴阿德爾·阿拉諾說蒂莉蘇·瑟佛林便是那位在烏倫家祖墳中供奉祭品的神秘訪客。由於這項證據還不足以構成控訴她的罪狀，他派我去瑟佛林宅邸以找出蒂莉蘇便是刺客的鐵證。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've recovered evidence from Severin Manor that exposes the true nature of the Severin family. The letters indicate that Vendil Severin is actually Vendil Ulen and that his supposed wife Tilisu and his daughter Mirri are members of House Hlaalu, one of the Great Houses that opposes Morvayn's House Redoran. All three of them are working in conjunction with unknown forces in a place called "Ashfallow Citadel," to assassinate Councilor Morvayn. I need to bring this urgent revelation to Adril Arano immediately.
plugin.target: 我在瑟佛林宅邸中找到了關於瑟佛林一家真實身分的證據。信中指出文德·瑟佛林其實叫做文德·烏倫，而表面上是他妻子的蒂莉蘇和女兒迷麗則是哈拉魯家族的成員——那是和莫爾凡所屬的瑞多然家族敵對的豪族之一。他們三個與一支駐紮在燼休堡壘的不明勢力合作，試圖暗殺莫爾凡議員。我得立刻向阿德爾·阿拉諾揭露這緊急訊息。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I'm supposed to meet two Redoran Guard outside the ruins who will assist me in this regard.
plugin.target: 阿德爾·阿拉諾派我去燼休堡壘摧毀文德·烏倫和與他合作的勢力。我應該去和遺蹟外的兩名瑞多然禁衛隊會合，他們將會在這次行動中提供協助。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I've found the two Redoran Guard I was supposed to meet there dead. I'll have to carry the fight into the ruins alone.
plugin.target: 阿德爾·阿拉諾派我去燼休堡壘摧毀文德·烏倫和與他合作的勢力。我發現那兩名應該和我會合的瑞多然禁衛隊已經死了。我得獨自奮戰進入遺蹟當中。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've killed Vendil Ulen and stopped the threat against Councilor Morvayn. Vendil had hired assassins from Morrowind known as the Morag Tong to help him with his coup, but fortunately I was able to defeat them in the depths of Ashfallow Citadel. I should return to Adril Arano with the good news.
plugin.target: 我殺死了文德·烏倫，並阻止了他企圖對莫爾凡議員不利的陰謀。文德從晨風省僱用了著名的魔拉格堂刺客來協助他。幸運的是，我在燼休堡壘地下擊敗了他們。我該把這個好訊息帶回去給阿德爾·阿拉諾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: With Vendil Ulen dead and the Morag Tong eliminated, I've ended the threat to Councilor Morvayn. In appreciation for my actions, I've been awarded Severin Manor and all of the contents within and deemed an honorary citizen of Raven Rock.
plugin.target: 如今文德·烏倫已死，魔拉格堂的人手也被殲滅，我終結了莫爾凡議員所面對的威脅。為感謝我的行動，我獲得了瑟佛林宅邸、所有裡面的物品以及鴉石鎮榮譽居民的身份。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the mines of Raven Rock contain a secret important enough for him to risk his own life to discover. He appears to have more to tell, so I should listen to what he has to say if I want to learn more.
plugin.target: 我在鴉石鎮礦坑遇見了克雷修斯·凱力尤司。他深信鴉石鎮的礦坑中藏著重要到足以讓他冒著生命危險去探索的秘密。他看起來還有更多沒說的事，所以如果我想知道，就該聽聽他怎麼講。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the remains of his great-grandfather, Gratian Caerellius, are at the bottom of the mine and that the East Empire Company has falsely designated his ancestor's death as an accident. He's tasked me with exploring the mine on his behalf to locate the remains, and perhaps discovering what killed Gratian Caerellius.
plugin.target: 我在鴉石鎮礦坑遇見了克雷修斯·凱力尤司。他深信曾祖父格拉提安·凱力尤司的遺體還在礦坑的底部，而東帝國貿易公司將他祖先的死詐稱為一場意外。他要求我代他探索礦坑找出遺體，如果可能的話則也一起找出是什麼致格拉提安·凱力尤司於死地的。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've located the skeletal remains of Gratian Caerellius. I've discovered an old journal. In order to return it to Crescius, I'll have to discover a way to escape Bloodskal Barrow.
plugin.target: 我發現了格拉提安·凱力尤司的遺體。在他的行囊中，我找到了一份古老的日記。為了將它還給克雷修斯，我得想辦法找路逃出血吟石冢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: After locating the remains of Gratian Caerellius, recovering his journal, and escaping Bloodskal Barrow, I should bring the evidence of my discovery to Crescius Caerellius.
plugin.target: 在發現了格拉提安·凱力尤司的遺體、找到他的日記並逃出血吟石冢後，我得把我所發現的證物帶去給克雷修斯。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Tharstan, a historian living in Skaal Village who discovered the recently unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.
plugin.target: 我遇見了一位住在斯卡爾村的歷史學者沙爾斯坦。他發現了一座最近出土的古老墓穴入口。他提議僱用我在探索墓穴時保護他，並告訴我如果有興趣的話，就去那裡找他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Tharstan, a historian living in Skaal Village who discovered the recently unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.
plugin.target: 我遇見了一位住在斯卡爾村的歷史學者沙爾斯坦。他發現了一座最近出土的古老墓穴入口。他提議僱用我在探索墓穴時保護他，並告訴我如果有興趣的話，就去那裡找他。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I arrived at the old tomb to find Tharstan waiting for me. He was eager to start exploring the place, and he asked me to lead the way. First, I need to figure out how to open the doors in the main chamber. Once that's done, we can explore the tunnels beyond.
plugin.target: 抵達古墓時，沙爾斯坦已經在等我了。他急切地想要探索這個地方，要求我帶路。首先，我必須找出如何開啟主廳的那道門。門開了之後，我們才有辦法探索裡面的通道。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Tharstan, a Nord from Skaal Village who discovered an old draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. After we discovered a pair of word walls, as well as two pieces of an ancient claw, we gained entry into a sealed chamber. Tharstan's translations suggest that we'll find a Dragon Priest's sarcophagus nearby.
plugin.target: 我遇見了一個來自斯卡爾村的諾德人，名叫沙爾斯坦。他發現了一座古老的諾德墓穴。我同意陪伴他探索這座古老的墓穴。在發現了兩面龍語之牆和分成兩半的古代龍爪後，我們來到了一間被封印的廳室前。根據沙爾斯坦的翻譯，他認為我們會在附近找到一座龍祭司的石棺。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Tharstan, a Nord from Skaal Village who discovered an old draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. Inside, we found the tomb of a Dragon Priest left behind long ago to guard against a traitor from his own order.
plugin.target: 我遇見了一個來自斯卡爾村的諾德人，名叫沙爾斯坦。他發現了一座古老的諾德墓穴。我同意陪伴他探索這座古老的墓穴。在裡面，我們找到了一座被遺棄多年的龍祭司陵墓，用途是用來看守成員中的背叛者。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met a historian named Tharstan in Skaal Village and he hired me to help him explore an old tomb he'd discovered. It turned out to the tomb of a Dragon Priest named Vahlok, who I fought and defeated.
plugin.target: 我在斯卡爾村遇見了一個叫做沙爾斯坦的歷史學者。他僱用我協助他探索他發現的一座古墓。後來我們發現那是名為瓦羅科的龍祭司的古墓，並在墓中擊敗了它。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf's worst fears of his brother proved true, unfortunately. plugin.source: It seems that Brutius was a wizard that has been luring unsuspecting fisherman into the woods under the guise of a fishing contest, only to slay and rob them. Of note is an enchanted ring that he recently lost in the river at the fishing spot he lured his victims. I might be able to claim it if I try fishing there myself.
plugin.target: 看起來布魯提圖斯是法師。他誘騙毫不知情的漁民進入森林，在一場釣魚對決後殺戮並且搶劫這個漁民。字條上寫道，他在河裡丟失了一枚附魔戒指，位置就在這個釣魚點，所以他才會在這個位置引誘漁民進行釣魚對決，希望把戒指釣出來。好吧，我自己試試看能否釣出來這枚戒指。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Tamriel is a better place without Brutius preying upon the citizens of Morthal. I also managed to fish up the Warlock's Ring, the ring Brutius lost at the spot near the river where he lured his victims.

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch.
plugin.target: 深水之王給了我另一個釣魚挑戰。我應該讀一下他給我的名單來看看我要釣什麼魚。

plugin.source: The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch are a bit more elusive than last time. However, they come to the surface more frequently while it is raining. I should refer to the second volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.
plugin.target: 深水之王讓我這次釣的魚比上次更難了一點。但是這些魚有個特點，在下雨的時候，這些魚會更加頻繁地浮出水面。我應該找到釣魚大全卷2來獲取更多內容。深水之王還希望我提供一個幫助，幫他找到他的幸運漁夫帽。這頂帽子丟失在了薩雷提農場西面的釣魚點。他說無論什麼時候他戴這頂帽子釣魚，天上都會各種傾盆大雨。我覺得封建迷信不可取，但我肯定會竭盡所能獲得幸運一手來完成挑戰。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I have read the second volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch are most easily caught when it's raining in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Catfish and pygmy sunfish can only be caught in lakes, while Spadefish can be found in streams. Pearlfish can be caught in both lakes and streams. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.
plugin.target: 我讀完了第二卷的釣魚大全。我這次需要釣起來的魚，在下雨的溫暖地區更容易被獲得。鯰魚和白鱘只會在湖裡獲得，而侏儒翻車魚則可以在小溪中找到。珍珠魚在湖水和小溪中都有存在。他還讓我幫忙釣起來他的幸運漁夫帽。這頂帽子被沉在了薩雷提農場西部的釣魚點。他說無論什麼時候他戴這頂帽子釣魚的時候，都會遭遇傾盆大雨。封建迷信不可取，但我為了完成挑戰，會採用所有手段提升幸運值。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge, as well as his lucky fishing hat. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish. He also handed me a sum of gold.
plugin.target: 我給了深水之王所有所需的魚，以證明我完成了他的挑戰。同時我還把他的幸運漁夫帽給了他。他獎勵了我一根亞龍人魚竿，這根魚竿專精大魚。除此之外還額外給了我一筆錢。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Calcelmo has heard fishermen's tales of a strange apparatus outside of Bronze Water Cave. He believes it is an ancient Dwemer mechanism of unknown purpose, waiting to be brought to life. I should investigate the area and see if there might be any way to trigger it.
plugin.target: 卡塞默聽一個漁民講述了銅水洞穴外一臺奇怪裝置的故事。他相信這是一臺古代矮人的機器，作用未知。這臺機器正在等待識貨的人幫它煥新。我應該調查這片區域，看看是否有什麼開關可以啟用這臺機器。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've arrived at the entrance of Bronze Water Cave. The fishermen that once fished here seem to have left behind a journal. It may contain a clue for activating the mechanisms nearby.
plugin.target: 我到達了銅水洞穴的入口。那個曾在這釣魚的漁民已經離開，但留下了一本日誌。這本日誌大概寫了了啟用這臺機器的線索。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The fishermen at Bronze Water Cave saw faint glowing objects at the bottom of the lake near Bronze Water Cave, but they were unable to fish them up. They believed that a fishing rod of Dwarven make might be needed to retrieve them. They recently left for Alftand Ruined Tower, where the schematics for such a rod might be located.
plugin.target: 一些漁民在銅水洞穴附近的湖底看見了一個發著微弱光芒的物體，但是他釣不起來。他們相信一根矮人魚竿可以釣起來那件東西。他們最近正動身前往精靈之牙遺蹟塔，在那裡也許有矮人魚竿的設計圖。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I've found the schematics for the Dwarven fishing rod that might be used to catch the glowing objects that lie below the water's surface outside of Bronze Water Cave. I should return it to Calcelmo so that he can construct it.
plugin.target: 我已經找到了矮人魚竿的設計圖，這個設計圖大概可以造出矮人魚竿，然後就可以釣起銅水洞穴附近湖底的發光開關。我應該回去找卡塞莫，讓他給我做一支出來。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: I cast the Dwarven fishing rod into the water near Bronze Water Cave, and caught an aetherium dynamo core. An empty socket on the pedestal nearby appears to be shaped to hold such a core. I'll have to insert the dynamo core to bring the rest of the mechanism to life.
plugin.target: 我把矮人魚竿甩進了銅水洞穴附近的湖裡，並且釣起來了一個神光水晶動力核。旁邊的基座上就缺了一個這種東西，有一個插槽，並且形狀大小剛好合適。我可以把這個動力核插進去，讓這臺機器恢復活力。

plugin.target: “白鬃”克拉科是戰友團的先驅者。他不發號施令，但在勇士之家和九大領地境內，他的話都備受重視。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 天際有九大領地：東陲、佛克瑞斯、海芬加、希雅陲、蒼原、邊塞領、裂痕、白漫以及冬堡。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 凡人們經常將西帝斯具象化為一個骷髏化身，以昭示他與死亡的關係。事實上，恐懼君主是無形的，如虛空般飄渺無垠。

plugin.target: 晨星的黑暗兄弟會聖所現在是一座古老的廢墟，其不祥的黑色大門使城市裡的居民們感到畏懼並敬而遠之。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 暗精靈，也被稱為丹莫，是晨風省的原住民，很多人都把那裡看作是化外之境。

plugin.target: 高精靈，也被稱為傲爾特莫，是夏暮島的原住民。那裡是一塊充滿神秘氣息的先古大陸。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 阿祖拉是黃昏和晨曦的魔神，也是少數幾個被認為並不完全是邪惡的魔神之一。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 波耶西亞是欺騙、密謀和謀殺的魔神。許多暗精靈認為他是自己的先祖。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 赫麥尤斯·莫拉是命運、知識和記憶的魔神。和凡人接觸時，他喜歡以一堆怪誕的觸角為形貌示人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 魔神海爾辛也被稱為狩獵王子、獸化人之父。他會發起魂獵來懲罰那些冒犯他的人。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Malacath is the Daedric Prince of Curses and the Spurned. Many Orcs worship him as their god-king.
plugin.target: 瑪拉凱斯是詛咒和遺棄的魔神，許多獸人把他當做神王來崇拜。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.target: 梅魯涅斯·大袞是毀滅、變革和野心的魔神。他引發了湮滅危機，並曾嘗試以自己可怕的真身入侵泰姆瑞爾。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mephala is the Daedric Prince of lies, secrets, and plots... and thoroughly enjoys meddling in the affairs of mortals.
plugin.target: 梅法拉是謊言、秘密和謀劃的魔神……因此特別喜歡插手凡人事務。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Meridia despises undead in any form, and is one of the few Daedric Princes not considered to be wholly evil.
plugin.target: 梅瑞狄雅仇視一切亡靈，是少數幾個被認為並不完全是邪惡的魔神之一。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Namira is the Daedric Prince of Darkness and Revulsion, and is frequently associated with disease, spiders, insects, slugs, and other repulsive creatures.
plugin.target: 娜米拉是黑暗和災變的魔神，往往和疾病，以及蜘蛛、昆蟲和鼻涕蟲這些令人反感的生物有關。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Peryite is the Daedric Prince of tasks, order, and pestilence. He is considered one of the weakest of the princes, despite being depicted as a dragon.
plugin.target: 魄伊特是使命、秩序和疾病的魔神。他被認為是所有的魔神中最弱的，雖然他的形象是一隻巨龍。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sanguine is the Daedric Prince of hedonism, debauchery, and dark indulgences. He is more likely than most princes to take an interest in mortal affairs.
plugin.target: 桑吉恩是享樂和放蕩的魔神。他比其他的魔神對凡人事務更感興趣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Sheogorath is the Daedric Prince of Madness. He is utterly unpredictable, and may hinder or help any mortal unlucky enough to cross his path.
plugin.target: 謝爾格拉是瘋狂的魔神。他的行為完全不可預知，可能會阻礙或者幫助那些不幸遇到他的凡人們。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Vaermina is the Daedric Prince of dreams, nightmares, and evil omens.
plugin.target: 瓦爾迷納是夢境、噩夢和惡兆的魔神。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Kynareth is the goddess of the air, wind, and sky. She has a temple in Whiterun.
plugin.target: 凱娜瑞絲是大氣、風和天空女神。她的神殿位於白漫城。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The wilds of Skyrim are teeming with deer and elk. They are docile creatures, but serve as food for much of the province's more savage beasts.
plugin.target: 天際的野外可以見到很多鹿，它們很溫順，但是卻成了很多肉食野獸的美餐。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Few creatures match the cunning, depravity, and repulsiveness of the hagravens. A terrible conjoining of woman and bird, they will take through savagery what they cannot win through guile.
plugin.target: 很少有生物能有烏鴉鬼婆那樣狡猾、墮落和令人厭惡。它們是女人和鳥類的恐怖結合體，並會用野蠻的手段來奪取它們用欺騙所無法獲取的東西。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Of all the automatons left behind by the ancient Dwemer, the Dwarven centurions are among the most technologically impressive... and deadly. They guard Dwemer ruins as if their masters still walked the halls.
plugin.target: 在古代鍛莫留下的自動機械中，用於鍛莫百夫長的技術是最令人讚歎的……並且也是最致命的。它們守衛著鍛莫遺蹟，就像它們的主人仍然闊步於那些大殿中一樣。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Woe to the unwary explorer who delves deep into the burial crypts of the ancient Nords, and disturbs the draugr that dwell within.
plugin.target: 對一名粗心大意的旅者來說，最糟糕的情況莫過於不小心踏入古代諾德人墓穴，並打擾到長眠其中的屍鬼們了。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: What the Dwarven sphere lacks in strength it makes up for in speed and mobility, as it patrols the halls of the Dwemer ruins it still protects.
plugin.target: 鍛莫機械球缺乏力量，卻擁有速度和機動力。它至今仍四處巡邏，守衛著鍛莫遺蹟的大廳。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Mammoths are a common sight in the tundra of Skyrim, and are often herded by the giants that also call that region home. They are generally peaceful creatures, unless provoked.
plugin.target: 長毛象在天際的苔原上很常見，通常由在附近生活的巨人飼養。除非被激怒，否則它們通常是很溫順的生物。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The frost troll is the most fearsome of its kind found in Skyrim, and is at home in the province's most frozen regions.
plugin.target: 天際的雪地巨魔是同類中最可怕的亞種，居住在該省份最寒冷的地區。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Most of the dogs in Skyrim are domesticated, and serve as faithful companions to their masters.
plugin.target: 天際大多數狗都已經被馴化成它們諾德主人忠誠的夥伴。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Horses and horse-drawn carriages are common means of transportation in Skyrim. Both can handle the harsh terrain with ease.
plugin.target: 馬匹和馬車是天際常見的交通工具。兩者都可以良好地適應惡劣地形。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The frostbite spider is one of Skyrim's most fearsome and loathed native creatures. It will attack anyone relentlessly with both poison and fangs, and is as deadly as the affliction for which it was named.
plugin.target: 霜噬蜘蛛是天際最可怕也是最討厭的動物。它會無情地使用毒素和利齒攻擊任何人，也因此有了這個代表痛苦與致命的名字。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: The sabre cat of Skyrim is a giant, ferocious predator, and will often ambush travelers who stray too far from the roads, and into the wilds.
plugin.target: 天際的劍齒虎是一種兇殘的食肉動物，常常伏擊那些離大路太遠的旅者們。

plugin.source: The common mudcrab can be found by the northern shoreline or along the banks of any lakes or rivers. When not moving, it is easy to mistake for a rock, and uses this natural camouflage to ambush unwary prey.

plugin.source: Nocturnal is the Daedric Mistress of Stealth and Shadow, and a patron to thieves.
plugin.target: 諾克圖娜爾是掌管潛行和暗影的魔神，也是盜賊的守護神。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: Little is known of the mysterious spriggans, save that they revere Skyrim's forested regions, and will defend these regions with their lives.
plugin.target: 人們對神秘的樹精所知甚少，只知道他們熱愛天際的森林地帶，並且會用他們的生命來保衛那些區域。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp

plugin.source: No one is quite sure why the draugr walk the halls of Skyrim's burial crypts, but some believe they once served the dragons ages ago... and have been cursed with undeath for their treachery.
plugin.target: 沒人知道天際的墓穴裡為什麼會有屍鬼出沒，但是某些人認為它們曾經為巨龍服務……並因為背叛而遭到詛咒變成了不死的亡靈。

plugin.target: 通過簽訂名為“白金協定”的停火協議，帝國才從高精靈“先祖神洲”的猛烈攻勢中倖存下來，並結束了浩大戰爭。
plugin.provenance: USSEP CHS 4.3.6c (Nexus 143324) matched into exact 4.3.8a source; OpenCC s2twp
